Abyssal Ridge.desc: Send a cascading eruption towards your foes, forcing them to react.

Abyssal Tendrils.desc: Create tentacles and pierce multiple opponents at once.

Alsin's Aid.desc: Give your ally an aura that grants then more speed, and increases the amount of healing they receive for 10 seconds.

Arc Beam.desc: Fire plasma energy. Deals additional damage in PvE.

Arc Suit.desc: Conjure and equip your Arcwarder suit.

Arc Wave.desc: Stomp the ground releasing a wave of Arc energy.

Ardour Slicer.desc: Close the distance and deliver a fast slash using your Ardour.

Ascension.desc: Take to the skies for a devastating strike.

Ash Slam.desc: Strike the ground, turning it to ash.

Astral Wind.desc: A rapid delivery of consecutive attacks.

Blade of Saints.desc: Perform an Attuned attack. This attack will change depending on your current Saint Stance.

Blinding Dawn.desc: Spin rapidly to unleash powerful rays of light.

Blood Orb.desc: Release an amalgamation of your blood.

Bloodcurdle.desc: Manipulate the blood within your target's body.

Bloodedge.desc: Conjure a scythe of blood and swing.

Bloodtide Ritual.desc: Summon the Bloodtide and perform a sacrificial judgement.

Bone Wisp.desc: A servant of bone, powered by the Eternal Gale.

Brace.desc: Brace yourself against attacks and gain hyperarmour.

Burning Servants.desc: Summon a legion of flaming spearmen that lunge inwards.

Ceaseless Slashes.desc: Click to reveal yourself and deliver a rapid flurry of slashes that can chain together.

Celestial Assault.desc: Use your wings and deliver two critical blows.

Chain Pull.desc: Manifest chains to brutally pull enemies towards you.

Champion's Whirlthrow.desc: Grab your opponent and toss them with the power of gale. Pressing F will toss your opponent straight down.

Close Shave.desc: Close the distance and deliver a fast slash.

Crimson Rain.desc: Release blood daggers. Recast to call them.

Crimson Surge.desc: Slash upwards and launch slashes of blood.

Crystal Impale.desc: Impale your foes with a brutal ice barrage. Does +50% damage if enemy is airborne, or after a Crystal Knee.

Crystal Knee.desc: Knock your enemy skyward with a kick of crystal.

Devouring Eye.desc: Summons a fragile eye that consumes the Ether of those who try to cast Mantras within its gaze.

Dread Whisper.desc: Grab your opponent and whisper a terrible truth in their ear. Further truths are unbearable. Deals increased damage to the insane.

Electro Carve.desc: Produce a highly potent field of electromagnetism, shocking all inside.

Emotion Wave.desc: Conjure up surging waves of lightning that travel along the ground.

Encircle.desc: Conjure shadows around your enemy before warp-striking to them.

Equalizer.desc: Whip forward a tendril. If it connects, it deals damage to the target, and gives the user a blue aura.

Ether Barrage.desc: Conjure concentrated orbs of Ether to launch at your enemy.

Ether Flight.desc: Take flight! Spacebar to ascend, CTRL to descend.

Exhaustion Strike.desc: A melee strike that removes your posture's damage on hit.

Fake Strike.desc: Trick your opponent and quickly go behind them.

Fire Gun.desc: A bullet of flames shot through each hand.

Fire Palm.desc: Conjure a cone of flames in front of you.

Firing Line.desc: Create a firing line of metal to light up your target.

Flame Assault.desc: Dash forward in a spiral of flames.

Flame Ballista.desc: Conjure a flaming arrow and fire it at your target.

Flame Blind.desc: Shoot a projectile that explodes after a short delay and blinds those looking at it.

Flame Grab.desc: Jet forwards with flames and slam anyone you catch in your clutches.

Flame Leap.desc: Leap up leaving behind a burst of flames.

Flame Repulsion.desc: Charge up an exertion of flames that knocks opponents backwards. If you take damage while charging, you repulse it back.

Flamecharm Blade of Saints.desc: Rise into the air, and slam down your Saintsblade to apply burn and knockdown to anyone hit.

Flare Volley.desc: Conjure up to 3 fireballs to volley at your enemies.

Flashdraw Strike.desc: Swiftly unsheathe your blade and deliver an upwards strike.

Flashfire Sweep.desc: Sweep with flames and lightning before following into a devastating uppercut.

Fleeting Sparks.desc: Call forth motes of electricity that seek out your foes.

Frostdraw Blade of Saints.desc: Use your Saintsblade to shoot out 3 crescent-shaped ice projectiles, followed up by a lunge which applies heavy knockback.

Gale Punch.desc: Form a punch of wind in your fist and release it.

Gale Wisp.desc: A servant of wind. Reduces fall damage by 20%. With Specter Path, makes your mantras give more Spectral Gauge. With Haunted Gale, increases the duration of your Phantoms by 3s.

Galebreathe Blade of Saints.desc: You propel yourself forwards with the winds, uppercutting anyone in your wake.

Glare.desc: Opponents facing you are briefly rendered immobile.

Glorious Charge.desc: Yell with valor and courage, increasing the speed of those who are in your party by 20 seconds and making them unknockable for 10 seconds.

Graceful Flame.desc: Conjure an undying flame for the caster and their comrades to rest by.

Grand Javelin.desc: A javelin made out of lightning.

Hell's Judgement.desc: A vicious grasp of flames. Receive a damage buff if you land this attack.

Hidden Blade.desc: Pull out a hidden blade and quickly stab your opponent, dealing a percentage of your opponents health while also applying a bonus poison.

Ice Cubes.desc: Manifest cubes of Ice to fire at your enemies. Cast the Mantra again to fire cubes.

Ice Daggers.desc: Form and toss daggers of ice at your aimed opponent.

Ice Fissure.desc: Send ice rippling out in a shockwave.

Ice Flock.desc: Send forth a flock of ice

Ice Forge.desc: Conjure and throw weapons of ice.

Ice Lance.desc: Form an ice spear and lunges forward.

Illusory Counter.desc: Fool others into striking and retaliate.

Illusory Servants.desc: Illusory servants to await your commands

Impel.desc: Blast through your opponent's guard and pull them towards you.

Iron Hug.desc: Crush your opponents bones with an iron infused grab.

Iron Quills.desc: Conjure metal from within, impaling surrounding entities.

Iron Skin.desc: Coat your skin with metal to reduce harm.

Iron Slam.desc: Conjure a giant rod of metal and slam it down.

Iron Tether.desc: Summon two cubes tethered by lightning, setting a trap for your enemies.

Jet Kick.desc: Rush forward with a jet kick. Requires a target if you're in combat.

Judgement.desc: Summon a black casting circle before enveloping a humanoid target in tendrils and tearing them apart. The target is unable to move or act during the animation.

Karita Divebomb.desc: Launch into the air and deliver a devastating divebomb kick. Chains from Karita Leap.

Karita Leap.desc: Launch yourself into a flying kick, backflipping into the air if you hit a wall.

Karita Swap.desc: Grab your ally and swap places in them while moving in with a swift kick to save them.

Lethal Injection.desc: Lunge forward and inject the targeted person with all of your auto-brew potions.

Lightning Clones.desc: Replicated forms of yourself conjured from electricity.

Lightning Impact.desc: Slam those under you with a lightning empowered kick.

Lightning Strike.desc: A strike of thunder at your desired location.

Lord's Slice.desc: The Hidden Tendril contracts, pulling both the contractor and target closer. They are flung in opposite directions.

Master's Flourish.desc: A powerful slash that chips through block and slashes through armor.

Metal Armament.desc: Summon a blade of metal to swing alongside you.

Metal Ball.desc: Create a metal ball and rush forward.

Metal Fakeout.desc: Create a metal clone and appear behind your target.

Metal Gatling.desc: A deadly rush of several metallic rods.

Metal Kick.desc: A powerful kick laced with metal.

Metal Rain.desc: Unleash a rain of metal rods down below.

Metal Turret.desc: An automated turret that fires at targets that that cross its sight.

Mindsoothe.desc: Give comfort to your allies by sharing in their burden.

Mirror Illusion.desc: Mirror your opponents and use their arsenal to your advantage.

Neural Pathway.desc: Using your mind's eye, you force your imagined position into reality, appearing to teleport a short distance. You alone know that the world moved, not you.

Onslaught.desc: Reel back and swing your weapon, unleashing an onslaught of blows if it hits.

Oxidizing Rush.desc: Conjure metal swords and rush forward with them.

Palm Strike.desc: Slice your opponent with your palm.

Parasitic Leech.desc: Activate when linked to an enemy to leech their own health for a short duration.

Permafrost Prison.desc: Imprison your enemies with shadows and impale them with pillars.

Pillars of Erisia.desc: Gaining inspiration from the Duke of Erisia, call forth a malicious gale from your stomp.

Precision Cuts.desc: Snip forward 3 times with your scissors!

Prediction.desc: Predict an opponent's attack and reflect it.

Pressure Blast.desc: Unleash a powerful pressure blast from the weight of your weapon.

Prominence Draw.desc: Close the distance and deliver a fast slash.

Punishment.desc: Absorb damage then return fury upon your foes.

Radiant Dawn.desc: Strike down your foes with your blinding light.

Radiant Kick.desc: Kick your foes at the speed of light.

Rally.desc: Absorb incoming posture damage for allies around you for a set duration. When you parry, you restore the posture of your allies. Restores some posture on cast.

Rapid Punches.desc: Unleash a barrage of blows against your foes.

Rapid Slashes.desc: Rush down your opponent cutting them apart.

Razor Blitz.desc: Create weapons on your arms and dash through.

Reinforce.desc: Buff those around you with extra defense and damage.

Relentless Flames.desc: Bear down on your foes with repeated fiery slashes.

Restrain.desc: Deliver a powerful kick that binds your opponent's soul to yours.

Revenge.desc: A vengeful rush. Deals additional damage the lower your health is below 50%.

Rhythm Advance.desc: Channel your Rhythm and track down your opponent.

Rising Frost.desc: Conjure a glaive of frost to launch your opponents skywards.

Rising Thunder.desc: Rise up with your opponent and crash down as a bolt of lightning.

Rising Wind.desc: Use wind to uppercut and propel yourself into the air. Press F after hitting an opponent to impale them

Rocket Lance.desc: Create a lance, impale your opponent, and send them flying.

Rupture.desc: Detonate your chained target, unleashing a powerful blast that shatters their restraints and inflicts significant damage.

Sanguine Dive.desc: Create or jump into a pool of blood.

Searing Snare.desc: Place a fiery snare at a chosen location. Enemies that stumble into it are scorched.

Shade Bringer.desc: Temporarily summon a shadow greatsword for a large slash.

Shade Devour.desc: Gorge on your own health for raw strength

Shade Step.desc: Submerge into your shadow. Click to launch an attack at any point while submerged.

Shadow Gun.desc: An awful blast of dark energy.

Shadow Seekers.desc: Call forth the void to track your opponents.

Shadow Vortex.desc: Create a shadow vortex that pulls in everything in its surrounding.

Shadowcast Blade of Saints.desc: The Saintsblade releases a horizontal mid-range slash of darkness that pulls enemies along with it, knocking them up at the end of its path.

Shoulder Bash.desc: Rush at your enemies with your full physical force.

Sightless Beam.desc: Turn insanity against your enemies, incredibly strong against depths creatures.

Sing.desc: Charm those around you with your powerful voice.

Sinister Halo.desc: Emit a spinning ring of celestial energy, trapping and shredding any who step before its wake.

Skycrash.desc: Leap towards your enemies and stomp knocking up enemies caught.

Skyshatter Kick.desc: Unleash two devastating kicks with your brute strength.

Slice 'n' Dice.desc: Step forward and slice through your enemies. Ability can be activated again on a successful hit.

Soul Beam.desc: Harness your Chorus of Wisps to unleash a devastating blast.

Soulflare Siphon.desc: Grab and siphon blood out of your victim.

Sovereign Drive.desc: Dash forward in a blink, knocking down enemies in your path.

Spark Swap.desc: Swap places with a selected target.

Storm Blades.desc: Conjure weapons of thunder with your ether.

Strong Leap.desc: Kick off of the ground with your strength, sending you into the air.

Summon Cauldron.desc: Make a cauldron appear from your memories.

Symbiotic Sustain.desc: Activate when linked to an ally to sacrifice your own health to them.

Table Flip.desc: Toss the ground in front of you.

Tacet Drop Kick.desc: Disguise yourself in tacet and drop kick your enemies.

Tacet Kick.desc: Slip out of perception and deliver a brutal kick.

Taunt.desc: Taunt those around you, causing them to be unable to jump and to take 20% more damage. However, they deal 10% more damage.

Tempest Blitz.desc: Sprint forward on the winds themselves and deliver a devastating thunder kick.

Thunder Kick.desc: An unrelenting kick like a clap of thunder.

Thundercall Blade of Saints.desc: Slash twice with your Saintsblade, applying knockdown on the second hit, followed up by a devastating bolt of lightning that applies stun.

Tornado Kick.desc: Kick a gust of wind forward, if it hits an enemy leap into the air and launch 3 more.

Tranquil Circle.desc: All within the ring cannot cast Mantras. Those who stand within the ring gain 10% Monster Armor and 10% Damage vs Monsters.

Twincleave.desc: Dart around the battlefield with devastating cleaves delivered in quick succession.

Twister Kicks.desc: Go forth with spinning kicks infused with the wind

Umbral Slash.desc: A swift slash channelled with foul energy.

Veinbreaker.desc: Charge up a strong punch infused with your blood.

Vicious Descent.desc: Leap into the air and slam down with vengeance.

Warp Kick.desc: Perform a kick, then warp to your enemies for a second followup kick.

Whirling Blade.desc: A chitinous scythe to cut through your foes in a whirl.

Wind Carve.desc: A quick swirl of sharp winds.

Wind Forge.desc: Encircle your foes with blades of wind that halt their escape until they respond.

A World Without Song.additional_info: The hit count required to proc this Talent is increased to 4 if you have less than 75 Galebreathe, and increased to 5 if you have less than 40 Galebreathe.
A World Without Song.desc: Every 3 hits with a Wind Mantra now procs Suffocating.

Absolute Force.desc: Evolve the technique of your Oppressive Force, letting both hits of your flourish deal 50% more posture damage.

Absolute Pitch.additional_info: If you have less than 100 Intelligence, this will instead halve the required Ritual Keys (rounded up).
Absolute Pitch.desc: You can cast Ritual Mantras instantly.

Absolute Radiance.additional_info: All elemental status effects cannot be applied to you during Absolute Radiance.
Absolute Radiance.desc: Dealing damage with Dawnwalker mantras briefly makes you immune to all elemental effects for a short period.

Acceleration Points.desc: Striking an opponent in the back with mobility mantras or Basic Attacks now steals and grants additional momentum.

Action Surge.additional_info: Both this and Vigil's Grace are applied before Lightning Cloak's swing speed multiplier.
Action Surge.desc: Adrenaline Surge now increases your swing speed by 0.04 for its duration.

Actions Speak Louder.additional_info: In 1v1 Chime of Conflict, your critical cooldown is reduced by 10% instead.
Actions Speak Louder.desc: Your Critical Attack cooldown is 20% shorter, but your Resonance cooldown is 20% longer. In areas where your Resonance is suppressed, reduce your cooldown by 10% instead.

Acute Hearing.additional_info: Your Echolocation now has a sound effect on proc.
Acute Hearing.desc: After years of using Echolocation, you've trained your ears to sense danger from even further away. You are also able to sense when someone completes a job.

Ad Astra.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that allows you to travel to and from The Floating Keep.

Adept Bloodrender.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Bloodrender.desc: You can now obtain 1-star Bloodrender mantras.

Adept Flamecharmer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Flamecharmer.desc: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.

Adept Frostdrawer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Frostdrawer.desc: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Frostdrawer Mantras.

Adept Galebreather.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Galebreather.desc: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.

Adept Ironsinger.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Ironsinger.desc: You can now obtain 1-star Ironsinger mantras.

Adept Shadowcaster.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Shadowcaster.desc: You can now obtain 1-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.

Adept Thundercaller.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Adept Thundercaller.desc: You can now obtain 1-star Thundercaller mantras.

Aegis of Tenacity.desc: You gain resistance to Guardbreaks, but your posture isn't reset when broken. Reduce all posture damage you take by 75%.

Aerogliding.additional_info: When active, create an aura that reduces fall speed and stops fall damage. Automatically ends after 5 seconds.
Aerogliding.desc: When falling from a high place, hold spacebar to generate wind currents until you hit the floor.

Aeronade.additional_info: Galetrap normally waits for contact with a target to begin its tornado, Galetrap now detonates once the trap stops moving.
Aeronade.desc: Your Galetrap automatically detonates on contact with an object.

After Cut.additional_info: After Cut deals 5% of a weapon attack's modified damage or 2.5% of a Mantra's modified damage.
After Cut.desc: Physical wind attacks apply an after cut that deals 5% of the damage dealt. Mantra after cuts deal 2.5% instead.

Against All Odds.desc: For each combat tag you have on your character, increase your damage by 2% (max of 14%).

Agility Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Agility Attribute. The requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Agility on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Agility Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your agility to its fullest.

Agitating Spark.additional_info: On proc, a small orange particle will trail between the burning target you hit and other targets nearby, setting them on fire and granting Emperor Flame stacks. Agitating Spark bypasses block and parry. Agitating Spark procs from self damage do not apply burn. 1 second cooldown.
Agitating Spark.desc: Applying Burning to enemies spreads to anyone nearby. Including yourself.

Air Pressure.desc: Dodging an attack or hitting an enemy's block will transform your next dash into a Gale Dash. Gale Dashes carry you further than regular dashes and have extended iframes, but will clear immediately should you initiate an attack.

All Above, Gods Below.additional_info: Only applies to "active" healing. The duration of this effect will be reduced if you do not meet the Talent's requirements. This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent.
All Above, Gods Below.desc: Any healing your opponent were to receive while All The Dead Gods is active on them is stolen and given to you, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 15% as well.

All Knowing.desc: Your prediction now ignores the range requirement to reflect attacks.

All the Dead Gods.additional_info: Whenever you land a Basic Attack, the target has most healing forms reduced/disabled for 8 seconds. Your anti-heal potency scales on your Willpower + Intelligence investment, only having 100% anti-heal if your Intelligence and Willpower attributes add up to at least 105.
All the Dead Gods.desc: Your Basic Attacks now apply anti-heal and 5% Heal Boost against PvE for 8s.

All-Seeing Eye.additional_info: Invisible players, including yourself, and monsters are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position.
All-Seeing Eye.desc: The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted.

Alloy Siphon.desc: Iron Pull siphons armor from your foes, restoring your posture.

Alloy of the Heavens.additional_info: Reduces posture damage taken from mobs by 50%.
Alloy of the Heavens.desc: Posture attack from mobs reduced by 50%

Alloyblood.additional_info: The effects of Alloyblood scale linearly with Ironsing investment, losing 0.3% bleed damage reduction and 0.75% blood loss damage reduction for every point in Ironsing below 100. Blood loss reduction is less effective if you are using the Curse of the No Life King Enchantment and stacks multiplicatively with Cauterized Wounds. The blood loss reduction does not affect blood drain effects like casting or being hit by Bloodrend Mantras, blood drain potions, and the blood loss Corrupt Resonance downside.
Alloyblood.desc: You don't bleed like others do. Bleed damage reduced by 30%. Blood loss is reduced by 75%.

Alloyed Soles.desc: Reduces the duration of Knockdown applied to you.

Already Dead.additional_info: Removes the self damage from Deepspindle's running critical. Reduces the self damage from Shade Devour, Flame Within (on cast, NOT the burn ticks), Rush Hour, Shadow Travel, Electrify, and 'Poison' Corrupt Resonance downside. Reduces the self Wither gain from Symbiotic Link and the 'Wither' Corrupt Resonance downside.
Already Dead.desc: You take reduced damage from abilities with a health cost.

Ambush.desc: When coming out of Tacet, gain a 30% damage boost for 5 seconds.

Amp Overdrive.additional_info: Deals 15 Thundercall damage. The Electrify status effect changes your opponent's damage type to Thundercall and gives you 10% damage reduction to their attacks.
Amp Overdrive.desc: Guardbreaking an opponent causes them to take extra thunder damage and applies Electrify for 7 seconds.

Amplified Rage.additional_info: Increases Amped's damage buff from 10% to 20%.
Amplified Rage.desc: Amped now grants you an additional +10% weapon damage. Also self-damage and cooldown by 3x.

Amplified Reflexes.additional_info: Increases the self damage from casting Electrify from 5% of your current health to 15% of your current health. Increases Electrify's cooldown to 2 minutes. While Amped, your walk speed will be increased by 50% and your climb height will be increased by 15%.
Amplified Reflexes.desc: Amped now grants enhanced speed and parkour, but triples the self-damage on use and doubles its cooldown.

An Ironsinger's Instinct.additional_info: Grants 60% damage reduction for 2 seconds. Ends early if you take damage. 18 second cooldown.
An Ironsinger's Instinct.desc: Successfully dodging an attack coats you in metal and reduces the damage of the next attack taken.

Analyze.desc: Marking enemies with your Callout analyzes them, making them take 20% more damage from all sources for 10 seconds.

Anchor Shock.additional_info: This puts your opponent's mobility slot Mantras on a 3 second cooldown whenever Blightshock is applied from a Blightsurger Mantra.
Anchor Shock.desc: Your Blightshock prevents targets from using mobility mantras.

Ancient Metalwork.additional_info: Landing your weapon critical puts your opponent's Resonance on a 25 second cooldown.
Ancient Metalwork.desc: Your critical hit can channel the effects of your Ironsing Rods and disrupt the resonances of others, disabling them for 25 seconds.

Angel's Guise.additional_info: Grants immunity to the Watcher's Watcher Gaze attack, preventing Sanity loss, vision distortion, and the spawning of Hollow Angel(s). Additionally grants unique dialogue with the Watchers.
Angel's Guise.desc: You resemble one of the Sworn Angels.

Ankle Cutter.additional_info: Deals 37.5 Oath damage. If in Flow State, this is increased to 52.5 and the windup is reduced. Has innate bleed. 6 second cooldown.
Ankle Cutter.desc: You can now do a special ground slash while sliding, applying a temporary speed debuff to those hit, as well as preventing jumping.

Another Man's Trash.additional_info: If the player you are mugging doesn't have any Notes, you will still take any unequipped equipment. You cannot steal Soulbound or Enchanted items. Gain +0.001% damage for every 1 Weight you're carrying. Every 100 Weight = +1% damage.
Another Man's Trash.desc: Take unequipped equipment when mugging a player. Gain a little more damage against PvE the more you are currently carrying.

Antithetic Salts.additional_info: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. When applied to your potions, it inverts the effects of the ingredients in the potion.
Antithetic Salts.desc: Alter your brews to invert their effects. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

Apothecary.additional_info: Additively increases potion Potency by 125%. Acts similarly to a potion ingredient, remaining active if you no longer have the Talent.
Apothecary.desc: Potions you prepare will have amplified positive effects when consumed, and amplified negative effects when thrown.

Apparitions.additional_info: Apparitions can only spawn from Haunted Gale being procced on Galebreathe Mantras or by proccing effects that would normally apply Suffocation.
Apparitions.desc: Your Haunted Phantoms become Apparitions that apply Winded on hit. Apparitions cannot be parried if you are in Phantom Step.

Approaching Singularity.additional_info: Gives 0.1% Mantra PEN per point in Intelligence.
Approaching Singularity.desc: You now gain +1% Mantra PEN for every 10 point of Intelligence.

Arc Module: Dash.additional_info: Jet dashes go much further than regular dashes. Also allows the user to M1 while performing a dash, ending their dash early.
Arc Module: Dash.desc: [In Arc Suit] Your dashes become Jet Dashes, allowing you to attack while dashing.

Arc Module: Eject.additional_info: Your posture will be set to 50% on activation.
Arc Module: Eject.desc: [In Arc Suit] When blockbroken, eject from your suit.

Arc Module: Enhance.additional_info: Arc Beam's base dmg is increased by 50%, Arc Wave's base damage is increased by 25%.
Arc Module: Enhance.desc: [In Arc Suit] Your Arcwarder Mantras deal increased damage.

Arc Module: Guard.additional_info: Prevents "backhit" Talents from proccing and grants 360 block against all attacks.
Arc Module: Guard.desc: [In Arc Suit] You can block attacks from any direction and cannot be backstabbed.

Arc Module: Leap.additional_info: 10 second CD outside of combat, 15 second CD in combat.
Arc Module: Leap.desc: [In Arc Suit] Holding Spacebar after double jumping propels you up for a short duration.

Arc Module: Null.desc: [In Arc Suit] Outgoing and incoming enchant effects are nullified. Can be toggled with N.

Ardour Scream.additional_info: Consumes 100% of your Ether on use. Ardour Scream requires you to have a minimum of 100% Ether to be casted. Having the Soul Infusion Talent will reduce this to a minimum of 40% Ether.  Combat tags opponents hit. Notably, its damage and posture damage buffs are applied on-hit to incoming attacks rather than being a debuff that increases damage/posture damage taken, meaning Ardour Scream is affected by the damage and posture damage modifier caps. Also has a 95-Stud range (245 if Soulbreaker),
Ardour Scream.desc: Amplify your shout into a scream using Ardour, dominating weaker foes, Victims take 12.5% more damage and 50% more posture damage for 10s.

Armor Conserver.additional_info: Does not affect Natural Armor from Exoskeleton and Chitin.
Armor Conserver.desc: You lose 15% less armor when hit.

Armor Piercing.additional_info: This has heavy diminishing returns in effectiveness with the more PEN you have. Elemental guns may not benefit from this Talent at all depending on your opponent's resistances, as the highest resistance value is prioritized.
Armor Piercing.desc: [Guns] Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied.

Armored Plating.desc: Put on extra plating on your armor, giving you 50 temp health whenever you are put in combat. Due to the weight of this additional plating, you have reduced speed at all times.

Aromatic Salts.additional_info: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. This changes your thrown potions to a lingering cloud that lasts for 10 seconds, applying the potion's effects on each hit.
Aromatic Salts.desc: Alter your brews to create lingering clouds of mist on shattering. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

Art of the Deal.additional_info: Reduces the purchase price of items by 10%.
Art of the Deal.desc: Your rapport with merchants gives you lower prices!

Artisan Chef.additional_info: Increases food nutritional value by 25%. Increases the healing gained from using Fondant Splitter's critical.
Artisan Chef.desc: The food you cook now becomes Artisan food, increasing its hunger and thirst gained by +25%.

Artisan's Blade.additional_info: Each Artisan Blade has 8 Base damage with 5 Ironsing scaling, gaining 0.04 damage per Ironsing investment. Artisan Rods deal 4.5 posture damage if blocked. Pulling rods normally also procs this Talent. "Metal infused attacks" refers to Ironsing legendary weapon attacks.
Artisan's Blade.desc: Activating Scrapsinger forges a metal blade behind you for every 2 rods you consume. Metal blades will fire at a target upon landing an ironsing or metal infused attack.

Ascended Phoenix Flames.desc: Once per fight, when an attack would down you immediately revive with 30% HP.

Ash Ember.additional_info: At 90 FLM 90 WPN you gain a 0.0175 burn damage increase per 1 point of wither. This has very slight Flamecharm and Weapon scaling.
Ash Ember.desc: The more wither your opponent has, the more damage your burn deals.
Ash Ember.reqs: 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY, 90s FLM

Assassin's Instincts.desc: Your air counters now deal 5% of your targets max health.

Assassin's Strike.additional_info: Doubles the base damage of Rapid Slashes.
Assassin's Strike.desc: Your Rapid Slashes now deals twice the amount of damage.

Audacity.additional_info: Applies true stun to nearby enemies when you start a manual execution on a humanoid target. 25 second cooldown. The buff duration will be reduced by 0.1 seconds for every point of Charisma and Strength you are below Audacity's requirements, capping at a minimum 35 second duration with 75 Charisma and 25 Strength.
Audacity.desc: Once you've brought down your prey, instill fear into all those who would separate you from claiming it. Charmed or nearby enemies will fear for longer. Nearby allies gain a 10% damage buff (40s).

Authority Ensign.desc: You are a member of the Authority deployed to the Eastern Luminant. You may find trouble with the local factions and must become stronger through advancing the Authority's position.

Authority Intimidation.desc: Lightning moves slow your opponent more.

Avaricious Blade.additional_info: Dealing damage by any means gives 1 Note, with backhits giving 50 Notes instead. This can proc on self damage.
Avaricious Blade.desc: Every strike landed lines your pockets.

Azure Flames.additional_info: Increases burn damage by 12.5%. Increases the radius and posture damage of Eruptions. Increases Flame of Denial's duration by 25%.
Azure Flames.desc: Many of your flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity.

Backstabber.additional_info: Has no range limit. Also procs on criticals with the M1 tag and Silentheart abilities. Applies daze and ragdolls.
Backstabber.desc: Landing a backhit with a light attack causes you to grab your opponent and stab them again, dealing an extra 15 damage. [15 second CD]

Bane.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that on use allows you to teleport to your opponent when you M1 for 20 seconds. The teleportation has a range limit of 25 studs. Additionally grants a speed boost for the full duration. 100 second cooldown.
Bane.desc: Activate to make your light attacks teleport to the closest enemy nearby.

Barber's Skillset.additional_info: Gives a Talent tool that opens an outdated version of the Barber UI. When selecting others: Changes what haircut your Fadetrimmer Mantras apply on hit. When selecting yourself: Changes your own hair.
Barber's Skillset.desc: What type of look are we going for today?

Barrage Mastery.additional_info: Increases the projectile count of Ether Barrage based on how many stacks of Ether Erudite you have.
Barrage Mastery.desc: For every Ether Erudite stack you have, gain one extra orb whenever you fire your Ether Barrage.

Battery Sapper.desc: If your Human Battery targets have Ether, it will drain their Ether to help pay for your Mantras. 10s cooldown.

Battle Frenzy.additional_info: This reduces the posture damage of incoming Mantras by 1 per hit, per combat tag you have. If you have more combat tags than the Mantra does posture damage, this can go into the negatives and your posture will be restored instead.
Battle Frenzy.desc: The grip on your weapon tightens, reduce the posture of all mantras you block with this effect scaling with the number of combat tags you have on your character.

Battle Tendency.additional_info: This only affects passive posture regeneration.
Battle Tendency.desc: You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen.

Battle-Hardened.desc: Reduce how much damage you take from mantra guardbreaks by 20%.

Bear Trap.additional_info: Affected targets cannot jump for 4 seconds. Targets gain 6 seconds of Bear Trap immunity.
Bear Trap.desc: Landing a hit with your critical against an opponent makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Also slows your opponent.

Beginner's Luck.desc: Slightly increase the amount of loot you find in chests.

Behind You.additional_info: This deals a separate instance of physical damage, scaling on your weapon's damage and your current Ether%.
Behind You.desc: Landing a basic attack behind your enemy after feinting a mantra will apply an ether slash, dealing extra damage based on how much ether you have left.

Beiruul's Vengeance.desc: Deal 5% more damage to factions that despise you. Serves them right.

Belief.additional_info: All of your Medium Weapon Mantras gain a second damage instance that scales directly on your Willpower investment and deals physical damage. This deals 0.15 damage per 1 Willpower investment, up to 15 damage at 100 Willpower or 15.45 at 103 Willpower. This has no cooldown.
Belief.desc: Your medium weapon mantras now deal extra damage based on how much Willpower you have.

Benefactor.additional_info: Grants faction reputation upon selling items to their respective Antiquarian.
Benefactor.desc: Gain reputation for selling goods to Antiquarians within faction territories.

Berserk.additional_info: While in the Berserk State, your M1s will gain increased PEN, scaling on how low your health is. This will cap at 50% if you do not have Million Ton Piercer. Additionally, your critical attacks gain +10% PEN. In exchange for this, all damage you take is true damage for the duration of the effect. In PvE, your M1s always gain +100% PEN, regardless of your health value. Lasts 20 seconds, halved to 10 seconds if you do not meet the Talent's Strength requirement. Berserk can be deactivated after 10 seconds by using the Talent tool again.
Berserk.desc: One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succumb to burning rage within and enter Berserk State.

Biotic Salts.additional_info: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. This halves the negative effects of your potion if used on allies (including yourself) and halves the positive effects of your potions if used on enemies.
Biotic Salts.desc: Alter your brews to not provide their positive effects to your enemies. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

Blackhole.additional_info: Pulls anyone nearby in a medium sized aoe to the closest opponent you hit with a shadow mantra.
Blackhole.desc: Your singularity pulls everyone nearby in.

Blade Dancer.desc: Landing a Basic Attack removes your roll cooldown.

Blade Scholar.desc: Landing your fist critical attack switches your stance to that fist style. Retain the same swing speed and damage your Markor's Inheritor had. You gain more swingspeed the more Intelligence you have.

Blade Threading.additional_info: The Metal Fakeout critical will only be used while you are in targeting range. Additionally, this attack has innate Bleed and counts as a weapon attack, not a Mantra.
Blade Threading.desc: Your Metal Greatsword now has Metal Fakeout as its critical attack. Landing Critical attacks applies metal rod and slow.

Blade's Edge.additional_info: The "tip of the spear" is the end of your weapon's range.
Blade's Edge.desc: [Spears] Damage dealt with the tip of the spear is increased by 10%

Blend In.additional_info: Most monsters in the Depths will be neutral you while you have this equipment on.
Blend In.desc: You resemble one of the Enforcers, become unnoticeable by regular depths mobs.

Blessing of the Moonseye.additional_info: Upon obtaining this Talent, you will lose all of your Sanity permanently. Defeating the three main progression bosses while having this Talent will unlock the Prince of the Moon Memento.
Blessing of the Moonseye.desc: The Moonseye is not one eye, but many. All of them watch you. All of them know of your sins.

Blight Pierce.additional_info: Blightshock now works similar to regular Shock, canceling hyperarmor.
Blight Pierce.desc: Your Blightshock attacks pierce through your enemies hyperarmor and gain more penetration.

Blighted Song.additional_info: Grants the user and the chained opponent 20% damage reduction against outside attacks.
Blighted Song.desc: Attaching your Shadow Chains to enemies disables yours and the enemy's ability to cast mantras. You take reduced damage from enemies while this is applied.

Blighted Touch.additional_info: This allows your Sovereign Bangle to apply Wither on hit.
Blighted Touch.desc: Landing Basic Attacks during Sovereign State now applies Blightshock.

Blightlash.additional_info: Increases the range of the Sovereign Bangle from 6 to 7.
Blightlash.desc: Your swing range is enhanced during Sovereign State.

Blind Spot.desc: [Land Critical Attack or Hidden Blade] Apply Blinded for 5 seconds.

Blinded.additional_info: Makes everything darker and creates fog at long distances. Grants immunity to the Flame Blind and Gaze Mantras.
Blinded.desc: Your vision is obscured by something. Somehow, you feel safer. You remember the warmth of your youth.

Blinkstep.additional_info: If you have 90% or more Ether, your regular dash will be replaced with a Blinkstep. This has much more distance than a regular dash. Consumes Ether on use.
Blinkstep.desc: Your regular dash is enhanced into a Blinkstep above 90% ether but now has an ether cost.

Blitz.additional_info: Decreases Prominence Draw's windup by 0.1s (from 0.55s to 0.45s).
Blitz.desc: Increase how quick you release your Prominence Draw.

Blood Bag.desc: You receive extra blood from knocking an enemy.

Blood Bank.additional_info: Grants 25 Temporary Health on proc. This Talent only procs via Donation Drive and Manipulator. Has an indirect 10 second cooldown due to it relying on Manipulator.
Blood Bank.desc: Consuming 'Charm' now gives slight temporary health.

Blood Convergence.desc: Receive 10% more healing from all healing sources when you have temp health.

Blood Drinker.additional_info: Restores 4% of the user's maximum health upon landing M1 attacks. The "bleed" is a unique damage over time status effect that is not bleed. This deals 6 damage per tick and ticks 5 times over 5 seconds. This can proc on Motif-given critical attacks. If you are knocked during the duration of this "bleed" effect, you will be instantly gripped.
Blood Drinker.desc: Recover health on hit. When landing a critical, deal 30 bleed damage over 5 seconds.

Blood Necrosis.additional_info: You will now need a scaled damage of 75 to hit the regular Bloodless Gem heal cap of 15.
Blood Necrosis.desc: Your bloodless gems heal 33% less than usual.

Blood Pact.desc: Gain 50 bonus temporary health whenever you knock/kill an enemy.

Blood Plague.additional_info: M1s apply stacks of Blood Plague. On critical, all Blood Plague stacks will be consumed to grant Temporary Health if your critical attack lands, with the amount of Temporary Health given scaling on the stacks of Blood Plague. The stacks of Blood Plague will be consumed regardless of if your critical attack lands, however.
Blood Plague.desc: For every light attack you land, add one Blood Plague stack on your opponent. Landing a Critical Attack converts all Blood Plague stacks into temporary health but missing the attack loses them.

Blood Siphon.desc: Your Critical Attack now siphons a bit of health, healing you 10% of the damage you dealt.

Blood Thirsty.desc: Gain a speed boost after causing an opponent heavy blood loss.

Blood Transfusion.desc: Successfully landing a critical attack while under a negative status effect will transfer the effect plus recover a small portion of your blood bar.

Blood and Iron.desc: Pulling rods out of your opponent now replenishes an equivalent amount of blood.

Bloodiron Spirit.additional_info: Restores 2.5% of your maximum armor upon executing an enemy.
Bloodiron Spirit.desc: You regain some Armor upon killing enemies.

Bloodless Overdrive.desc: Gain bonus temp health every time you land a mantra with a Bloodless Gem.

Bloodrend Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Bloodrend Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Bloodrend Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Bloodrend to its fullest.

Bloodrender.desc: Grants you the ability to command Blood as a Bloodrender. Your Bloodrend mantras replenish your blood, steal blood and apply 'Blood Poisoning'.

Bloodwarden's Sense.additional_info: Adds a red highlight to the player.
Bloodwarden's Sense.desc: Enemies you attack with a mantra above 60% Blood Poisoning are highlighted red briefly. Enemies who are highlighted red take 20% more blood poisoning.

Blossoming Darkness.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Blossoming Darkness.desc: The more Ether you drain during Shadow Roar, the bigger it gets.

Blunt Force Trauma.desc: All mantras that deal blunt damage gain 15% extra PEN. The mantras deal additional PEN if the opponent has more than 30% physical armor, scaling on how much more they have.

Bodkin Arrow.desc: Your charged shots now do extra armor damage to armored enemies and extra damage to unarmored enemies.

Boiling Point.additional_info: Deals 10 typeless damage. This cannot be parried nor blocked. Procs when you hit the Steam cloud with your Flamecharm Mantra, meaning your opponent can parry your Mantra and this will still proc.
Boiling Point.desc: Using a fire mantra near your own steam cloud detonates it.

Both Ends.additional_info: The followup attack has fast swing speed, and deals 135% of your weapon damage. Shares a 1 second cooldown with Counter Spin.
Both Ends.desc: [Staffs] Pressing M2 after landing a light attack with the staff performs a follow-up swing from the opposite end.

Bottom Freeze.additional_info: Prevents you from rotating your character and moving around overall. Taking damage from any source will end Bottom Freeze early.
Bottom Freeze.desc: Hitting chilled enemies with Ice Projectiles while they are on ice freezes them to the ground.

Braced Collapse.additional_info: After being block broken, reduce the next instance of damage by 20%. This has no cooldown.
Braced Collapse.desc: After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage.

Brain Death.additional_info: Applies a new stack of suffocation on proc.
Brain Death.desc: Enemies that are already suffocated will have their suffocation duration extended when hit by a bloodrend mantra.

Brain Rattler.desc: [Clubs] Guardbreaking an opponent with your Critical rattles their brain in its container, causing increased blood loss, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and blurs their vision.

Brassneck.additional_info: Works on non-humanoid monsters, applying the damage reduction after they die.
Brassneck.desc: Knocking an enemy grants you 20% damage resistance for 15 seconds.

Brazen Blow.additional_info: Only procs on weapon attacks. Does not proc on uppercut. 20 second cooldown.
Brazen Blow.desc: [Greataxes] Attacking an enemy slowed by your Greataxe grants you temporary hyperarmor.

Breakthrough.additional_info: Increases the posture damage of M1s by 10%.
Breakthrough.desc: Posture damage on light attacks are increased by 10%.

Breakthrough Drive.desc: Knocking a player refreshes your Glorious Charge cooldown and extends both effects it has by 5 seconds. [90 second CD]

Breathing Exercise.additional_info: Your passive sanity regen is increased by 50%.
Breathing Exercise.desc: Your sanity recovers more quickly once out of terrifying situations.

Breathing Impact.additional_info: The increased damage dealt is based on the attack's initial damage and your opponent's acceleration.
Breathing Impact.desc: When knocked into objects by wind mantras enemies take additional blunt damage based off of how hard they are hit.

Breeze.additional_info: Increases your studs/s movement speed by +2 permanently. This is not counted as a speed buff.
Breeze.desc: Gain a permanent +2 speed at all times.

Brick Wall.additional_info: Grants full immunity to ragdoll. The knockdown duration reduction scales on your combined Fortitude and Willpower investment, being fully negated if you have 100 points invested into each attribute.
Brick Wall.desc: You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely Unconscious. Also reduces the duration of Knockdown.

Broken Ankles.additional_info: Broken Ankles' duration will be reduced by 0.15 seconds for every point in Strength below 70, capping at 8.25 seconds with 45 Strength. 30 second cooldown.
Broken Ankles.desc: Blockbreaking an opponent puts their Mobility slot Mantras on CD for 12s.

Broodlord's Scream.additional_info: Applies 100% Anti-Heal. These abilities will also gain the Broodlord Scream sound effect.
Broodlord's Scream.desc: Using Sing, Taunt, or Ardour Scream applies anti heal for the duration of the move.

Bruiser's Mixup.desc: Switching your Fist Style mid-fight makes your basic Fist attacks inflict bleed temporarily.

Brunt.additional_info: Reduce posture damage taken by 10% while 2 handing a weapon.
Brunt.desc: While 2-handing, you take less posture damage.

Brutal Momentum.desc: [Heavy Weapons] Successfully dodging will give you hyperarmour on your next swing.

Brute Strength.additional_info: Deals 35 Blunt damage with 20 Posture damage. This cannot be buffed through damage modifiers. Increases your Vent's windup from 0.25s to 0.5s.
Brute Strength.desc: Your vent is replaced with a ground slam attack that knocks back enemies.

Bulldozer.desc: Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact.

Bulletproof.additional_info: This has no effect on your natural armor or incoming PEN.
Bulletproof.desc: You take no Armor damage from guns. You take 5% less Armor damage from other sources.

Bulwark Breaker.additional_info: Increases the AoE and range of your Pressure Blast. The final hit of your Pressure Blast deals 3x the posture damage (from 12 to 36), increasing the total posture damage of the Mantra from 36 to 60.
Bulwark Breaker.desc: Increase the size of your Pressure Blast, with the last hit of it dealing increased posture damage.

Burning Puppets.additional_info: Grants your Puppets 5 Flameharm scaling, increasing their damage by 0.1 per Flamecharm investment. Your Puppets now apply 'Puppet Burn', allowing you to create more Puppets. Despite what the Talent description states, your Puppets don't proc any Flamecharm Talents.
Burning Puppets.desc: Your puppets can now inflict burn and fire-based Talents when they explode.

Burning Sacrifice.additional_info: Puppets will turn purple if they've gone 15 seconds without hitting anything. You can sacrifice these purple Puppets with this Talent tool, granting a 4% damage buff per Puppet sacrificed (caps at 12%) and a small speed boost for 6 seconds. Additionally this grants 1 Emperor Flame stack per Puppet sacrificed. This has a 15 second cooldown if a Puppet is successfully sacrificed, and a 1 second cooldown if not.
Burning Sacrifice.desc: Sacrifice puppets who have been alive for half of their lifetime and burn purple for Emperor Flame Stacks, a damage boost per puppet, and a slight speed boost.

Burnout.desc: Igniting enemies reduces their damage by 4% per Black Blood stack, up to a maximum of 12%.

Buster Call.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that lights a flare and highlights a large AoE on the ground. After a considerable delay, that location will be bombed several times, dealing very high damage. Cannot directly knock players. Applies burn on hit. 24 hour cooldown.
Buster Call.desc: Radio in the Authority's navy for a buster call, sending out a barrage of bombardment wherever you see fit.

Calamity Punch.desc: Every successful Strong Left builds up stacks to perform a larger scale punch.

Call of the Deep.additional_info: When used in the overworld, play an animation and sink into the first layer. This does not count as a drown. When used in the Depths, teleport to Castle Light with a 20 minute cooldown.
Call of the Deep.desc: Sink beneath the waves and return to the Depths

Callout.desc: You can mark objects or enemies by pressing Z, which will mark them for all nearby allies.

Camaraderie.desc: Landing a critical attack reduce your allies' mantra cooldowns by 5 seconds and heals them 1%. [1 sec CD]

Cap Artist.additional_info: This can be deactivated by using the keybind again.
Cap Artist.desc: Pressing [,] while crouching allows you to fake being dead. You also take a bit less damage from PvE while ragdolled as well.

Captain Etrea.desc: Fists Moving while blocking with a shield no longer slows you down.

Captain's Call.additional_info: On use, this summons two allied Blacksteel Pirates to assist you. 5 minute cooldown.
Captain's Call.desc: Call up two Blacksteel Pirates to aid you in battle.

Careful Handling.desc: Reduce your chances of dropping ingredients on death.

Careful Stance.desc: Gain a bit more autoparry frames on successful parries.

Carnivore.additional_info: Cannot be obtained if you have the Vegetarian Flaw.
Carnivore.desc: In return for losing the ability to eat vegetation, satiate your hunger by gripping monsters and people alike.

Catalytic Strike.desc: Posture breaking an enemy will Overload their Surge stack.

Cauterized Wounds.additional_info: Does not reduce the blood damage of 'blood drain' effects, such as casting or being hit by Bloodrend Mantras, blood drain potions, and the blood loss Corrupt Resonance downside. Stacks multiplicatively with Alloyblood. The effectiveness of this Talent is reduced if you are using the Curse of the No Life King enchantment.
Cauterized Wounds.desc: Blood loss from all sources is lowered.

Celebrity.desc: Your natural skill in mediating conflict makes people think more highly of you. Your base reputation with factions is higher and your reputation caps out higher.

Centurion's Resolve.desc: Your Legion Kata/Imperium Kata attacks deal 4% more damage.

Chain Reaction.additional_info: Procs when a thrown potion replaces a different potion's effect, increasing your potion's effect by 40% multiplicatively.
Chain Reaction.desc: When applying a potion effect to someone who already has one, the new effect is amplified. You have a 25% chance not to deplete potions when drinking them.

Chain of Perfection.additional_info: Gain a 5% damage buff against PVE enemies per stack of Perfection above 5, capping at +100% damage at 25 stacks. This is treated as a final damage multiplier and it bypasses the damage modifier cap. All stacks of Perfection are lost upon taking any damage, excluding self damage.
Chain of Perfection.desc: You gain stacks of Perfection on hitting mobs with Weapon Attacks or Mantras. Mantras are only worth half a stack.

Chainlash.additional_info: Right clicking after a flourish will enchain your target and pull them towards you. M1ing after the pull will perform a Crushing Kick, dealing high damage.
Chainlash.desc: On flourish, gain the ability to summon a chain on an enemy for 5 seconds by right clicking. This lets you whip your chain to seize and yank enemies towards you, setting them up for a crushing kick.

Champion's Regalia.desc: Flourishing an opponent grants you +50% posture damage on Basic Attacks for 10 seconds.

Champion's Shield.desc: Deal an extra 25% more posture. Deal even more posture the more posture you have.

Chaotic Charm.additional_info: Applies Chaotic Charm for 15 seconds, granting an additional source of damage reduction. Chaotic Charm gains 0.15% damage reduction for every point in Charisma you have.
Chaotic Charm.desc: Charm enemies nearby when attacked at low health. Enemies affected by this charm have their damage increased to anyone but you, and deal reduced damage towards you.

Charged Return.additional_info: Procs on Burn, Chill, Shock, Fear, Winded, and Suffocation.
Charged Return.desc: Being under an elemental status effect causes your Basic Attacks and Criticals to do 10% more damage.

Charisma Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Charisma Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Charisma on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Charisma Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your charisma to its fullest.

Charismatic Cast.desc: Landing a hit with a mantra on an enemy applies Charmed. Allies recover from being knocked twice as quickly when Charmed by you.

Cheap Shot.additional_info: Multiplies your PEN by 1.1x at 65+ Agility. Cheap Shot's PEN multiplier will be reduced by 0.11% for every point in Agility below 65, having a minimum multiplier of +7.22% PEN (or 1.072x PEN) at 40 Agility.
Cheap Shot.desc: Your attacks gain 10% PEN multiplicatively when you have an active speed boost.

Cheap Trick.additional_info: Being hit while under half HP grants I-frames and turns you invisible for a very short duration. 60s CD. Knocking an opponent turns you invisible for 2.5 seconds with no I-frames.
Cheap Trick.desc: When hit below half health briefly disappear, leaving behind an illusion clone to keep your enemy occupied for a short duration. Briefly disappear after knocking an enemy.

Chemistry Kit.desc: You no longer drop potions on death. You have a 25% chance to brew an extra potion.

Chief's Will.additional_info: Gives M1 attacks and criticals with the M1 tag +10% PEN if you are using the Way of Navae fist style.
Chief's Will.desc: Way of Navae light attacks have 10% additional penetration.

Chilling Flourish.additional_info: Leaves 3-4 ice patches on the ground.
Chilling Flourish.desc: When flourishing an enemy, they leave behind a trail of ice in the direction you send them.

Chitin.additional_info: Grants 5% physical damage reduction in the form of Natural Armor. This stacks multiplicatively with Exoskeleton. Increases Exoskeleton's durability by 200.
Chitin.desc: You have a layer of Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest

Chorus of Souls.additional_info: Grants heavily increased health regeneration if you have all Wisps active. This Talent will not activate unless you have every Attunement's Wisp Mantra equipped and active. If one of your Wisps runs out, this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp. This Talent will not work if you no longer have the Oathless Oath.
Chorus of Souls.desc: Alone, the Wisps lack a voice. But surrounded by so many, the frequencies overlap and you hear it true.
Chorus of Souls.reqs: 30s BLD, 30s SDW, 30s MTL, 30s WND, 30s LTN, 30s FLM, 30s ICE

Christmas Miracle.desc: Christmas Mod Shop reward. Regens hunger and thirst. "Thank you so much K1!" Heh, no problem guys. All in a day's work.

Chronostasis.additional_info: On hit, apply a 13 second Resonance cooldown. This cannot proc if their Resonance is already on cooldown.
Chronostasis.desc: Landing a Basic Attack or Critical puts the target's Resonance on cooldown for a short duration, while also applying Ether Sunder to PvE opponents.

Circuit Breaker.additional_info: Using this with the Deepscorn Casque will cause you to heal upon using Electrify.
Circuit Breaker.desc: Electrify no longer deals self-damage on use.

Closed Circuit.additional_info: Adds 5 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling to the Overload, gaining 0.025 damage per Thundercall damage. This is a flat value that does not depend on Rod count.
Closed Circuit.desc: Surge Overloads that fail to arc to other opponents will deal additional damage to the Overloaded enemy.

Clutch.desc: For every combat tag you acquire, gain 4% more posture resistance.

Clutch Recovery.additional_info: If you are at or below 30% of your maximum health, heal 1% of your maximum health upon landing any weapon attack.
Clutch Recovery.desc: When at 30% health or below, every time you land a light attack or critical hit heal 1%.

Cold Blooded.additional_info: Applies 12.5% blood poisoning over the duration of the chill or 25% blood poisoning on crystal explosion. Only crystal explosions applied through maximizing crystal stacks will proc this Talent.
Cold Blooded.desc: Chilled enemies passively build up blood poison, alternatively when crystals explode it'll apply blood poison. (DOES NOT STACK)

Cold Front.additional_info: Venting creates an ice patch on the floor and applies Chill to any enemy hit by it. Increases your Vent damage by 40% and changes its damage type to Frostdraw.
Cold Front.desc: Your vent is imbued with glacial frost.

Coldseep Reactor.additional_info: You can no longer gain parasites while in the Second Layer.
Coldseep Reactor.desc: By cultivating the localized chemosynthetic microorganisms within the Depths and utilizing them as a power source, your helm thrums with a protective field of static electricity and heat.

Collapsed Lung.additional_info: This effect lasts 8 seconds and loses 0.04s for every investment point below 100 Strength. The Collapsed status effect reduces the posture damage affected enemies deal to you by 40%.
Collapsed Lung.desc: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.

Comeback Kid.desc: When waking up from being knocked you are unable to be knocked down for 5 seconds. (120 second cooldown)

Command Phoenix.additional_info: Summoning an adult Phoenix, then commanding it to take air will allow you to select a spot where it should Divebomb on the next usage of the Talent.
Command Phoenix.desc: Command your Phoenix to scout, and dive into enemies.

Command: Live.additional_info: Fully heals your Servant if they are below 40% health. The cooldown of this Command scales on your Charisma investment.
Command: Live.desc: Once per hour, command a servant to defy all odds and obey your command - live.

Command: Summon.additional_info: Teleports the subject to the master regardless of distance. Teleportation takes 10 seconds to complete, and any hit will cancel it. 30 second cooldown for the Master, 2 minute cooldown for the Servant.
Command: Summon.desc: Command your servant to obey your summons and appear before you no matter the distance.

Compelling Offer.additional_info: Madness from this Talent procs when attacking charmed enemies who are below 50% health. Using Taunt as a counter displays Prediction's visual effects but with a dark purple color. This also plays a laughing sound effect and reduces Taunt's cooldown to 1 second. Taunt counter does not deal damage, but instead stacks Taunt's damage buff effect.
Compelling Offer.desc: Any charmed enemy below 50% hit with your mantras or critical will mysteriously begin attacking everyone but you. [Madness] Your taunt also now functions as a counter that stacks damage multipliers with every successful taunt.

Concussion.desc: Enemies you flourish into walls have their vision altered for a short duration and are dazed longer than usual. Flourished PvE enemies get Stagger for a few seconds.

Concussive Flash.additional_info: People blinded by Flame Blind are Dazed for 2 seconds.
Concussive Flash.desc: Your blinding light now concusses foes.

Concussive Force.additional_info: Enemies remain knocked for 15 seconds instead of 10.
Concussive Force.desc: Enemies you knocked remain downed longer than usual.

Concussive Strike.desc: Anytime you ragdoll your opponent, disable your opponents ability to cancel that ragdol for half a second. Deal 5 extra blunt damage when this occurs.

Condensation Drip.additional_info: Reduces the passive thirst drain by 3x.
Condensation Drip.desc: Passively collect condensation from the air, greatly reducing your thirst.

Conditioned Runner.additional_info: This effect only applies while sprinting.
Conditioned Runner.desc: You take 5-15% less damage. The damage reduction amount scales with your agility stat and how long you have been running for.

Conditioned Swimmer.desc: You lose less hunger and thirst while swimming.

Conditioning.desc: Reduce all slows you receive by 40%.

Conductor's Cable.additional_info: Creating a Conductor Rod drains 10% of your opponent's maximum armor.
Conductor's Cable.desc: Applying Conductor rods on opponents steals some of their armor to you.

Conquer your Fears.additional_info: Recover Sanity when killing monsters in the Depths, with the Sanity restored depending on how strong the monster is. Gain Sanity whenever a nearby ally executes a humanoid target.
Conquer your Fears.desc: Killing the beings of the deep replenishes your sanity somewhat. When an Ally grips an enemy nearby to you, you regain Sanity.

Continuous Bleed.desc: Every time you land a crit, flourish, or uppercut, increase the amount of bleed damage you deal for 15 seconds. This is stackable.

Controlled Combustion.additional_info: Your Agitating Spark cannot spread to you either.
Controlled Combustion.desc: Your Agitating Spark no longer spreads to your allies.

Cook's Kit.additional_info: You can light Campfires without a Flint.
Cook's Kit.desc: Each food item's max quantity is increased by 5. Your kit comes with a lighter.
Cook's Kit.reqs: 5r INT OR 5r WLL OR 5r CHA, 5s FTD

Cool Head.desc: If set on fire while on ice, immediately put it out and gain the Cool Head status for 30s. During Cool Head, you cannot be lit on fire. 15s cooldown

Cornered Fool.additional_info: Despite what the description states, this applies Taunt for 6 seconds. Every point of Charisma below 85 will reduce the duration of this Taunt by 0.035 seconds, capping at a minimum of 5.12 seconds with 60 Charisma. The Taunt damage buff is also applied to the attack that guard broke. 15 second cooldown.
Cornered Fool.desc: Blockbreaking a Charmed opponent procs Taunt for 5s, making them take and deal more damage.

Corporeal Dissolution.additional_info: Caps at 30 Wither damage per proc.
Corporeal Dissolution.desc: Applies Wither on any weapon attack that drains Ether, and scales on the amount of Ether drain.

Corpse Explosion.additional_info: Burn grip unconscious targets, even yourself, in 3.5 seconds instead of 7. The explosion does not work.
Corpse Explosion.desc: Your flames will incinerate unconscious Targets much faster and bodies that you burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage

Corrosive Touch.additional_info: On proc, drain 5% of your opponent's armor. This has a 10 second cooldown.
Corrosive Touch.desc: Landing a successful Critical Attack or Flourish will corrode a portion of your opponent's Armor.

Cosmic Connection.additional_info: Increases Astral's damage buff in PvE from +20% to +25%.
Cosmic Connection.desc: All celestial and astral related abilities are buffed.

Counter Spin.additional_info: On proc, swiftly thrust your Staff forwards, dealing 45% of your weapon's damage on hit.
Counter Spin.desc: [Staffs] After blocking an attack, press M2 to counter with your staff.

Crimson Fountain.desc: Blockbreaking or flourishing an enemy now spills a pool of blood below them. Blood mantras cast within blood pools have a reduced blood cost.

Crippling Comeuppance.additional_info: 30 second cooldown. For every point of Agility below 100, Crippling Comeuppance's duration is reduced by 0.1 seconds, having a minimum duration of 12.5 seconds at 75 Agility.
Crippling Comeuppance.desc: Landing Revenge puts your opponent's Mobility slot Mantras on CD and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for 15s.

Crippling Darkness.additional_info: Grants +20% PEN to any non-weapon attack. This not only affects Mantras, but things like Bleed or Burn too.

Crippling Impact.additional_info: The duration of this effect scales on your Strength investment, being 2 seconds + 0.015 seconds per point of Strength. This lasts for 3.5 seconds at 100 Strength.
Crippling Impact.desc: Landing a critical with someone while Wrath Gem is active disables their vent for a few seconds.

Critical Engine.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that applies the effects of your held Deep Gem to your weapon critical. This does not consume the Deep Gem on use. Blue Gems have a unique interaction with this Talent, granting Ether back based on scaled damage dealt.
Critical Engine.desc: You gain the ability to use Deep Gems on your critical attack. Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to apply to your crit then use the tool to enhance your critical.
Critical Engine.reqs: 30r LHT OR 30r MED OR 30r HVY, 90s INT

Critical Heal.desc: Every time you heal, you have a chance to proc a Critical Heal, healing you 30 health. [5 second CD]

Critical Mass.desc: Landing a Critical Attack on an enemy with Black Blood ignites them with pink fire.

Crossguard.additional_info: This is additive to weapon chip damage.
Crossguard.desc: If you are using a sword, you gain 10% chip against other opponents wielding swords.

Cruel Counter.additional_info: If you interrupt someone's attack with the shock from your Krulian Charge critical, apply the Cruel Counter status effect to your opponent, increasing all damage taken by critical attacks for 20 seconds. This grants a 40% damage buff to all critical attacks (including those that aren't Krulian Knife's), bypassing the damage modifier caps.
Cruel Counter.desc: When using your initial charge up on your Krulian Knife, if you interrupt someone's attack with it apply Cruel Counter on them, massively increasing the damage they take from your critical attacks.

Cruentare.additional_info: You heal for 25% of the damage your Whirling blades deals.
Cruentare.desc: Increase the amount of all bleed damage you deal by 50%. Your Whirling Blade now now heals you when landing it.

Cryonis.additional_info: Reduces the Ether cost of Frostdraw Mantras by 40% when standing on ice.
Cryonis.desc: All ice spells casted on top of ice cost less Ether.

Crystal Shrapnel.additional_info: Does not hit allies or the target you procced the Crystal explosion on. Scales off Frostdraw investment and amount of crystals present.
Crystal Shrapnel.desc: Your crystal explosions now have an AoE that applies crystals to all hit.

Cult of Personality.additional_info: The PEN gain per target will be reduced if you do not meet Cult of Personality's Charisma requirement.
Cult of Personality.desc: You gain +3% PEN for each person Charmed, capping at +15% PEN.

Cursed Immortality.additional_info: Instead of being knocked, your health will be set to 75% of its maximum instead, with a 5 minute cooldown. Once this Talent procs, all future Depths trials will automatically be corrupted for the rest of your character's life. This Talent does not proc during the Zi'eer boss fight.
Cursed Immortality.desc: Instead of getting knocked, get set to 75% health. When this effect occurs, this guarantees that you depths trial will become corrupted for the rest of your character's run.

Curved Edge.desc: Your light weapon mantras now gain 30% more chip.

Cut to the Chase.additional_info: Adds 10 True damage to your Air Counter. The damage bonus will be lessened if you do not meet the Talent's requirements.
Cut to the Chase.desc: Air Counter damage scaling is largely increased. Landing an Air Counter now initiates an uppercut. Deal 5% more damage to PvE enemies in the air.

Cutting Pace.additional_info: Buffed attacks deal 15% more damage, have a slightly shorter windup, and are purple.
Cutting Pace.desc: Dodging attacks will now grant 'Cutting Pace' stacks. Mantras and basic attacks consume a stack to shorten wind-up and increase damage, procs after dash.

Cyclical Exsanguination.desc: Whenever you deal more than 20 damage to an enemy in an instance, pause your temporary health decay for 3 seconds.

Cyclone Blade.additional_info: Lasts for 3 seconds with no cooldown. Phantom Step dashes will also proc this effect. Despite stating "Light Attack", this Talent also procs on weapon criticals.
Cyclone Blade.desc: After a successful Gale Dash you wrap your weapon in wind, causing your next Light attack to do +30% damage as bleed and have +10% chip damage.

Dancer's Beat.additional_info: Your Vent can no longer be used defensively, unless it is used to escape an otherwise inescapable move, but does not cost Tempo to use. You need to have at least 20 Tempo to use Dancer's Beat. Your next M1 used within 1 second of using Dancer's Beat will deal higher damage, more stun, and have a higher swing speed. If you are hit before you use your next attack, wait out the 1 second proc window, or if your next attack does not land (including if it was blocked, parried, or dodged), you will lose 60 Tempo and will be stunned for 0.5 seconds. 2.5 second cooldown.
Dancer's Beat.desc: Your Vent is replaced with Dancer's Beat. You increase the speed, damage, and stun of your next Basic Attack. However, should your attack fail to land, you'll be stunned and your Tempo will be greatly reduced.

Dancer's Geas.additional_info: Also procs on weapon criticals. When you land an attack from the tip of your weapon, an icon of a pair of hands clapping will appear, signifying that you've activated the buff. When you land an attack from half or less than half of your weapon's range, an icon of a thumbs down will appear, signifying that you were debuffed.
Dancer's Geas.desc: You deal +30% damage when striking with the tip of your weapon, but deal 15% less damage when striking below half of its range.

Dancer's Impale.desc: Hitting an enemy after a perfect dodge makes your next attack deal 30% bleed damage. If that attack would already bleed, it adds +10% chip damage instead.

Dancer's Sting.desc: Striking with the tip of your weapon applies +25% PEN and +25% Chip Damage.

Dancing Guard.additional_info: Dancing Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.086s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 4.86s at 30 Fortitude.
Dancing Guard.desc: Parrying an opponent and then parrying another enemy in quick succession applies slow for 7s.

Dancing Steps.additional_info: Casting a Flamecharm Mantra will give you a moderate boost of horizontal movement in the direction your character is facing. This will still proc even if the Mantra is feinted. 5 second cooldown.
Dancing Steps.desc: Fire mantras now move you in the direction you're facing.

Dancing Steps Of War.desc: When landing a flourish, gain a speed boost and massively reduce the cooldown of your dodges for 2 seconds.

Dark God.desc: If a Shadowcast mantra would drain your opponent's Ether to 0, drain from their Tempo instead and increase your Tempo.

Dark Harvest.desc: Steal all of the hunger of enemies caught in your Shadow Vortex. Knocking a player also greatly enhances your next Shadow Vortex.

Dark Hours.additional_info: Night cycle is XX:50 to XX:10 in real-time.
Dark Hours.desc: Your Shadowcast Mantras deal 15% more damage at night and in realms the Sun does not reach.

Dark Receiver.desc: Shadow moves will also steal Ether from those you are Static Linked tethered to.

Dark Replenishment.desc: Knocking out an enemy in combat restores a portion of your ether.

Dark Rift.additional_info: Lasts 1.8 seconds with a 20 second cooldown that starts on proc. Blocking, parrying, dodging, or sliding will also cancel the effect. You cannot use Mantras during Dark Rift.
Dark Rift.desc: Enter a rifted state when you successfully dodge, where you can't be damaged until its duration ends. Can be cancelled with feinting or attacking.

Dark Synergy.desc: Engulf your enemy in shadows when flourishing them.

Dark Waltz.desc: Anytime you guardbreak your opponent with a light attack or critical, steal half of your opponent's current tempo. Also apply Ether Sunder to PvE enemies.
Dark Waltz.reqs: 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY, 90s SDW

Dazing Finisher.additional_info: The duration of this Daze scales on your Charisma investment.
Dazing Finisher.desc: Flourishing enemies that are charmed by you cause them to not be knocked back and dazed instead.

Deal Maker.additional_info: This is unaffected by Snake Oil.
Deal Maker.desc: Your rapport with merchants allows you to attach a flat fee of 20 notes to all your sales.

Death From Above.additional_info: Air dash canceling with your weapon equipped grants your Starnkindred Wings. Air dash canceling with your weapon equipped and your wings out performs a three hit slashing attack that deals 25 Oath/Slash damage per hit.
Death From Above.desc: Upon cancelling your Air Dash, reveal your wings and strike your enemy.

Decisive Blow.desc: Hitting an enemy with your Critical Attack immediately after they dodge (or any time against mobs) now procs Knife's Journey. Your Knife's Journey procs do 2x Armor damage.

Decisive Winds.additional_info: The Decisive Winds status effect grants a 25% speed boost as long as you are within 20 studs of the target who initiated this effect. This procs through block, parry, and dodge, but not on self damage. 30 second cooldown.
Decisive Winds.desc: When damage below 50% health, don an aura of Decisive Winds for 10s.

Deep Wound.desc: Assassinating a target applies anti-heal for 20s and gives you a speed boost for 6s. Assassination damage now scales with level against mobs.

Deepbound Contract.additional_info: You can always enter Castle Light, even if you've drowned. Your Depths trial will always be an Enforcer or harder.
Deepbound Contract.desc: You progress much faster in the Depths, and slower on the overworld. You can regain sanity at Castle Light, but will always face the strongest foes in your Trial.

Deepfolk.additional_info: Increases Sanity gain by 1.2x. Deep Shrine Knowledge cost is reduced by 1 (this cannot go below 1).
Deepfolk.desc: The secrets of the Deep are easier for you to unravel. Your mind is sturdier against its effects, as well as using less Knowledge in Knowledge exchanges.

Defensive Reprisal.additional_info: Defensive Reprisal's duration will be reduced by 0.177s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 15.55s duration with 40 Fortitude.
Defensive Reprisal.desc: Being flourished grants you 10% posture resistance for 20s.

Defensive Stance.desc: [Rapier] Gain more parry frames the lower your health is.

Defensive Sweep.additional_info: This does not bypass the PEN cap. 14 second cooldown.
Defensive Sweep.desc: [Spears] Posture breaking an opponent grants you +50% PEN for 3 seconds.

Defiance.additional_info: The Effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement. Works on: Burn damage, the duration of Chill, Winded, Suffocation, time knocked, Ring of Pestilence, and Sightless Still, Crystal and Surge Rod gain, Blood Poisoning gain and Wither gain.
Defiance.desc: Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP.

Demon Step.additional_info: On use, lose 50 Ether to travel a short distance forwards in iframes. Additionally, 20% of your current posture will be dealt to you as self-posture damage.
Demon Step.desc: Activate to gain brief iframes while moving forward. This requires 50 ether to activate and increases your posture by 20% each use.

Denial Repulse.additional_info: When Flame of Denial activates, release an explosion around you. This deals 20 Flamecharm damage with 5 Flamecharm scaling, meaning it gains 0.1 damage per Flamecharm investment for a total damage of 30 at 100 Flamecharm. This cannot be parried nor dodged, but can be blocked, dealing 5 posture damage. Has a windup of 0.6s.
Denial Repulse.desc: You now emit a delayed burst of flames after coming close to death.

Depressive State.desc: Activating Rage Bait while your opponent has the enhanced charm from the Guilt Trip talent buffs your Rage Bait effect. Decrease your opponents damage multiplier hard cap from 50% to 5% while Rage Bait is active on them.

Depths Denizen.desc: The city you once called home is now your only way out of the depths, perhaps you can use this to your advantage. Gain extra leeway when attempting to escape the depths.

Destructive Recovery.desc: [Greatsword] Enemies recover 20% less Posture when parrying.

Destructive Yell.additional_info: Your Ardour Scream destroys all campfires within its range.
Destructive Yell.desc: Your Ardour Screams now break campfires around you, while increasing its range by 2x.

Devastating Power.additional_info: Gain 10 maximum Ether for every Mantra you have equipped.
Devastating Power.desc: Gain extra Ether for every Mantra in your arsenal.

Devastating Recovery.desc: Enemies recover 30% less posture when parrying your Zweihander light attacks.

Dirty Boxing.desc: Hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack after feinting applies bleed, obscures their vision slightly and makes PvE enemies Sluggish.

Disbelief.additional_info: Halves the duration of the Charmed status effect. Additionally halves the duration of Illusory Servants if they are casted on you.
Disbelief.desc: You're resistant to the effects of Illusion magic. You are resistant to charms and tricks.

Discharge.additional_info: Deals 5 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling, gaining 0.025 damage per point in Thundercall. Applies Shock or 1 Surge Rod on proc.
Discharge.desc: [Light Weapons] On 5th successful attack you will discharge static dealing lightning damage to those nearby.

Discovery of Fire.additional_info: Grants the Discovery of Fire Talent tool that consumes 20 Ether to cause a lightning strike after a 1 second delay. On hit, this deals 3 Thundercall damage and lights all nearby entities and campfires on fire.
Discovery of Fire.desc: Flints and Flamecharm are for simpletons.
