Dispatch.desc: [Clubs] Bear Trapped targets deal 20% less posture. Dazed targets deal 20% less posture. This can stack.

Diver's Resilience.additional_info: You can now parry certain NPC attacks that are normally unparryable. 10 second cooldown.
Diver's Resilience.desc: You can parry unparryable attacks from giant monsters, but due to the heft of the plate, you have slightly reduced speed.

Donation Drive.additional_info: Donation Drive's cooldown scales on your Charisma investment, having an 8 second cooldown at 60 Charisma and gaining 0.1s for every point in Charisma below 60. Donation Drive has a 8.5 second cooldown at 55 Charisma, and a maximum cooldown of 10.5 seconds at 35 Charisma.
Donation Drive.desc: Consuming 'Charm' on an opponent replenishes some blood. Additionally, you can also activate this effect and Manipulator through blockbreaking with a Bloodrend mantra.

Dormant Strength.additional_info: Increases your Strong Left's damage and posture damage if you are at max Calamity Punch stacks.
Dormant Strength.desc: At max Calamity Punch stacks increased posture damage & physical damage.

Double Jump.additional_info: Reduces Wind Step's cooldown to 5 seconds and lowers the Ether cost. You will need to equip Gale Boots to gain the Wind Step Talent.
Double Jump.desc: Take the Wind Step and refine it into your own technique, reducing the cooldown and improving its efficiency.

Down Comes the Claw.additional_info: Lasts 6.5 seconds despite what the description states. You cannot reapply this effect if it is currently active. For every point in Agility under 75, Down Comes the Claw loses 0.055 seconds of duration, capping at a minimum of 5.11 seconds with 50 Agility.
Down Comes the Claw.desc: Landing a Critical while you have a speed boost prevents your opponent from being able to dodge twice in a row for 5s.

Down to your Level.additional_info: Down to your Level's duration will be reduced by 0.05s for every point in Fortitude below 60, capping at a minimum of 3.75s with 35 Fortitude. The slow only procs on M1s or critical attacks with the M1 tag. Procs from Entanglement, Daze, Chill and most other things that slow you down.
Down to your Level.desc: While you have a speed debuff, your Basic Attacks slow your enemies for 5s.

Dragon's Song.additional_info: Grants +20 Ether on proc. 2 second cooldown.
Dragon's Song.desc: Using a mantra after an uppercut grants ether.

Dread Fighter.additional_info: Each stack of Dread Fighter grants 5% Mantra damage reduction, capping at 5 stacks for 25% Mantra damage reduction.
Dread Fighter.desc: Parrying and getting hit by mantras now give you stacks of Dread. Each stack lasts for 15 seconds.

Drift.additional_info: Your parry is replaced with a low distance dodge if you successfully parry an attack.
Drift.desc: You're no longer slow enough to have to rely on parries. Dodge instead.

Drifting Cloud.additional_info: Proccing Cutting Pace now unsheathes your Purple Cloud, giving it new animations and changing the damage type to Slash.
Drifting Cloud.desc: Cutting Pace now unsheathes the full potential of your Purple Cloud.

Driving Impact.additional_info: The first hit of your default spear critical will deal double the posture damage. The second hit of your default spear critical will not deal posture damage.
Driving Impact.desc: [Spears] The first hit of your Spear's Critical Attack will deal greatly increased posture damage. Subsequent hits will do reduced posture damage.

Drop Dead.desc: Take less damage when you are crouching.

Duelist's Lunge.additional_info: Running attacks with rapiers deal 35% more posture damage. After landing a Critical, the next rapier running attack gains 2 range.
Duelist's Lunge.desc: [Rapier] Running attacks deal increased posture damage. Upon landing your Critical, your next running attack will have increased range.

Dustlunge.desc: You can now assassinate your enemies from much farther, shadestepping to their location if they're too far. Assassinating an enemy will automatically assassinate other nearby enemies.

Ebb and Flow.desc: Landing a medium mantra increases your heavy mantra's level by 1 and vice versa. This is stackable and can increased to a max of +5 levels. All stacks are removed if your medium/heavy mantra is defended against.

Echoing Lunatic.desc: Your Ardour Scream now inflicts insanity.

Echolocator.additional_info: Pings the location of nearby players who unsheathe their weapons (even through Tacet and Lowstride) and event spawns.
Echolocator.desc: Your highly tuned hearing helps you navigate, seeing better in the dark and sensing potential threats.

Electrical Accumulation.additional_info: Passively gain 4 stacks of Static Blade if you have 4 or more orbs.
Electrical Accumulation.desc: While having 4 or more orbs, automatically gain 4 charges of Static Blade whilst you have 4 orbs.

Electrify.additional_info: If used while not being carried, this deals 5% of your current health as self damage on proc. Additionally, you will gain the Amped status effect for 15 seconds, increasing your weapon damage by 10% and allowing your weapon attacks to apply Shock on hit. However, incoming damage will be increased by 10%. 1 minute cooldown.
Electrify.desc: Shock yourself and apply Amped for 15s. Can be used while Carried to escape.

Electrolyte.additional_info: Applies a Surge Rod instead if you have Surge Path. Consumes 4 Temporary Health on proc.
Electrolyte.desc: Hitting Bloodrend mantras while having temporary health applies Shocked while removing a portion of temporary health.

Elegy of Light.additional_info: On use, Deep Gems cannot have their effects proc on you and your Deem Gems have increased effectiveness in PvE for 3 minutes. This ability requires you to kill a player of equal or higher level or a boss to recharge its effect.
Elegy of Light.desc: The Unspoken Vow of the Waking God resonates through you, if briefly. Protects you from the effects of Deep Gems for 3 minutes and provides you Gem Enhancement. Remains dormant until you take the life of an equal.

Elemental Mentalist.additional_info: When you Overcharm yourself, your light attacks apply the status effect of your highest invested Attunement for the duration of the Overcharm. While your allies are Overcharmed by you, their light attacks apply the status effect of their highest invested attunements. Procs on criticals with the M1 tag. Overcharm can be applied through the following Talents: Narcissist (self only), Rule Through Fear (self and allies), and Propagandist (allies only). This deals 0.1 elemental damage on proc as hitregistry for the status effects. This triggers your opponent's Everchanging Aegis.
Elemental Mentalist.desc: Empower your Overcharm, allowing you and your allies to bring forth your high stat attunement's elemental effect into your light attacks when overcharmed.

Embedded Nails.desc: When your Critical Attack gets dodged, embed nails onto their shoes for 8 seconds. This makes your opponent clumsy, ragdolling them if they use their second dodge.

Embolism.desc: If an enemy is guardbroken while you have temporary health, convert your temporary health into additional damage.

Emergency Mark.additional_info: Applying a Justicar's Mark on an ally who has 20% or less current health health them for 10% of their maximum health.
Emergency Mark.desc: Applying a mark on someone who has less than 20% health heals them for 10% of their health.

Emergency Rations.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool with 3 charges. Using the Talent tool consumes one of the charges to heal you for 20 flat health. This has a 15 second cooldown. Resting at a campfire, while not in combat, restores all charges
Emergency Rations.desc: Eat some of your emergency rations, healing you for 20 health. You can only use this 3 times before having to sit at a campfire outside of combat again.

Emergency Repairs.desc: Your repairs scale somewhat with the Max Health of the ship.

Emergency Reserves.desc: When you get hit below 20% health, gain 20% tempo immediately.

Emperor Flame.additional_info: Agitating Spark procs grant Emperor Flame stacks. At 5 stacks, gain the Emperor Flame status effect for 10 seconds, causing your next M1 to instantly proc Explosive Finish, dealing 15 Flamecharm damage. On top of this, this will deal an additional 25 Wither damage and apply burn. Emperor Flame also extinguishes self-applied burn through Agitating Spark. While Emperor Flame is on cooldown, the burn will not be extinguished and you cannot gain additional stacks. 30 second cooldown.
Emperor Flame.desc: Absorb fire produced by you, once you reach 5 stacks your next attack will be an automatic Explosive Finish flourish. This flourish will deal additional damage and proc Wither, reducing your opponent's maximum health temporarily.

Empowered Eruption.desc: Your next Eruption after landing a critical is Empowered with +50% range and damage. 10s cooldown.

Encore.additional_info: Applies 0.4s of true stun. Doesn't affect allies.
Encore.desc: Your Sing will stun opponents who are already charmed.

Endurance Runner.desc: Your speed is decreased less by low health.

Energy Siphon.additional_info: Takes 15 Ether from the affected opponent on proc.
Energy Siphon.desc: Your singularity now pulls ether from the extra players affected.

Enforcer's Pull.desc: Your Enforcer's Pull is improved. Land a flourish to make it even stronger.

Enforcer's Strength.desc: Your enemies recover 20% less posture on parry.

Enhanced Flow.additional_info: When you land basic attacks during Rush Hour, gain Temporary Health equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage. This cannot give more than 50 Temporary Health in a singular instance. Reduces Rush Hour's self damage by 22%, from 4.5 damage per tick to 3.5 damage per tick. Despite what the description states, this Talent still procs when hitting monsters or other non-player enemies.
Enhanced Flow.desc: Refine your Rush Hour, allowing you to now also gain temp health whenever you hit a player while using Rush Hour. You now also take less damage from Rush Hour.
Enhanced Flow.reqs: 90s BLD, 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY

Enrage.desc: Whenever you stun an opponent who's taunted with Encore, enrage them.

Entropy Link.additional_info: You are able to fast travel to certain places while resting at a campfire. Locations are unlocked by interacting with special meteorites that are scattered around the map. By sitting at a campfire and typing out the name of the desired meteorite, you will be transported directly to it.
Entropy Link.desc: The world is broken, linked by fragile webs. Traverse the path by stating your destination amidst the flame.

Erupting Shade.desc: The size of your shadow eruption increases with how much siphoned health you have gained from wiping players.

Eruption Path: Lava Serpent.additional_info: Eruptions have a base damage of 15 with 5 Flamecharm scaling. Eruptions have a 3s proc cooldown. You can still apply burn via Immolation, Flash Point, and Agitating Spark.
Eruption Path: Lava Serpent.desc: Your fire abilities no longer proc burn and instead proc an eruption under the enemies feet.

Ether Absorption.desc: Receive Ether back when inflicted with damage from Mantras.

Ether Adeptness.desc: Your mantras now deal extra chip.

Ether Amplification.desc: For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, increase the size and damage of your Pressure Blast.

Ether Blade.desc: Draw your foes ether into your weapon when you parry ether-based attacks. Gain Ether when you parry mantras.

Ether Blitz.desc: For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, reduce the windup of your enhanced Master's Flourish. This consumes your Ether Erudite stacks on use.

Ether Burst.additional_info: Consumes your Ether Erudite Stacks. Turns your Rapid Slashes light blue.
Ether Burst.desc: Landing Rapid Slashes on your opponent gives them an overflow of Ether, causing them to take bursts of damage based on how many Ether Erudite stacks you had.

Ether Efficiency.desc: All mantras you cast now have a reduced cost of 30 ether.

Ether Emergency.additional_info: On proc, restore health equal to 15% of your maximum Ether. 5 minute cooldown.
Ether Emergency.desc: When you get hit below 25% health, exhaust all of your ether to gain a flat health boost (healing scales of total max ether). You are briefly unable to cast Mantras.

Ether Erudite.desc: The more total Ether you have, the more damage you deal. Gain Ether Erudite Stacks to improve your combat abilities. The max amount you can hold is 6.

Ether Overdrive.desc: Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits.

Ether Pinpoint.desc: Mantras that have Might Gem on them now ignore fully ignore the posture bonus from shields.

Ether Proselyte.additional_info: Increases the level of all Attuned Mantras by 1 unless they are already level 5. This is not displayed on the Mantra's tooltip. Allows your non-Ironsing/Bloodrend Attuned Mantras to proc the Attunement Talents of your current Saint Stance. (E.g. Clutching Shadow in the Flamecharm Stance can proc Scorched Peak). Not all Attuned Talents are compatible with Ether Proselyte.
Ether Proselyte.desc: All of your Elemental Mantras below Lv. 5 are now 1 level higher. Your Mantras are now converted to the element of your current stance.

Ether Quell.desc: Landing a Critical Attack or Guardbreaking an opponent gives you 1 Ether Erudite Stack.

Ether Reflux.desc: Successfully countering an opponent with Prediction gives you 2 Ether Erudite stacks.

Ether Repletion.additional_info: Hunger stolen from players through any means will proc this Talent.
Ether Repletion.desc: Hunger stolen from other players now grants you ether as well.

Ether Tension.desc: Deal bonus true damage whenever you guardbreak an opponent with a mantra.

Ether Upgrade.desc: All mantras you cast now get one bonus level on top of their current level.

Etherguard.additional_info: When landing a Mantra with a Warped Blue Gem equipped, gain the Etherguard status effect, granting you damage reduction to Mantras and elemental resistance in PvE. The damage reduction for Mantras scales on the Ether cost of the Mantra you got hit by.
Etherguard.desc: Warped Blue Gems now provide a bonus effect when landed using a mantra, Etherguard. This effect gives extra resistances to mantras based on how much ether they cost to cast + gain elemental protection against PvE.

Ethiron's Gaze.additional_info: The snow in the Second Layer no longer affects your ability to see. Also reduces the visual clutter of snow in the overworld.
Ethiron's Gaze.desc: Your eyes have been opened to the wasteland. You can see through the harsh fog of the storm of the Eternal Gale more clearly now.

Eureka.additional_info: Landing and parrying Mantras grants Inspiration stacks. Mantras cap at giving 1 stack per, and you do not gain stacks from autoparry frames.
Eureka.desc: Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack.

Evasive Expert.desc: Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased.

Everchanging Aegis.additional_info: Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry.
Everchanging Aegis.desc: You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element.

Excavator.desc: Chance to receive two sets of ore when mining, mine ores a lot faster.

Execution.additional_info: Deals true damage. Only works if you do not have bullets in your inventory. Also procs on the offhand shots of Dual Gun attacks, but it deals 5 true damage instead if used on Dual Guns.
Execution.desc: Your offhand gun attacks now count as flourishes and do a flat 20 extra damage when used with no bullets.

Executioner's Frenzy.additional_info: This works on Paused Posture caused from Stature Break or Maiming Claws.
Executioner's Frenzy.desc: Landing a light attack while their posture is paused reduces their assassination cooldown by 5 seconds.

Exoskeleton.additional_info: Exoskeleton's resistance will be less effective if you do not meet its Fortitude requirement, losing 0.125% resistance for every point under 40 Fortitude, capping at 6.875% resistance with 15 Fortitude. Chitin's resistances stack multiplicatively with Exoskeleton.
Exoskeleton.desc: You have a layer of fortified Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest. Your Natural Armor will resist 10% Physical Damage when active.

Exotherm Path: Sanguine Blaze.desc: Your blood is thick and oily, clinging to all it touches. Blood mantras leave foes coated in Black Blood, slowing them and stifling their healing, up to 3 stacks. Touch it with flame and it erupts. Your fire burns a searing pink.

Exothermic Finish.desc: Igniting an enemy with Black Blood now flourishes them instead of knocking them back, inflicting all flourish talents.

Expeditionary Evasiveness.additional_info: Your Agility Mantras gain 3 Mantra levels, bypassing the level 5 cap. This is not displayed on the Mantra tooltip. Jetstriker Mantras are unaffected by this.
Expeditionary Evasiveness.desc: The design of this rapier allows you to much more swiftly attack in tandem with your mantras, giving Agility mantras you use +3 levels in all stats, even bypassing the level cap.

Expeditious Combo.additional_info: Passively increases the speed of your Onslaught. After landing a basic attack uppercut, gain the Expeditious Combo status effect for 15 seconds, displayed on the cooldown indicator. Casting Onslaught while you have this status effect will massively increase its speed, consuming the status effect in the process. This has no cooldown, but must be manually refreshed every time you use it.
Expeditious Combo.desc: Landing an uppercut will grant a buff to your Onslaught for 15 seconds, using Onslaught during this time will massively increase the speed of it.

Experienced Healer.desc: Every time you heal yourself, gain 5 extra health on top of that.

Expert Bloodrender.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Bloodrender.desc: You can now obtain 2-star Bloodrender mantras.

Expert Flamecharmer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Flamecharmer.desc: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.

Expert Frostdrawer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Frostdrawer.desc: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Frostdraw Mantras.

Expert Galebreather.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Galebreather.desc: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.

Expert Ironsinger.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Ironsinger.desc: You can now obtain 2-star Ironsinger mantras.

Expert Shadowcaster.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Shadowcaster.desc: You can now obtain 2-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.

Expert Thundercaller.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Expert Thundercaller.desc: You can now obtain 2-star Thundercaller mantras.

Explosive Efficiency.desc: Crafting a bomb will yield two bombs. Chance to make three.

Explosive Finish.additional_info: Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. Upon proccing Emperor Flame, this Talent will be put on a 3s cd.
Explosive Finish.desc: If an enemy is on fire when you flourish, blast them away with a fire blast.

Explosive Ignition.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool, that when used while standing inside of a steam cloud causes a very large explosion after a delay, dealing high damage and consuming the Steam cloud.
Explosive Ignition.desc: Ignite nearby steam, causing a large explosion.

Explosive Rage.additional_info: While buffed, your Puppets will gain an orange swirling aura. On proc, this buffs all currently alive Puppets and all Puppets that spawn within the next 10 seconds. The following abilities and Talents proc Explosive Rage: Explosive Finish, Emperor Flame, The Final Act, and the Detonation enchant.
Explosive Rage.desc: Causing explosion will make your puppets go into a frenzy - speeding up and dealing 50% more damage.

Explosive Rounds.desc: Every bullet that lands now detonates on your opponent.

Exposed Durability.additional_info: Procs against Berserk users and while Berserk is active.
Exposed Durability.desc: Deal 10% more damage to opponents with no armor durability left.

Extended Trauma.additional_info: Deals 3 posture damage to non-blocking opponents on M1, and 10 posture damage on critical. This cannot posture break, and this does not benefit from posture damage modifiers.
Extended Trauma.desc: Successful light attacks and criticals on your opponent now also gives them a bit of posture.

Eyes On Me.additional_info: Reclarification: Affected targets will deal 20% less damage to your allies, and any other entity that is not you. You do not gain damage reduction from this effect.
Eyes On Me.desc: Landing Both End's staff strike will cause all damage your opponent does to be reduced by 20% for the next 20 seconds to any target that is not you.

Face Cutter.additional_info: Grants an additional hit to your Spine Cutter that deals 50% of your weapon's scaled damage. Similarly to Spine Cutter, the damage of this attack cannot be buffed and it has no PEN.
Face Cutter.desc: Your Spine Cutter now deals an additional hit.

Family Recipe.additional_info: Bombs are crafted with 2 Iron and 1 Coal. Pressing E while holding a bomb will throw it, while pressing M1 while holding a bomb will drop it at your feet. Bombs have a 5 second cooldown on throw. Bombs do not deal self damage. Bomb damage scales on your Intelligence attribute, dealing 10 damage at 0 Intelligence and scaling up to 45.5 damage at 100 Intelligence. Bombs deal typeless damage, ignoring armor.
Family Recipe.desc: You can now craft bombs at a crafting bench.

Fan the Flames.additional_info: The benefits of Inhale can now be applied to your Flamecharm Mantras.
Fan the Flames.desc: Your stored Wind mantras can now empower your Fire mantras.

Fang and Coil.additional_info: Allows you to use the Fang and Coil fist style. Unlocked by speaking to Vesque with 20 LHT.
Fang and Coil.desc: Adopt the path of the serpent.

Fast Blade.additional_info: Increases the speed boost duration from parrying by 3 seconds.
Fast Blade.desc: Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack.

Faster Blade.desc: A successful "Drift" now grants a speed boost.

Fatal Backstab.desc: Weapon backstabs deal an extra 5 true damage on your opponent (20 extra damage if done to PvE).

Fatal Stealth.additional_info: Grants a 0.2% damage buff to attacks that hit your opponent's back for every 1% stealth you have. This only works on stealth gained from Equipment or Outfit sources. Felinor's innate stealth multiplier has no effect on this. This does not work on assassinations.
Fatal Stealth.desc: You deal increased backstab damage to opponents based on how high your stealth stat currently is.

Fatal Strike.additional_info: Applies a 50% slow for 5.5 seconds on proc. 10 second cooldown. If you have the full Reinforced War Set, this will deal an additional 15 true damage on proc.
Fatal Strike.desc: Landing a guard break with a strength mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it devastates your opponent, slowing them down.

Fear the Dark.additional_info: After you land a Shadowcast Mantra, if your opponent attempts to distance themselves from you, they will be locked in place for 1.5 seconds.
Fear the Dark.desc: Enemies will briefly hang in place when they run from you.

Feathered Glider.additional_info: Provides a Glider with infinite durability. The color of this Glider is dependent on your aspect variant, but it can be dyed.
Feathered Glider.desc: As a show of independence when they come of age, Tirans will strike out on their own with just their hand-crafted glider, gliding down from the mountain peaks where they make their homes. You take 10% less fall damage.

Featherfall.additional_info: Nullifies fall damage. Once 255 fall damage has been nullified, this will go on a 2 minute cooldown, disabling its benefits.
Featherfall.desc: Prevents falls from damaging you. After sufficient damage has been resisted, the pendant will go inactive and require time to recharge.

Ferryman's Curse.desc: Wearing this gives you a 20% chance to convert incoming elemental damage into Lightning damage.

Fictitious Force.additional_info: Halves the effectiveness of all speed boosts. Adds true damage to your attacks, with the true damage scaling on your speed boosts and momentum.
Fictitious Force.desc: Reduce the power of all speed boosts you gain by 50%. Deal extra true damage based on how fast you are.

Finishing Slay.additional_info: Consumes all of your Chains of Perfection stacks for a secondary instance of damage on your critical. This deals 7 typeless damage per Chain of Perfection stack in PvP, or 166 typeless damage per stack in PvE. The first 5 hits that normally do not grant stacks will contribute to this, allowing you to deal 150 PvP damage or 3.5k PvE damage at maximum Chain stacks. This can be buffed, but it is not considered as a weapon attack, limiting buffing options. Finishing Slay has no cooldown, allowing multi-hit criticals to deal massive damage in PvE.
Finishing Slay.desc: If you land a critical attack while also having stacks from the Chain of Perfection talent, consume all those for a massive damaging attack. This works on other players as well.

Finishing Touch.additional_info: Your critical must knock the opponent for this Talent to proc.
Finishing Touch.desc: [Dagger] Instantly execute enemies finished with the critical attack of your dagger.

First Blood.desc: Your first blood mantra you use in combat has no blood cost.

First Interrogation.additional_info: Only procs on weapon attacks from Electrified opponents. Ether given is half of their scaled damage.
First Interrogation.desc: Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage.

Fisher's Lure.additional_info: Slightly increases the chance of hooking something while fishing.
Fisher's Lure.desc: Fish are drawn to your line more quickly.

Fishman.desc: When your Blood is over 50%, you won't drown when Unconscious in water. Gain additional healing from knocking others Unconscious in water.

Fists of Fortitude.additional_info: Lasts 10 seconds then goes on cooldown once the buff ends. You can only gain stacks from M1s or criticals with the M1 tag.
Fists of Fortitude.desc: Fists Every 6 hits with your fists builds up a shield of endurance reducing incoming damage by 15%. 70s CD

Fists of Navae.desc: Double the amount of ether you gain on successful light attacks.

Flame Within.additional_info: 8 second cooldown on cast. The self burn can only be dispelled by using the tool again or through the rain/sea.
Flame Within.desc: An application of Pleeksty's concept of the inner flame, also known as the soul of man. Set yourself ablaze to gain more move speed and 10% extra damage.

Flamecharm Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Flamecharm Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Flamecharm Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Flamecharm to its fullest.

Flamecharmer.desc: Grants you the ability to command Fire as a Flamecharmer.

Flames of the Past.additional_info: Your Flamecharm Mantras now spawn Twisted Puppets' Puppets on hit.
Flames of the Past.desc: Your flamecharm mantras now call forth fiery homing spirits.

Flamewalker.desc: When Warding Radiance is active you leave trails of flame when you slide.

Flaming Flourish.desc: Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them.

Flanking Maneuvers.desc: Enemies you assassinate take more PEN from your squadmates in your party.

Flare Drop.additional_info: Applies burn when you land a Mantra with a 5 second cooldown.
Flare Drop.desc: Landing mantras sets your opponent on fire.

Flash Point.additional_info: 45 second cooldown on the Empowered Eruption effect.
Flash Point.desc: Block breaking an opponent causes your Eruptions to be Empowered for the next 10s. Block breaking an opponent with a Fire Mantra procs Burning.

Flashboil.additional_info: Steam deals 2 typeless damage per tick, at 6 ticks per second. Steam cannot be blocked nor parried.
Flashboil.desc: Landing Ice/fire attacks on burning/chilled enemies extinguishes the flame and generates steam.

Flashwind.additional_info: After using a Gale or Lightning dash, gain the Flashwind status effect for 3 seconds, allowing you to perform Flashwind dashes.
Flashwind.desc: Anytime you proc Air Pressure or Overcharge, give yourself the ability to have enhanced dashes again for a few seconds.

Flask Amplifier.additional_info: Increases the healing gained from Etris Flasks by 15% additively, meaning Flasks will restore 65% health on use instead of 50%.

Fleetfoot.additional_info: After using a Lightning or Gale dash, all dashes within the next 3 seconds will become enhanced. These enhanced dashes have the same effectiveness as Lightning and Gale dashes.
Fleetfoot.desc: Gain an initial speed boost when slide jumping.

Float Like a Butterfly.additional_info: 5s CD. Only accessible if True Strength is active. Deals 24 Oath + Slash damage (4 hits that deal 7 damage each).
Float Like a Butterfly.desc: While having True Strength active, cancel your air dash to enter a frenzy of slashes.

Flow State.additional_info: Activating Ankle Cutter, Mayhem, Relentless Hunt, or Rising Star within 2 seconds of activating Flow State will enhance these attacks. Flow State has a 10 second cooldown, but landing a Flow State-enhanced Silentheart ability will reset its cooldown. Flow State may affect the damage, wind-up, number of attacks, sound effect, or properties of Silentheart abilities.
Flow State.desc: Enter a moment of extreme focus in which you can change the windup of your special attacks with the correct timing.

Flying Swiftkick.desc: Hitting a Jus Karita critical attack while Swiftkick Prodigy is active will greatly slow your enemy, and consume your speed boost.

Focused Hematoma.desc: Increase the amount of temporary health you receive by 15%.

Focused Perception.desc: Massively increase the range of your Rhythm if you use it while Tranquil Circle is active.

Focused Strikes.desc: All criticals deal 15% more posture damage.

Foolish Outburst.additional_info: Steals 40% of the Tempo used. Every point in Intelligence below 50 will reduce the Tempo steal by 0.66%, capping at a minimum of 23.33% of the Tempo absorbed with 25 Intelligence.
Foolish Outburst.desc: Blocking or parrying a vent will absorb the Tempo cost of the vent. A Tactician steadies the course of battle.

Footwork Mastery.additional_info: The speed boost lasts 15 seconds despite what the description states. 45 second cooldown.
Footwork Mastery.desc: Landing a critical gives you an immense speed boost for 10 seconds.

Force Your Way.additional_info: You can now parry certain NPC attacks that are normally unparryable. On proc, your armor will be drained, with the amount of armor lost being based on the damage the attack would normally deal. This Talent does not work if you have no armor durability.
Force Your Way.desc: You can parry unparryable attacks from giant monsters, at the cost of armor durability.

Forced Fulfilment.additional_info: The Metal Fakeout critical only works while you are in range of a target. Additionally, this critical applies Bleed and counts as a weapon attack, not a Mantra. The rod applies a 52.5% slow for 15 seconds.
Forced Fulfilment.desc: Your Metal Greatsword now has Metal Fakeout as its critical attack. Landing a critical attack using your Metal Greatsword attaches a heavy rod onto your opponent, heavily slowing them.

Formless.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that costs 50 Ether with a 5 second cooldown. This tool allows you to teleport to your cursor's location, but you cannot teleport outside of the Tacet bubble. On teleport, Tacet will end early. The speed boost gained from using Tacet lasts 2.5 seconds.
Formless.desc: Teleport to a location within your Tacet bubble. Receive a slight speed boost when activating Tacet.

Fortify.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that grants 15% damage reduction at the cost of reducing your movement speed by 36%.
Fortify.desc: Slow down your movement in exchange for fortifying your defenses.

Fortitude Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Fortitude Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Fortitude on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Fortitude Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your fortitude to its fullest.

Fragile Freeze.additional_info: Encases them in ice, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time. Taking damage by any source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early. You can spam [F] to get out of Freeze faster.
Fragile Freeze.desc: Your Light Attacks and Critical will now freeze chilled opponents on guardbreak.

Freezing Wight.additional_info: Applies Chill for 7 seconds or 1 Crystal on proc. Additionally, this changes the damage type of your Haunted Gale Ghosts and Specter Apparitions to Galebreathe + Frostdraw.
Freezing Wight.desc: Your Haunted Gale now procs Chilled.

Frenzied Dance.desc: [Rapier] The more posture you currently have, the more chip and posture damage you deal.

Frenzied Slash.desc: Any damage you take during your Critical Attack's windup gets added to the damage of the Critical Attack.

Fried Circuits.additional_info: Targets affected by Sapped have the cooldowns of their Mantras increased.
Fried Circuits.desc: Overloading an enemy applies Sapped for 5s.

From The Ashes.desc: Using an Etris Flask when at 30% health or below now grants you a damage buff and resistance buff for 30 seconds.

Frost Buster.additional_info: On critical, create three moderately large ice patches in a linear path in front of yourself. These patches last 1 minute 30 seconds. Despite what the Talent description states, Greathammers do not proc Frost Buster but Greataxes do. Greatcannons do not proc Frost Buster either.
Frost Buster.desc: Greatsword Criticals and Greathammer Criticals now leave a place Ice below the path they carve.

Frostbite.desc: Enemies can no longer heal when under the effect of your chill. PvE enemies also net you 5% more Heal Boost when they are chilled.

Frostdraw Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Frostdraw Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Frostdraw Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Frostdraw to its fullest.

Frostdrawer.desc: Grants you the ability to command Ice as a Frostdrawer.

Frostride.additional_info: You can now walk on water by creating ice below your feet. This has no cooldown and does not cost Ether.
Frostride.desc: Your footsteps echo the legend of Saint Jay, freezing the sea beneath.

Frozen Anchor.additional_info: Bottom Freeze will be removed if the target takes damage from any source. This makes this Talent extremely ineffective on multihit criticals. The Chill applied from this Talent lasts 12 seconds. 10 second cooldown.
Frozen Anchor.desc: Apply bottom freeze and chill to your opponent whenever you land a flourish, uppercut, or crit.
Frozen Anchor.reqs: 100r LHT OR 100r MED OR 100r HVY, 100s ICE

Frozen Legs.additional_info: Lasts for the first 0.75s of Chill duration. Does not work with Crystallization Path.
Frozen Legs.desc: Chilled applied by your Mantras prevents your opponents from rolling.

Frozen Pin-Cushion.additional_info: Instantly detonates crystals if you have Crystallization Path.

Frozen Web.additional_info: Applies Chill for 7 seconds and Bottom Freeze. Has a 4 second cooldown.
Frozen Web.desc: Landing a critical with a Static Link on your opponent applies Chilled.

Fulgurite Formation.additional_info: The lightning strikes deal 5 typeless damage with a 4 second cooldown. The double Crystal application buff does not stack with successive Fulgurite Formation procs. Procs Grounding Bolt.
Fulgurite Formation.desc: When your Crystals explode, lightning strikes. When your Surge charges Overload on an enemy, your Crystals apply twice on them for 8s.

Full Reset.additional_info: Also works on non-humanoid monsters, resetting your Resonance cooldown after they die.
Full Reset.desc: Knocking an enemy resets your resonance cooldowns. This effect has a 60 second cooldown.

Ga Buidhe.additional_info: Attacking your opponent's back now procs all Talents and effects that would normally proc when attacking with the tip of your weapon.
Ga Buidhe.desc: Backstabs now count as the tip of your weapon.

Ga Dearg.additional_info: Hitting a bleeding enemy with the tip of your weapon will reapply the bleed.
Ga Dearg.desc: Striking a bleeding enemy with the tip of your weapon extends the bleed.

Gale Boots.desc: Reduce the amount of fall damage you take by 50%.

Gale Trap.additional_info: Marks players knocked by you for 6s with "Gale Trap". If the user picks up a target they've marked, they will gain a 35% speed boost for 20 seconds. But if anyone else attempts to pick up the marked target, they will be ragdolled and flung upwards. This includes the user's allies. Gale Reflection activates upon getting hit by an enemy, granting damage reduction to the attack and placing a Gale Trap on them. The damage of the Gale Trap scales with the strength of the enemy you killed.
Gale Trap.desc: Knocking a player places a wind trap, causing anyone to pick up that body to get sent flying. Gain a speed boost picking up the body yourself. Killing PvE opponents gives you Gale Reflection instead.

Galebreathe Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Galebreathe Attribute.
Galebreathe Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Galebreathe to its fullest.

Galebreather.desc: Grants you the ability to command wind as a Galebreather.

Gathering Electricity.additional_info: Clears all Static Blade stacks on proc. You can still gain Static Blade stacks while Gathering Electricity is active. For 15 seconds, this increases the base damage on your weapon attacks, including criticals by 3.
Gathering Electricity.desc: Reaching 5 Static Blade charges will now consume the stacks and apply a lightning buff to your blade. 60 second cooldown.

Gathering Storm.additional_info: All weapon damage is stored instead of being dealt initially, similar to the Poser's Ring. Upon reaching damage thresholds of stored damage, lightning orbs will appear above your character's head, with a cap of 8 orbs. Upon sheathing your weapon, the orbs will attack your opponent, dealing all of the stored damage at once.
Gathering Storm.desc: Your damage is stored in a lightning orb. Sheathing your weapon will shoot the lightning orbs at the opponent. The orbs will do more damage based on how many orbs are being stored up.

Ghost.additional_info: The invisibility and I-frame duration is 1.2 seconds if you have 40 or higher Agility. Ghost's duration will be reduced by 0.0133 seconds per point in Agility under 40, capping at 0.866 seconds at 15 Agility. 20 second cooldown.
Ghost.desc: Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible, ending early if you attack.

Gilded Path: Scrapsinger.additional_info: Your Ironsing abilities and status effects are now yellow.
Gilded Path: Scrapsinger.desc: Flourishing an enemy consumes any rods they have and siphons their armor to you per rod.

Give and Take.additional_info: This does not apply to self damage. Stacks multiplicatively with Loyalty.
Give and Take.desc: Deal less damage to comrades and receive less damage from comrades.

Glacial Coasting.desc: Sliding while Orbital Ice is active leaves trails of ice.

Glacial Mobility.additional_info: The Talent activates after you've slide jumped, and not during the slide jump, contrary to the Talent description.
Glacial Mobility.desc: Cast while slide-jumping to perform a running attack with your ice sabers.

Glass Path: Crystallization.additional_info: Turns your Frostdraw pink. Applying chill or freeze applies red ice crystals on the enemy instead of slowing opponent. Stacking 5 ice crystals or guard breaking an opponent who has crystals makes them explode. Each crystal has 3 base damage with 5 Frostdraw scaling, increasing by 0.015 damage per Frostdraw investment for a maximum damage of 4.5 each at 100 Frostdraw. 1 second cooldown on explosion proc.
Glass Path: Crystallization.desc: Your ice abilities no longer grant a slow effect or the ability to freeze and instead cause ice crystals to grow on your opponent.

Glide Mastery.desc: Experience using the glider you crafted results in you being able to glide faster in the air. You've also trained to quickly pull it out in dire situations, resulting in you no longer taking fall damage.

Going Nowhere.desc: When enemies dodge your attacks, their momentum is killed and they're briefly prevented from sprinting.

Golden Age.desc: Your Iron Pull now detonates Crystals and overloads Surges.

Golden Tongue.additional_info: This can either restore 33% of your maximum Ether or grant 10% damage reduction with a visual effect similar to Reinforce. The buff given to each player is rolled independently. Golden Tongue's cooldown is dependent on your Charisma investment, gaining or losing 0.25 seconds for every point in Charisma below or above 40 respectively. Minimum cooldown of 45 seconds at 100 Charisma, maximum cooldown of 66 seconds at 15 Charisma.
Golden Tongue.desc: Typing or using a gesture gives a random buff to you and those around you. (60 second cooldown)

Good Luck Charm.desc: Makes you feel a little better, probably.

Gourmand.additional_info: Increases hunger and thirst gain by 20%.
Gourmand.desc: Your hunger and thirst gain from eating is increased.

Graceful Steps.additional_info: The speed boost has a very short duration; having a fast swingspeed weapon is recommended to capitalize off this Talent's effect. 5 second cooldown.
Graceful Steps.desc: Your dancing steps now gives a faster speed boost.

Grand Feast.additional_info: Health gain is disabled in PvP combat. On proc, gain 40% tempo, 55% Ether, 3% blood, and 5% health.
Grand Feast.desc: Regain tempo, ether, blood and health when gaining hunger from killing.

Grand Skewer.additional_info: Press [F] during Grand Javelin's windup to activate this effect. This does not work in Layer 1.
Grand Skewer.desc: Your Grand Javelin now carries opponents through the air.

Grand Support.additional_info: Heals you for 2% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for every player buffed. Heals affected players by 3% of their maximum health.
Grand Support.desc: Everyone you buff with Reinforce is healed lightly. You're healed slightly if you heal others.

Grasp of Eylis.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used in the Voidheart, teleporting you to your Bounty target. Choosing Stealth causes teleports you near, but far away from your target, hiding the bounty target. Choosing Ferocity teleports you close to your target, highlighting them through walls briefly. If Ferocity is chosen, your character will be enveloped in shadows, signifying that you have a bounty.
Grasp of Eylis.desc: You can temporarily teleport to locations near your bounty target, if one can be found. However, you must stay close, or be desynchronized.

Grasp on Reality.desc: Damage taken from insanity is reduced.

Grotesque Resilience.additional_info: Reduces burn damage by 50%. Reduces Flame Within's burn and bleed damage by 25%.
Grotesque Resilience.desc: You take reduced damage from 'Damage over Time' effects.

Grounding Bolt.additional_info: 10 second cooldown. Procs on lightning strikes caused from Scorched Peak, Fulgurite Formation, the Specialist Set equipment Talents, and Storm/Stormbreaker enchantments during the rain.
Grounding Bolt.desc: Anytime you summon a lightning strike on your opponent, disable their ability to jump. Uppercutting your opponent while they are unable to jump now strikes them with another bolt of lightning.
Grounding Bolt.reqs: 90s LTN, 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY

Gruesome Harvest.additional_info: Grants 15 flat temporary health on proc. Has a 2 second cooldown.
Gruesome Harvest.desc: Landing Bloodrend mantras on opponents with over 70% blood poison will give you slight temporary health.

Guilt Trip.additional_info: Turns your Charm blue. Also procs on allies.
Guilt Trip.desc: Enhance your charm with the ability to affect one's emotions negatively, doubling the cooldown of their mantra feints.

Gunpowder Blast.additional_info: Pistol blast shots deal 2 more posture damage if you have no bullets in your inventory.
Gunpowder Blast.desc: Pistol shots without bullets do 2 extra posture. [Dual Guns]

Gunslinger's Fury.additional_info: If your main weapon is a Pistol or a Rifle, and you have an offhand Pistol equipped, your critical will be replaced with the Soulwrought Gun's special attack if used midair.
Gunslinger's Fury.desc: When having a side gun equipped with a gun or rifle, use a critical in the air to shoot a barrage of bullets towards your opponent.

Gut Rot.desc: Landing a flourish enhances your next instance of anti-heal, doubling its duration for how long it lasts.

Hair Product.additional_info: Gives a Talent tool that shows a popup menu and allows you to select either Flammable, Charming, or Revitalizing Hair Sprays. Your Hair Spray will change to the chosen effect.

Hair Spray.additional_info: Flammable applies Burn or causes an Eruption; parryable and blockable. Charming applies Charm for 15 seconds; parryable and blockable. Revitalizing heals 10% of the affected entity's health; unparryable and unblockable. 10 second cooldown.

Hammerfall.desc: [Clubs] Aerial attacks do 25% more posture damage when blocked.

Hard Read.desc: Hitting your opponent during a feint will cause them to be Dazed.

Hard Stop.desc: Landing a charged shot will knock your opponent back.

Hardened Shell.desc: Your Natural Armor grows sturdier, being able to take more hits before breaking.

Harvester.desc: Chance to receive two sets of ingredients when harvesting.

Haste.additional_info: Increases your movement speed by +3 studs per second. This does not count as a speed boost for Talent procs.
Haste.desc: Gain a permanent +3 speed buff at all times.

Haunted Gale.additional_info: On proc, gain the Haunted status effect, spawning ghosts that attack your opponent every time you land a Mantra. Having Gale Wisp active increases the duration of Haunted by 3 seconds. If you have Apparitions, landing a Galebreathe Mantra while having the Haunted Gale status effect will create an Apparition instead while non-Galebreathe Mantras will summon Haunted Gale's Ghosts like normal.
Haunted Gale.desc: Landing 3 Galebreathe Mantras without whiffing calls for a Haunted Phantom. The Phantom will attack alongside you for the next 8s before dissipating.

Haunted Path: Specter.additional_info: Turns your Galebreathe white. If Haunted Gale procs on non-Galebreathe Mantras or if you do not have the Apparitions Talent, then Haunted Gale's phantoms will still appear on proc.
Haunted Path: Specter.desc: Build up spectral energy by performing successful dodges and landing Wind mantras. Phantom winds from Haunted Gale no longer appear. You can no longer suffocate enemies.

Heart Reverb.additional_info: If someone performs an action within Rhythm's range, they will be highlighted red, even through walls. Rhythm will now stay active after uncrouching, only deactivating if done so manually or if you take damage. If an enemy dodges your attack, their health and posture percentages will be displayed in text next to their character briefly.
Heart Reverb.desc: Those picked up by your Rhythm are marked for 8 seconds. Whenever an opponent dodges your attack, detect their rhythm and vigor. You can use Rhythm while standing.

Heartfire Renewal.desc: Regenerate Heartfire whenever you are burning. Upon revival with Phoenix Flames, restore half of your Heartfire gauge.

Heartwing Beat.additional_info: Your aerial attack is replaced with Heartwing Beat, a slashing attack that applies bleed and deals Wither damage. This attack has a base damage of 25.5, copying the scaling stat from your equipped weapon. You cannot proc Air Counter or Relentless Hunt on Heartwing Beat. 6 second cooldown.
Heartwing Beat.desc: Your heart beats a new rhythm, as your aerial attack takes on a new manifestation.

Hearty Ether.desc: Devouring Eye steal procs now heal you based on the amount of ether stolen.

Heavy Cannonball.additional_info: This equates to an ~29% net damage increase on the base Greatcannon critical, and an ~33% net damage increase on Smouldering Hallow's critical. Critical Engine (with Blessed Gem) or Summer Hullwrecker (due to its Talent) can be used to negate the added critical cooldown. This does not work on Edenbrand Hellcoil.
Heavy Cannonball.desc: [Greatcannon] Double the cooldown of your critical attack but increase the cannonball damage by 50%.

Heavy Fatigue.desc: [Greataxes] Hitting an enemy slowed by your Greataxe temporarily reduces how far they can roll and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.

Heavy Haul.desc: Enemies who carry you move significantly slower. Take slightly less posture damage from large enemies. Takes one to know one.

Heavy Hitter.desc: [Heavy Weapons] Your posture damage is increased by 5%.

Heavy Shoulders.desc: If your opponent has 3 or more rods, their dodges are slower.

Heavy Weapons Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Heavy Weapons.
Heavy Weapons Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Heavy Weapons attribute to its fullest.

Heir of Lightning.additional_info: Increases the base duration of Lightning Cloak to 15 seconds.
Heir of Lightning.desc: At max orbs, Lightning Cloak is enhanced.

Heliodar Wings.additional_info: Pressing H will sprout your Heliodar Wings. Hold Space while flying to ascend, Q to speed up, or CTRL to descend. Flying consumes Heartfire Gauge. If you run out of Heartfire Gauge while flying, you will be set on fire, ending the flight early. Taking damage from any source will cause your flight to end early.

Hell's Partisan.additional_info: Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. Parryable, but not blockable or dodgeable due to hitstun.
Hell's Partisan.desc: After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above.

Hellion Shift.desc: The more insane you are the more iframes you gain on your dodge.

Hemolysis.desc: Deal 20% more critical attack damage to opponents with over 25% blood poisoning.

Hemolytic Transfusion.desc: Guardbreaking an enemy with a Bloodrend mantra increases the amount of blood poison from the attack.

Hemorrhaging Blow.additional_info: The damage to healing conversion is 1:1, meaning 20 healing = 20 damage. Works on all non-passive healing. 55 second cooldown, starting once the guardbreak occurs.
Hemorrhaging Blow.desc: Block breaking your opponent with a blood mantra turns your opponent's combat healing into damage for 8 seconds.

Herbivore.desc: You gain more nutrition from eating plants.

Heretic's Sacrifice.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that drains a significant amount of sanity to heal 20 raw health. If you are already at 0 Sanity, you will still be healed at no downside.
Heretic's Sacrifice.desc: A chant that heavily sacrifices your sanity to regain a bit of health.

Heretic's Sutra.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that drains the user's sanity on proc. If your sanity is above 80%, it will be set to 65% on use. If your sanity is below 80%, it will be reduced by 15% on use. Passively procs Shared Misery and Piercing Will for 15 seconds. The cooldown and windup of Heretic's Sutra scale on your Willpower investment, but the scaling is largely negligible.
Heretic's Sutra.desc: A chant that steers you into the state of Insanity for 20 seconds.

Hero's Assist.additional_info: Each Saint has a specific spawn requirement and ability when spawned. You can spawn heroes independent of your current Saint Stance. This passive ability works once per Saint Stance, requiring you to cycle to the next one to reactivate.
Hero's Assist.desc: Heroes come to your aid based on your current stance.

Hex Bullet.desc: Bullets that hit your opponents block shatter into dust on impact, unleashing a maddening smoke that increases your opponent's sanity.

Hidden Tendril.additional_info: Also procs on physical critical attacks, uppercuts, and flourishes.
Hidden Tendril.desc: Landing any physical mantra places a Hidden Tendril on the opponent.

Hip Shooter.additional_info: 5 second cooldown. Requires ammunition in your inventory to be used.
Hip Shooter.desc: When wielded with a Medium/Heavy weapon, your side gun can now fire a bullet projectile.

Hook, Line, and Sinker.additional_info: Slightly increases margin of failure before losing a fish.
Hook, Line, and Sinker.desc: Once something's caught your line, it's much harder to get loose.

Hoplite.desc: Posture damage is reduced by 15% when wielding a spear and standing still.

Hot Potato.desc: Gain a large boost of speed after throwing a bomb. Your bombs have a chance to detonate twice.

Human Battery.additional_info: Each Rod equates to 10 Ether. Works on Rods that weren't applied by you, but does not work on Rods applied to you.
Human Battery.desc: When you are out of Ether, convert the Surge stacks of nearby enemies into Ether to pay the cost of your Mantras.

Hungry Flames.desc: When you have no Ether, consume Stomach and Water to instantly cast your next fire mantra [15 second CD].

Hunter's Chase.desc: Double the range you are able to chase down enemies with a running attack. Your Running attacks now also proc Bear Trap and deals 15% more base damage.

Hunter's Reflexes.desc: You have a slightly larger dodge window.

Hunting Trap.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that places a bear trap on use. 60 second cooldown. Walking onto a bear trap deals high damage and renders you immobile for a few seconds. The bear trap cannot trigger again once it has been triggered. You can trigger your own bear trap.
Hunting Trap.desc: Place down a trap that upon being stepped on will render your opponent unable to move for a bit.

Hyperbody.additional_info: Provides 35.5% damage reduction, scaling up with the amount of players buffed. Provides a 7.5 studs/s movement speed bonus, scaling down with the amount of players buffed. Hyperbody has a 30 second duration, but this duration will be reduced by 3s for every player buffed (including yourself). 2 minute cooldown.
Hyperbody.desc: Apply a buff to your allies around you that increases your speed, defense, and regeneration. This effect becomes weaker the more allies you buff with it.

Hypovolemic Focus.additional_info: The opponent regains 20% less posture damage from parrying you.
Hypovolemic Focus.desc: While you have temporary health, your opponent regains far less posture from parrying you.

I'm Blue.additional_info: Increases the effectiveness of Blue Gems by 40% additively.
I'm Blue.desc: Improve the efficiency of your Blue Gems. Blue are the gems you use.

Ichor Imbuement.additional_info: Buffs any Starkindred Mantra if your wings are not out on cast.
Ichor Imbuement.desc: Using a Starkindred mantra while your wings are not out increases the damage they deal by 2 times.

Ignition Rite.desc: Landing fire attacks with the phoenix summoned regenerates Heartfire.

Immolation.additional_info: "Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you. "Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. This applies burn regardless of Flamecharm path. Instead, all instances of Physical damage, and all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) fx on hit will proc Immolation, applying burn.
Immolation.desc: Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames.

Immortality.additional_info: Grants one instance of knock prevention. Having this Talent disables the Viscosity Enchantment.
Immortality.desc: The remnants of the helmet's Mind Veil stir into life when you would be made Unconscious soaking all damage for a brief duration. 30s CD. Viscosity is rejected.

Impairing Blow.desc: [Greataxes] Basic Attacks will slightly slow your enemy for 2 seconds. Running attacks will slow your enemy for 3 seconds. Gain +20% posture damage against enemies with speed boosts.

Imperium Kata.additional_info: Allows you to use the Imperium Kata fist style.
Imperium Kata.desc: Wield an advanced form of the Legion's martial arts

Impervious Slumber.desc: Getting hit while Unconscious no longer resets your time Unconscious.

In a Hurry.additional_info: Reduces grip time by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster).
In a Hurry.desc: You grip faster with a movement speed boost.

Incendiary Formula.additional_info: Bombs apply burn on hit. Bombs will deal 20% more damage to burning targets, regardless of where the burn came from.
Incendiary Formula.desc: Bombs will set your enemies on fire upon detonation, as well as launch with more force. Bombs will deal 20% increased damage to burning enemies.

Inhale.additional_info: Inhaling adds (Mantra level multiplied by 2)% damage to the next Galebreathe Mantra cast. Grants a speed boost for 3 seconds. Additionally grants the Maestro's Blade status effect, allowing your basic attacks to proc After Cut.
Inhale.desc: Feinting a Wind spell stores its power in your lungs for 5 seconds, empowering the next wind spell cast in that time. All relevant modifications and upgrades from the inhaled wind mantras are applied to the empowered mantra.

Inky Pearls.additional_info: Turns your Vent black and makes it drain 47.5 Ether on hit. Additionally, your Vent can now proc certain Shadowcast Talents on hit like Sightless Still or Twisted Puppets' Shadowcast burn.
Inky Pearls.desc: The ether you eject is coated with inky shadow. Your vent now steals a small amount of ether.

Innate Agility.desc: You hinge on your instincts to keep you alive, even in battle. Slightly increase your dodge frames.

Instant Nucleation.desc: Take less damage for a few seconds after you are guardbroken.

Intelligence Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Intelligence Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Intelligence on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Intelligence Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Intelligence to its fullest.

Intrepid Flame.desc: Flames wear off twice as fast on you.

Intuitive Repairs.additional_info: Iron Skin regenerates your armor and Natural Armor while its active.
Intuitive Repairs.desc: Your 'Iron Skin' repairs armor while it's active.

Iron Gut.additional_info: Heavily reduces the chance that you vomit upon eating bad food. This does not work on Pufferfish.
Iron Gut.desc: You have resistance against being poisoned by foods.

Iron Stance.additional_info: Grants immunity to one instance of ragdoll. If this procs, it will go on a 20 second cooldown.
Iron Stance.desc: Be able to shrug off being ragdolled every so often.

Ironclad Punishment.additional_info: Gain +0.15% posture damage on Ironsing Mantras for every 1% armor durability your opponent has, capping at +15% if your opponent is at maximum armor.
Ironclad Punishment.desc: Your Ironsing mantras deal more posture damage to enemies the more armor durability they have.

Ironsing Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Ironsing Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Ironsing Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Ironsing to its fullest.

Ironsinger.additional_info: Ironsing mantras apply stacks of Metal Rods on targets. Pressing [X] will pull affected towards you, with the strength of the pull depending on the amount of Metal Rods present. You cannot apply more than 5 Metal Rods to one target, unless you have one of the Rending Needle Talents.
Ironsinger.desc: Grants you the ability to command Metal as an Ironsinger. Press X to Pull on Metal Rods.

Jackpot.desc: Charmed enemies now have a chance to be hit critically, multiplying the damage.

Jay's Judgement Gavel.additional_info: Landing your critical on a frozen or bottom frozen enemy will deal extra damage and heal you.
Jay's Judgement Gavel.desc: Breaking a frozen enemy free with your Critical saps their lifeforce.

Jester's Ruse.additional_info: Visionshaper's Cheap Trick visual effect plays on proc. This can proc if an attack is blocked, dodged, or parried. When this happens, the visual effect will play, but nothing will happen.
Jester's Ruse.desc: Anytime you take damage, there's a 10% chance it gets completely nullified. Anytime you deal damage, there's a 10% chance it also gets completely nullified.

Jetstream Pursuit.desc: Upon a successful flourish, teleport to the opponent when they stop moving. Receive a significant boost of momentum.

Jolting Current.additional_info: While you and your opponent are in the water, landing any attack that would apply Shock or a Surge Rod will strike other waterborne targets in a 20 stud AoE from the initial target, dealing 50% of the attack's damage and applying Shock or a Surge Rod.
Jolting Current.desc: Your lightning attacks in water strike others near them with lightning.

Juicy Snack.desc: Eliminating enemies returns their amount of blood poison as health to you.

Jumper Cables.additional_info: Whenever you would get knocked but have a tether active, steal HP from the target to survive the hit. This has a 4 second cooldown.
Jumper Cables.desc: Being made Unconscious with an active tether allows you to steal health from a tethered target and not be made Unconscious.

Jus Karita.additional_info: Allows you to use the Jus Karita fist style. Unlocked by speaking to Polis with Power 5 and 40 LHT.
Jus Karita.desc: Adopt the kick-based fighting style of the Justicars.

Just a Taste.desc: First Bloodrend mantra you hit in combat has increased blood drain.

Justicar Whistle.additional_info: Upon using the provided Talent tool, a Justicar may respond to your call for aid, teleporting to your server to assist you with events and protect you in combat.

Justicar's Adaptation.additional_info:
Having the Justicar's Technique Talent allows you to have the Jus Karita running attack on any weapon, allowing you to proc Jus Karita and Fist exclusive Talents on any weapon via the running attack.

Having the Justicar's Preference Talent allows you to have the Jus Karita critical attack on any weapon, allowing you to proc the Jus Karita Talents on non-Jus Karita weapons.
Justicar's Adaptation.desc: Jus Karita running attacks and criticals can now proc Jus Karita talents even if you aren't currently using Jus Karita. Your Jus Karita running attacks can now also proc fist talents.

Justicar's Blessing.desc: Allies you mark with Justicar's Mark gain 15% more healing.

Justicar's Call.additional_info: Upon using the provided Talent tool, a UI will pop up that shows a list of all Castaways who have used the Justicar Whistle tool. Upon selecting one, you'll teleport into their server, and you'll be tasked with protecting them against Voidwalkers and assisting them in events. Assisting Castaways with this tool is the main progression method of this Origin.
Justicar's Call.desc: Lend your aid to those in need.

Justicar's Gift.desc: Your Justicar support mantras now heal your allies for 10 health instead of 5. Increase the duration of your Karita Aid to 15 seconds.

Justicar's Mark.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that allows you to apply the Justicar's Mark status effect on one of your allies. While this effect is active, the marked target gains 20% damage redirection, as 20% of the damage they would have taken is redirected to you instead. Additionally, you take 20% more damage.
Justicar's Mark.desc: Mark someone you wish to protect for a minute. While marked, you take 20% of the damage they receive but they take 20% less damage. Marking someone also cause you to take 20% more damage while they are marked.

Justicar's Preference.additional_info:
The Jus Karita critical will adopt your equipped weapon's scaling stat.

Having the Vanguard Style Talent will override this Talent, allowing you to use the Vanguard Style critical on any weapon instead of the default Jus Karita one.
Justicar's Preference.desc: Replace your critical with the Jus Karita critical attack.

Justicar's Prowess.additional_info: Gain +30% posture damage on weapon attacks against opponents using Way of Navae, Fang and Coil, Imperium Kata, Untrained Fist, or Legion Kata.
Justicar's Prowess.desc: Jus Karita gains +30% posture damage against other fist styles.

Justicar's Renewal.additional_info: Landing Jus Karita's critical attack will reset its cooldown. This has a 10 second cooldown. Also procs if Jus Karita's critical is blocked or parried.
Justicar's Renewal.desc: Hitting an opponent with your Jus Karita critical resets the cooldown. (Cooldown of 10 seconds).

Justicar's Technique.additional_info: Replaces your weapon's running attack animation with the Jus Karita one, and adds 0.5 range to your running attacks.
Justicar's Technique.desc: Replace your running light attack with the Jus Karita running light attack. With the Justicar's Training, your legs extend the range of this running attack by an extra 0.5.

Karita Combo.desc: Remove the endlag from your next running attack. [5 second CD] Landing a critical attack right after your running attack makes that critical attack have no cooldown and deal more damage. [10 second CD]

Keen Recovery.additional_info: The amount of Ether restored scales on your Intelligence investment, being above the Mantra's cost if you have over 55 Intelligence.
Keen Recovery.desc: Landing a basic attack after feinting a mantra will restore the feinted mantra's ether cost.

Kick Off.additional_info: Falls are considered to be 10 studs shorter, reducing fall damage. Climb height is increased by 15% with a 3s CD. Slide jumping further increases climb height.
Kick Off.desc: You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall.

Kick the Beat.desc: Dancer's Beat now works with Critical Attacks.

Kickstart.additional_info: Heals the person for 10% of their maximum health if you successfully resurrect them. Kickstart consumes 5% of your Ether on use, and then another 20% if the Kickstart was successful. Kickstart has a 3 second long animation, in which you cannot act. This can be used on players using Cap Artist. Despite the description stating "allies," this can be used on non-allies and humanoid NPCs.
Kickstart.desc: Play the resurrector. Use your lightning to defibrillate your allies on the battlefield.

Kindness.desc: Whenever you heal another player, heal 5 health yourself. [3 second cooldown]

Kj's Courage.additional_info: Due to it rounding down, this Talent will only activate if you get at least 10 Knowledge in one instance.
Kj's Courage.desc: Gain 10% more Knowledge from all sources, rounded down.

Knack.desc: Trees yield more Wood when felled. Your Repair speed is increased.

Knife's Journey.additional_info: In PvE, your Dagger attacks have a 15% chance to critically hit, dealing 5x damage. This does not proc "on critical attack" effects, and cannot proc on Moppet's critical attack.
Knife's Journey.desc: [Dagger] Cancelling an enemy's Mantra windup with your Basic Attacks now deals 15% more damage

Knight's Rally.desc: When using a shield, you ready your block more quickly after taking a hit.

Know When To Run.additional_info: Increases the price of using the Magic Coffin by 50% in exchange for adding the entire Depths lootpool to it.
Know When To Run.desc: Your magic coffin has a higher chance to draw depths loot, but the price is increased.

Knuckle Guard.additional_info: Knuckle Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.1s for every point of Fortitude and Strength below its requirements, having a minimum possible duration of 10.4 seconds with 30 Fortitude and 4 Strength.
Knuckle Guard.desc: Hitting Dazed enemies grants you 10% posture resistance for 15s.

Laced Traps.additional_info: Landing a Caltrop slows down your opponent and disables their ability to jump for 1.1 seconds. This effect refreshes if the victim gets hit by another Caltrop.
Laced Traps.desc: People hit by your 'Caltrops' cannot jump and are slowed for a small duration, while also applying Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.

Lackluster Guard.desc: You aren't used to having to block, resulting in weaker posture.

Laminated Armor.additional_info: Reduces damage taken and dealt by a flat 2 (3 in Vow of Iron). This is applied after damage modifiers but before resistances. It cannot reduce a damage value below 0.
Laminated Armor.desc: Reduces all incoming damage by 2/3 (applied after damage multipliers).

Lancer's Impale.desc: [Spears] Hitting an enemy after a perfect dodge makes your next attack deal 30% bleed damage. If that attack would already bleed, it adds +10% chip damage instead.

Landshark.additional_info: The lifesteal only works in PvE.
Landshark.desc: Killing a Megalodaunt will grant lifesteal on your attacks for 30 seconds.

Largent.desc: Your diplomatic skills extend into your ability to barter. Gain 300 extra notes per chest when turning in a sack.

Last Resort.desc: Deal +5% more damage when your health is below 25%.

Lasting Charisma.additional_info: This adds 10 seconds to Charismatic Cast's Charm duration, but this will be reduced by 0.16s for every point of Charisma below 55, capping at 15.8 seconds at 30 Charisma.
Lasting Charisma.desc: Enemies charmed by your mantras are charmed longer.

Lasting Sorrow.desc: Shadows last longer on your opponent.

Lasting Trauma.additional_info: This applies the Fearful status effect for 19 seconds. Wrath gems have a 10 second cooldown, meaning you can potentially disable your opponent's ability to use their critical indefinitely. Deal 15 extra true damage whenever you guardbreak with a Strength Mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it.
Lasting Trauma.desc: Anytime you land a Wrath Gem, your opponent becomes fearful, being unable to use their critical for a few seconds after you land it. This also buffs Fatal Strike, causing it to deal 15 true damage on proc.

Leg Shot.desc: [Rifles] Landing your critical slows your enemy for a bit while making PvE enemies Sluggish, and also disables any speed boosts they get for the next 10 seconds.

Legendary.desc: Parrying and landing hits with your weapon gives you ether back.

Legion Kata.additional_info: Allows you to use the Legion Kata fist style.
Legion Kata.desc: Gain the ability to use the Legion's martial arts.

Lethal Depressant.desc: Assassinating an opponent decreases the damage they deal by 25% for the next 30 seconds.

Lethal Dose.additional_info: Doubles the duration of the Hidden Blade poison effect, from 8 seconds to 16.
Lethal Dose.desc: The poison from your hidden blade lasts twice as long.

Life Leech.additional_info: The healing gained is based on summon damage dealt. This works on the following summons: monsters from the Parasol's Blight enchantment, The Weaving Web's critical attack, Illusory Servants, Illusory Counter, Lightning Clones, and Flame Sentinel.
Life Leech.desc: Your summons now heal you each time they deal damage.

Light Weapons Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Light Weapons.
Light Weapons Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Light Weapons attribute to its fullest.

Lights Out.desc: Assassinations now give you 30% PEN and blind the target for 5s. Those you carry are now blindfolded.

Lightspeed Reflexes.additional_info: Grants a 60% speed boost for 5 seconds on proc. This does not stack with the innate speed boost from parrying, nor the speed boost from Fast Blade.
Lightspeed Reflexes.desc: When you parry an attack after feinting an attack, gain a 5s speed boost.

Lightweight.additional_info: Grants a +25% movement speed buff. This is not a speed boost, meaning it won't proc any speed boost-reliant Talents.
Lightweight.desc: Move faster when your armor runs out of durability.

Link Conduction.additional_info: Each active Link reduces the Ether cost of your Thundercall Mantras by 30%.
Link Conduction.desc: While you have active tethers your lightning mantras cost less ether.

Lithe Step.additional_info: Provides a brief speed boost on proc. 3s CD, reduced to 1s if in True Strength.
Lithe Step.desc: When Sprinting, roll-cancel and instantly vanish and surge with unmatched speed.

Lock n Load.desc: [1H Guns] The first bullet in your gun does more damage when fully loaded. This damage buff scales with the number of bullets up to 15%.

Lone Wolf.desc: Despite the loyalty of your allies, you recognize that you sometimes need to hunt alone. Deal more damage to targets who are only combat tagged by you.

Looter.additional_info: This affects: turning in Artifacts or the Strange Egg at a banker, turning in Sacks to Mercille, handing in pure ore to a Blacksmith, and trading in Explosive Crates to Scope.
Looter.desc: Get extra loot from items you turn in for rewards.

Lord's Tithe.additional_info: Steals Ether (or health in PvE) in pulses.
Lord's Tithe.desc: Everyone you Reinforce is drained of their Ether while Reinforced. Drain scales with your Shadowcast. Drain health from PvE opponents as well.

Lose Your Mind.additional_info: Starting at 70% Sanity, gain a damage buff that scales non-linearly on your current Sanity percentage.
Lose Your Mind.desc: Deal more damage the more insane you are. Grants +15% damage at maximum insanity.

Lowstride.desc: When crouching, your stealth and roll distance are increased. The speed penalty you receive from crouching is much smaller. You now draw and sheathe your weapon silently.

Loyalty.additional_info: Allies take 35% less damage from you and deal 35% less damage to you. This stacks multiplicatively with Give and Take.
Loyalty.desc: Your bond with your allies is strong enough to reduce damage between you.

Luminous Flash.additional_info: During Absolute Radiance, your M1 attacks have a chance to proc Luminous Flash, applying the damage modifier hardcap as a damage buff.
Luminous Flash.desc: After dealing a certain amount of damage in Absolute Radiance, gain a chance to empower your strikes with pure light.

Magic Coffin.additional_info: Activating your Coffin takes 50 Notes. This Note cost will increase by 50 per Power, costing 1,000 Notes at Power 20. When used, the Coffin acts like a loot box, randomly rolling an item to give you. There is a 1% chance to grant the Skull, giving you high tier loot. This chance is increased by 1% per level, up to 20% at power 20. There is a 5-10% chance to roll a blank, doubling the chest of the next box. This can stack. Coffin activation uses your Resonance keybind. You can use any weapon or equipment item without meeting their attribute requirements.
Magic Coffin.desc: A jack of all trades, all attribute requirements are ignored. Activate your Coffin with C.

Magical Resolve.desc: Being hit increases Ether regen for a short duration, the strength of the regen scales off your Willpower.

Maiming Claws.additional_info: While their posture is paused, your opponent cannot restore posture by parrying, spitting, passive posture restoration, or through Steady Nerves. All other forms of posture restoration ignore this effect entirely. Maiming Claws' duration will be shortened if you do not meet its requirements. Maiming Claws cannot be refreshed if Down Comes the Claw is currently active.
Maiming Claws.desc: Down Comes the Claw now disables your opponent's posture regeneration for 6s on proc.

Malevolent Sapper.desc: The more blood poisoning your opponent has, the more ether your shadow mantras steal from your opponent.

Manipulator.additional_info: 10 second cooldown. This is inherently weaker on multihit criticals due to it only proccing once then going on cooldown. Unnecessary Theatrics or Overcharm can be used to reapply the Charm after Manipulator removes it on the same hit.
Manipulator.desc: Deal 20% more critical attack damage to charmed enemies, but the effect is removed on impact.

Mantra Permanence.desc: Knocking an enemy with a mantra refunds the cost of the mantra.

Mark Mastery.additional_info: Reduces the additional damage you take from marking an ally from 20% to 5%.
Mark Mastery.desc: Reduce the amount of extra damage you receive while your ally is marked with the Justicar's Mark from 20% to 5%.

Mark of Jurik.additional_info: Gain a tool that lowers the sanity drain of nearby players. Also buffs affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food and their blood regen. 4m CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Does not require you to be resting at a campfire.
Mark of Jurik.desc: Mark of Jurik, the Moonseye. A beacon of calm, those in your presence are resistant to insanity.

Mark of Ku.additional_info: Gain a tool that buffs the blood regen of nearby players. Also buffs the affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their sanity and their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food. 3m 30s CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.
Mark of Ku.desc: Mark of Ku, the Mother. Improves the rest of those in your presence.

Mark of Nemit.additional_info: Gain a tool that buffs the food and thirst replenishment of nearby players. Also buffs the affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their blood regen and sanity. 3m 30s CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.
Mark of Nemit.desc: Mark of Nemit, the First Beast. Food consumed in your presence is more nourishing.

Mark of the Lone Warrior.additional_info: Gain an experience gain multiplier if nobody else has combat tagged the enemy. Gain a 5% damage buff against enemies who have combat tagged you, or enemies you've combat tagged if the opponent has less than or an equal amount of combat tags as you.
Mark of the Lone Warrior.desc: Progress much faster when progressing alone. Gain a damage boost when facing threats alone and also when outnumbered.
