Marked Descent.additional_info: Targets the enemy who hit your marked ally, not the marked ally themselves.
Marked Descent.desc: When your Justicar's Mark target takes damage, they are revealed. Using your Karita Divebomb will target them.

Martial Brutality.additional_info: Increases your posture damage by 0.1% per 1% health missing, up to a maximum of +10% posture damage against someone at 0% health.
Martial Brutality.desc: The less health your opponent has, the more posture you deal to them.

Martyr.additional_info: Martyrdom grants a +20% damage and damage reduction buff to your allies. Enemies who knock you restore only half of the posture and health they would normally obtain (50% -> 25%).
Martyr.desc: When you're knocked Unconscious, enemies gain less health and posture, and allies around you are granted Martyrdom for 20s

Mass Effect.additional_info: Increases the posture damage bonus of Might Gems by 2.25% additively, for every Might Gem you have equipped on your Mantras.
Mass Effect.desc: For every Might Gem you have equipped on your mantras, slightly increase each Might Gem's power.

Master Bloodrender.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Bloodrender.desc: You can now obtain 3-star Bloodrender mantras. Your maximum blood capacity is 25% more than a normal individual. You regen blood at a quicker pace.

Master Chef.additional_info: Increases the duration of food buffs by 30%. Increases the healing gained from using Fondant Splitter's critical.
Master Chef.desc: Buffs applied by food you cook now have their buff effects amplified by +30%.

Master Craftsman.additional_info: You can craft items that normally require a Crafting Station from your inventory.
Master Craftsman.desc: Your skills alone substitute the need for a Craft Station.

Master Flamecharmer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Flamecharmer.desc: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.

Master Frostdrawer.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Frostdrawer.desc: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Frostdraw Mantras.

Master Galebreather.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Galebreather.desc: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.

Master Ironsinger.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Ironsinger.desc: You can now obtain 3-star Ironsinger mantras.

Master Shadowcaster.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Shadowcaster.desc: You can now obtain 3-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.

Master Thundercaller.additional_info: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Master Thundercaller.desc: You can now obtain 3-star Thundercaller mantras.

Masterwork.desc: Successful hits from Artisan's Blades will proc metal rods and deal 50% more damage.

Matador.desc: Deal +20% more damage to human enemies with hyperarmor.

Maudet.additional_info: Gain 3 free investment points to invest every time you level up. This stacks with Autodidact. Your starting reputation with all factions is higher.
Maudet.desc: Your understanding of your destiny is such that learning new things often comes naturally to you. People appreciate your diplomatic ways of speaking.

Max Ammo.desc: Landing the cannonball of your critical attack removes your critical attack's cooldown.

Mayhem.additional_info: 16s CD per weapon type, 6s CD if feinted. Movesets and damage differ depending on weapon type. Gains the ability to autogrip if it is enhanced by Flow State.
Mayhem.desc: Initiate a special dash attack by pressing M1 during the start of your dodge.

Medium Weapons Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Medium Weapons.
Medium Weapons Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Medium Weapons attribute to its fullest.

Mercenary Blade.desc: For every 10% stealth you have, deal 1 extra damage on all sources of damage.

Merchant's Accord.additional_info: This Talent does NOT allow you to use the Antiquarian in the First Layer if you are not Deepbound or Ignition Delver.
Merchant's Accord.desc: Merchants and Antiquarians will do business with you no matter how poor your reputation is.

Merciless Blade.additional_info: Increases your execution speed by 25%, down to 2.25 seconds from 3 seconds.

Metal Absorption.additional_info: Iron Hug will steal 10% of your opponent's current armor durability and siphon it back to yourself.
Metal Absorption.desc: Your 'Iron Hug' also absorbs armor from the enemy.

Metal Eater.additional_info: Consumes 30% of your maximum armor on proc, regardless of the Ether cost of the Mantra.
Metal Eater.desc: When you have no ether, consume Armor durability to cast your Ironsing mantras.

Metal Shackles.desc: Guardbreaking an opponent prevents them from receiving speed boost for 5 seconds, while PvE opponents will be Sluggish for 12 seconds.

Metal Thief.additional_info: Steals 2% of your opponent's current armor durability per rod.
Metal Thief.desc: Pulling an opponent absorbs a portion of their current Armor durability.

Meteor Impact.additional_info: Deals 10 flat Flamecharm damage on top of your weapon's scaled damage. Procs by light attacking after using certain Mantras that end with both the user and the victim suspended in the air.
Meteor Impact.desc: Aerial moves you land will follow up into a devastating slam. This is also possible when you yourself gets hit by an aerial move.

Million Ton Piercer.desc: Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits.

Mindspark.additional_info: Your burn damage is increased based on how low your Sanity is.
Mindspark.desc: The damage of your flames scale with how insane you are.

Mirage Clone.additional_info: 20 second cooldown. Causes an Eruption instead if you have Eruption path.
Mirage Clone.desc: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.

Mist Mobility.additional_info: Despite what the description states, this actually procs when you activate Flashboil, and not Boiling Point.
Mist Mobility.desc: Anytime you proc Boiling Point, increase the speed at which you reload your Vapormaw Carbine and increase your Critical Attack's fire rate.

Mocking Favor.additional_info: Grants a random buff or affliction from a set list whenever you spit or use an emote.
Mocking Favor.desc: When taunting, Aelita or Tillian appears, bestowing upon you a random boon of affliction. (30s cooldown)

Molt.additional_info: The duration of Chill, Suffocation, and all potion effects is reduced.
Molt.desc: Ailments and blessings alike fade away more quickly.

Momentum.desc: Speed boosts now give you a bit of extra chip based on how fast the speed boosts are making you.

Monster Slayer.desc: Deal 25% more damage to giant enemies.

Mortar Mystery.additional_info: Each hit landed from your Greatcannon critical aummons a mortar above each target's head. These deal 30 damage each if they land.
Mortar Mystery.desc: [Greatcannon] Landing a greatcannon critical attack summons mysterious cannonballs from above that target your opponent.

Moths to a Flame.additional_info: Puppets will now home in on targets who are burning with either of Twisted Puppets' burn types. When a Puppet gets close to a burning target it speeds up.
Moths to a Flame.desc: You summon a puppet of black flames that homes onto enemies with black flames.

Mothwing Defense.desc: Further refining how sharp your antennae, you can now immediately recognize a sneak attack and brace yourself for it. Reduce all backhit damage by 50%.

Mothwing Dust.additional_info: Upon being hit at the start of combat, cover your opponent in Mothwing Dust, applying a red highlight on your opponent for 10 seconds. This highlight can be seen through walls.
Mothwing Dust.desc: You release Mothwing Dust when others are the first to strike, granting you vision of your attacker. Your antennae improve your peripheral senses, narrowing the angle at which you can be backstabbed.

Moving Fortress.additional_info: Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to -20%.
Moving Fortress.desc: Blocking no longer slows you down as much.

Mudskipper Gripper.desc: When executing an opponent with your critical attack, summon mudskippers to aid you in battle.

Muffled Screams.additional_info: NPCs have a shortened aggro range from gripping allies in proximity. Defiant Until The End and Last Second Negotiations affect your grip speed less.
Muffled Screams.desc: You quieten the cries of help of those you execute, reducing the distance at which their allies will hear it and come to assist, and reducing the effectiveness of Talents that slow your executions.

Murmur: Ardour.additional_info: Drains Ether while active, with the Ether drain scaling inversely with your level and being entirely negated at Power 20. Ardour automatically deactivates if you run out of Ether. Increases the posture damage of M1s and critical attacks with the M1 tag by 20%. Reduces incoming posture damage by 15%. Additionally applies a +15% damage buff to M1s and critical with the M1 tag that guard break.
Murmur: Ardour.desc: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables one to channel the murmur into raw strength. Press H.

Murmur: Rhythm.additional_info: Pings all nearby Monsters, NPCÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s, and Players, through walls while gray-scaling your screen. Red = Low Health, Yellow = Moderate Health, Grey = Healthy.
Murmur: Rhythm.desc: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to perceive the subtle murmur emanating from all things. Press G while crouched.

Murmur: Tacet.additional_info: On use, a sphere around your character will be created. To everyone outside of the sphere, you are invisible. The size of the Tacet sphere scales inversely on your level and your stealth stat, becoming smaller the higher your level and the more stealth you have. In PvE you become effectively invisible to enemies at almost any range. Tacet will deactivate if you: stop crouching for 3 seconds, sprint for 1.5 seconds, use any attack, get hit, or use Soulbreaker's Formless ability. Tacet will be disabled during Hell Mode, Diluvian, and Depths Trials.
Murmur: Tacet.desc: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to suppress their own murmur. Press T while crouched.

Mythic Stability.desc: Players and regular mobs cannot instantly execute you while you're on your feet. Protects you from one instance of instant execution when Unconscious.

Nanji's Training.desc: Nanji shows you a better way to properly block attacks using a weapon, granting you 1 Posture.

Narcissist.additional_info: Overcharms yourself for 4 seconds. Charms yourself for 8 seconds, halved to 4 seconds if you have Disbelief.
Narcissist.desc: Charming an already Charmed opponent Overcharms you briefly. Guess you really were always that great.

Natural Healing.additional_info: "Plants" refers to any plant-based food item.
Natural Healing.desc: Every time you eat plants, heal 2% of your health.

Navae's Connection.desc: All Navaen related combat weapons are empowered.

Navae's Guidance.additional_info: Receive a compass, displayed at the top of your screen, which points East. Right clicking on the map will place a waypoint or change the location of a pre-existing one. Waymarkers can be seen both in the physical world and on the map. The passive hunger loss is reduced.
Navae's Guidance.desc: Navae's star guides your path, showing you the way forward. Right-clicking on maps sets a Waymarker which can be followed. You are less prone to starvation.

Navae's Technique.desc: A passed down technique from generations ago to refine your Ether control. Reduce how much ether it takes to cast mantras by 30%.

Needleblade.additional_info: Replaces your current weapon with the Metal Greatsword for 10 seconds when you Pull an enemy who has 5 Metal Rods on them. The enchantment and quality stars of your original weapon carry over. While Metal Greatsword is equipped, your Metal Armament damage is increased by 50%.
Needleblade.desc: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will use their rods to form a powerful sword to attack with. This also makes your Metal Armament stronger while the weapon is equipped.
Needleblade.reqs: 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY, 90s MTL

Neural Overload.desc: You can input up to 4 copies of each Mantra ingredient instead of being limited to 3.

Neuroplasticity.additional_info: The reduced cost on Mantra modifiers does not apply retroactively to previously modified Mantras until you rejoin.
Neuroplasticity.desc: Your mind is a pliable, flexible substance. The Ether cost of additional modifications to your Mantras is now reduced by 10%.

Night Night.desc: Uppercut attacks blind opponents for 15 seconds.

Night Terror.additional_info: Also procs on weapon criticals. Despite its description, this Talent immediately applies the Fear status for 1 second with no cooldown (they are not required to run away from you).
Night Terror.desc: Your light attacks now proc Fear the Dark.
Night Terror.reqs: 100r LHT OR 100r MED OR 100r HVY, 100s SDW

Nightchild.additional_info: Multiplies all stealth gained by 1.2x. Gain +20% Stealth on spawn.
Nightchild.desc: Relying on your instincts, you are naturally more stealthy. You are more nimble on wooden surfaces.

No Interruptions.additional_info: Grants extremely high damage reduction and true hyperarmor against attacks that are coming from opponents from far away. This requires you to be combat tagged by at least two people. Self-combat tags do not count, but NPC combat tags do (you will still need to be combat tagged by at least one player for this to activate).
No Interruptions.desc: When combat tagged by 2 or more players, render any ranged attack a lot less effective.

No Limits.additional_info: Increases the cap for Bloodless Gem healing to 30. You will need a scaled damage value of 100 to hit the 30 healing cap.
No Limits.desc: Increase the cap on Bloodless Gem healing.

No Survivors.additional_info: Reduces grip time by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster).
No Survivors.desc: Your allies and yourself execute faster when affected by Overcharm.

None Left Behind.desc: You can now shadestep to pick up Unconscious humanoids far away from you.

Not a Scratch.additional_info: Your clothing no longer gets blood splotches and you no longer play low health animations at low health. Your outfit no longer tears when your armor durability is low. Rhythm users can no longer see your health. If you have less than 100 Willpower, your character has a chance to scream in agony upon taking damage.
Not a Scratch.desc: You don't show any signs of damage

Null Recovery.desc: Sacrifice 20% of your hunger bar to recover 10% of your health back.

Nullifying Clarity.additional_info: Procs on Burn, Chill, Shock, Fear, Winded, and Suffocation. Only works on M1s.
Nullifying Clarity.desc: Deal 10% more damage to enemies with elemental status effects, but remove the status on hit.

Oath: Arcwarder.desc: You vow to be a shield for your comrades, to wear your regalia with pride and serve the greater collective. From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs.

Oath: Bladeharper.desc: You vow to carry your blades as an instrument, to lend yourself to any cause it guides you to. Collapse the infinite number of possibilities ahead of you into just one. The blade keeps you as much as you keep it.
Oath: Bladeharper.reqs: LHT + MED + HVY = 90r OR 75r MED, 25r AGL OR 25r STR

Oath: Blightsurger.desc: Fists and storm. Wield sacred lightning, tear through foes and leave them withered.

Oath: Blindseer.additional_info: You can now see while blinded, but the world gains a blue hue.
Oath: Blindseer.desc: You vow to not let the horrors of the world pierce your tightly fastened blindfold. Everything is simply as we choose to perceive it.

Oath: Chainwarden.desc: You vow to be the chain that binds the wicked and drags them back where they belong. There are those in this world who should not be free.

Oath: Contractor.desc: Your heart is forever now eternally tied to Zi'eer, the 4th Prophet of the Ministry. You swear to serve under his will, no matter the cost.

Oath: Dawnwalker.desc: You vow to forever reach towards the brilliant Light. There is no shadow that your radiance cannot expunge.

Oath: Fadetrimmer.desc: You vow to forever hone your precision with the scissors. There will never be another fringe incident again.

Oath: Jetstriker.additional_info: Gain Momentum by sprinting. At maximum Momentum, your Jetstriker Mantras deal 20% more damage.
Oath: Jetstriker.desc: You vow to flow with the Song itself, drifting across where the trails may take you. If the Song permeates everything, then let it be your conduit, and you its master.

Oath: Linkstrider.desc: You vow to give up your own life for the sake of others. Stepping out of the fray, you become a foundation of your allies' strength.

Oath: Oathless.additional_info: Notably, the Oath Armor given by this Talent is affected by PEN and will be nullified if you run out of armor durability. Additionally, due to how resistances work, Oath attacks that have dual damage typings will ignore your Oath armor.
Oath: Oathless.desc: You vow to never be bound to any Oath; to live your life free of restraint. If free will is an illusion, why not make it a convincing one?

Oath: Saintsworn.additional_info: While the Saintsblade is equipped, your Saintsworn Talents will be activated and you can utilize the Blade of Saints Mantra. By using the Saintsblade's critical attack, you can cycle between the Saint Stances. Each Saint Stance is attributed to one of the Attunements, potentially changing the effects of your Saintsworn Talents and altering your Blade of Saints Mantra.
Oath: Saintsworn.desc: A vow to the fallen heroes. Press L to swap to Saintsblade.

Oath: Saltchemist.desc: You vow to dedicate body and mind to the furthering of the Material Arts. Your body is a conduit through which true knowledge shall be siphoned. Knowledge is power, and you shall be its vessel.

Oath: Silentheart.additional_info: If you have any Mantras, they will be unusable and will be entirely invisible. The weapon requirement reduction effect only reduces weapon stat requirements, and not attribute requirements. Additionally, it stacks with Khan's Versatile. Silentheart abilities can proc the Enchantment of your equipped weapon with a 30 second cooldown.
Oath: Silentheart.desc: You vow to reject the Words of the Song, denying yourself of mantras in pursuit of your own path to true strength, no matter the cost. You can wield weapons with 25 points below their usual requirements.
Oath: Silentheart.reqs: 25r STR, LHT + MED + HVY = 75r, 25r AGL OR 25r CHA

Oath: Soulbreaker.additional_info: Your Ardour gains a new visual effect.
Oath: Soulbreaker.desc: The sum of your fragments is greater than the whole. Though your very being is splintered and threatening to drift apart, every shard of you Vows to remain One. Your Oath is a solvent that joins all of your distinct selves into the gestalt you.

Oath: Starkindred.desc: You vow to feel the knowledge of all that is, all at once. Your heart beats with the world itself, as the Stars above watch over you.

Oath: Visionshaper.desc: You vow to only see that which you wish to see. Reality itself is malleable, pliable to your deft hands.

Observation.additional_info: Cancelling your roll quickly will grant dodge frames equals to the length of a regular roll. Basically giving extra 0.1s dodge frames.
Observation.desc: Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately.

Off Your Game.desc: You now slow Taunted enemies when you hit them.

Offensive Recovery.additional_info: If all of your equipped Mantras have a Might Gem equipped, hitting your opponent's block with Mantras will restore your posture.
Offensive Recovery.desc: If all your mantras have Might Gems equipped, lose posture any time you hit opponents block with a mantra.

Officer's Slash.desc: You now gain an additional critical attack with Authority armory weaponry while your regular critical attack is on cooldown.

Officer's Training.desc: While using a Sword or Rapier, take 30% less posture damage from criticals.

Oh The Irony.desc: Opponents affected by 'Taunt' receive double iron rods for the duration.

Old Habits Die Hard.desc: Blocking an attack with your lingering block frames after failing a parry will cause the attack to deal 15% less posture damage.

Omen.desc: Your Shadow Travel now has no windup and always requires health to teleport.

One With Flame.additional_info: These effects only apply while you are burning. Also turns your Medium Weapon Mantras orange and adds Flamecharm scaling to your Belief while active.
One With Flame.desc: When equipping a Worshipper Longsword and Worshipper Shield, you take 25% less damage while on fire and every mantra you use sets enemies on fire.

Open Wound.desc: Guardbreaking enemies leaves enemies more susceptible to blood loss from Bloodrend mantras.

Oppressive Force.additional_info: The first hit deals your regular M1 damage and posture damage, the second hit deals 80% of your weapon's scaled damage with 7 posture damage. The damage and posture damage of the second hit cannot be buffed. The second hit does not count as a weapon attack, and therefore it does not benefit from any of your weapon's stats and cannot proc Talent effects.
Oppressive Force.desc: When using a weapon found in the Merit Armory, gain a unique two-hit flourish that does not knock back opponents and dazes them.

Orb Discharge.desc: If an extra orb is available, you can consume it to vent if you don't have enough tempo.

Orbital Ice.additional_info: 90 second cooldown. Durability of Orbital Ice is equal to "Frostdraw investment +10".
Orbital Ice.desc: When landing a parry while standing on ice, automatically forms a gravitational ring of ice that absorbs 15% of the physical damage you take. The ring breaks after sustaining a certain amount of damage. (Scales with Frostdraw)

Osseous Surge.additional_info: Press right click within a 10 second window after landing a flourish to stomp and send a wave of bones in the direction you're facing. This deals high damage and sends your opponent upwards.
Osseous Surge.desc: Flourishing an enemy enhances your boots for 10 seconds, allowing you to spawn a wave of bones in the way you're facing. Right click to activate this.

Overcharge.additional_info: Lightning Dashes increase your dash distance travelled by 2.3x and the duration of i-frames from rolling, but will end early if you attack.
Overcharge.desc: Your next dash after activating Static Blade is enhanced by lightning.

Overdrive.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that doubles the damage of your Mantras for 10 seconds. 3 minute cooldown.
Overdrive.desc: Go beyond your limits. All mantras you cast deal twice as much damage for 10 seconds.

Overflow.desc: Increase the amount of tempo you receive when landing light attacks by 50%.

Overflowing Dam.additional_info: For every point of Intelligence below 40, Overflowing Dam's damage bonus will be reduced by 0.125%, having a minimum damage buff of 6.875% at 15 Intelligence.
Overflowing Dam.desc: Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage.

Overwhelming Drain.desc: If multiple enemies are hit by your Shadow Eruption, they are dazed.

Overwhelming Might.desc: Strong Left now guard breaks at level 5.

Overwhelming Stability.desc: Landing a Both Ends staff strike will now instantly proc insanity debuffs onto your opponent. The damage from insanity procs is further increased the greater the difference there is between you and your opponents [5 sec CD]

Pace.additional_info: Grants damage reduction based on the combined potency on all speed boosts you have. Landing attacks grants a speed boost.
Pace.desc: Hitting opponents apply a speed boost. The faster you are the less damage you take.

Pack Mule.additional_info: Stacks with the Boon of the same name, increasing the maximum amount of food items you can carry in one stack from 10 to 20.
Pack Mule.desc: The max quantity for food you can hold is increased by 5.

Padded Armor.additional_info: The 3% Blunt Armor is multiplicative with other sources of Blunt resistance.
Padded Armor.desc: While your armor is broken (or if you have no armor), you take 5% less damage.

Paired Soul.additional_info: Katana deals 25% more damage. Alloyed Katana, Shattered Katana, and Purple Cloud deal 5% more damage. This is a damage modifier.
Paired Soul.desc: Wielding a katana with this outfit grants extra damage.

Panacea.desc: Hitting an enemy with a Bloodrend mantra stops their blood poison from decaying briefly.

Pardon Me.additional_info: Guards will not aggro onto you if you perform a crime in their territory if you have neutral or higher reputation with the faction.
Pardon Me.desc: Crimes you commit in allied territories are often ignored. Who's asking?

Parting Gift.additional_info: On proc, all dual gun M1s within the next 5 seconds have projectiles.
Parting Gift.desc: After you land a flourish, gain the ability to shoot bullets for 5 seconds. [Dual Gun]

Pastry Platter.additional_info: This cannot give the Brain, Scale, Strength, or Throat food buffs.
Pastry Platter.desc: Guardbreaking your opponent with a critical attack gives you a random non-boss food buff for 30 seconds.

Perfect Flash.desc: Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away.

Peripheral Vision.desc: Your glare now ignores if your opponent is facing you.

Perpetual Distillery.additional_info: Upon using the Distillery's Talent tool, you're given three empty spaces where you input your potions. You're able to switch the mode from "Throw" to "Drink", and vice versa. Each potion in the Distillery will be given as a Talent tool, using the potion on use. Potions in the Distillery go on cooldown when used. Drink potions place other drink slots on a cooldown if they share buffs.
Perpetual Distillery.desc: Your very body has become a distillery for your alchemy. Gain 3 Autobrew slots that will automatically produce 3 concoctions of your choice.

Perpetual Wrath.additional_info: Enchaining targets and hitting Chained targets with Restrain will add 1 stack of Perpetual Wrath. Each stack of Perpetual Wrath increases Restrain's (Mantra) damage by 8, capping out at 4 stacks for +32 damage.
Perpetual Wrath.desc: Unleash the true power of Restrain. Each successive hit will increase its damage. stacking up to the base damage.

Perseverance.additional_info: This can stack with other Talents to reduce knock time even further. (Ex. Defiance)
Perseverance.desc: Reduces the duration you're Ragdolled and Unconscious for by 25%.

Phantom.additional_info: Your weapon attacks that bypass block apply shaky block.
Phantom.desc: For the next 5 seconds, your next basic attack bypasses block after landing a crit. [45 second CD]

Phantom Edge.desc: Your weapon Basic Attacks have +0.25 range.

Phantom Step.additional_info: Additionally grants a speed boost for the full duration. While active, your Spectral Gauge will be passively drained.
Phantom Step.desc: Press X to begin running at high speeds and your regular dashes transform into gale dashes. (Must have at least 10% Spectral Gauge)

Phoenix Flames.additional_info: Healing scales on your Flamecharm investment; heals 25% health at 0 Flamecharm and scales up to 50% health at 75 Flamecharm, gaining 0.33% healing per point in Flamecharm. If you used Flame Within while knocked to proc Phoenix Flames, then the healing received will be halved.
Phoenix Flames.desc: Any time you would burn to death, you instead rise again with 50% of your health restored. Has a 60 second cooldown.

Phoenix Impact.additional_info: Heals 4% max HP and restores 20 ether.
Phoenix Impact.desc: If you Meteor Slam an opponent whilst on fire, restore some HP and Ether.

Pickpocket.additional_info: You can only pickpocket Unconscious targets. Gain +0.0002% PvE damage for every 1 Note you have; grants +3% damage at 15,000 Notes.
Pickpocket.desc: Gain the ability to pickpocket by pressing N. Deal a little more damage the more notes you have against PvE opponents as well.

Pierce Through.additional_info: The default spear critical attack no longer cancels if the first hit is parried. Additionally, parrying the first hit of this critical does not provide autoparry frames.
Pierce Through.desc: Remove the autoparry frames the first hit of your base spear critical has.

Piercing Blow.additional_info: If you do not have 100 Strength, this Talent will instead halve your opponent's armor resistances multiplicatively, before PEN on proc.
Piercing Blow.desc: Attacks that break an opponent's block ignore their Armor resistances.

Piercing Metal.additional_info: Each rod increases armor damage dealt through weapon attacks and Mantras by 5%. This does not affect armor drain effects such as the Metal enchantment.
Piercing Metal.desc: Deal additional armor damage to enemies per metal rod affecting them.

Piercing Shot.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool, that on use, enhances your next critical attack used with any Rifle or Pistol. Enhanced critical attacks gain 100% chip damage and apply the Pierced Armor status effect to your opponent, increasing incoming PEN for a few seconds.
Piercing Shot.desc: Activate to make your next critical attack with any gun have 100% chip and shatter your opponent's armor for a few seconds, making them take increased PEN from all sources.

Piercing Will.additional_info: Grants 5% PEN at 35% Sanity, scaling up to 15% PEN at 0% Sanity.
Piercing Will.desc: When your sanity is below 35%, gain up to +15% PEN on your attacks. Starting at 5% PEN, the lower your sanity, the higher your PEN.

Placebo Effect.additional_info: Also procs potion sickness, causing allies to throw up upon usage if they've ingested a potion recently.
Placebo Effect.desc: Drinking potions near allies will share the potion's effect with them.

Pleeksty's Faith.additional_info: Does not proc with flames produced by the user with Flame Within or Agitating Spark.
Pleeksty's Faith.desc: When on fire, automatically quench flames at the cost of some ether.

Pleeksty's Inheritance.additional_info: Makes your Flamecharm Mantras extremely loud.
Pleeksty's Inheritance.desc: You inherit the teachings of Amorus Pleeksty, augmenting your flamecharm mantras.

Pleeksty's Will.additional_info: Consuming Gale Stones, Heartstars, Dying Embers, Spark Glands, and Frigid Prisms gives significantly more Ether.
Pleeksty's Will.desc: You gain significantly more ether from consuming elemental ingredients.

Pleetsky's Wrath.additional_info: Spawns swords from the sky, similarly to First Light's critical attack.
Pleetsky's Wrath.desc: After dealing 500 damage with Flame Mantras, call forth a hail of fiery swords.

Pocket Bombs.additional_info: On proc, this consumes 1 Iron Bomb to drop 2 bombs at your feet. This has a 1 second cooldown, with the cooldown activating any time you take damage, even if the effect did not proc.
Pocket Bombs.desc: You have a chance to activate a bomb in your inventory when damaged

Pocket Sand.desc: [Fist] Feinting into an uppercut blinds, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and also applies Dazed briefly. We're even now, right? 30s cooldown

Poisoned Knife.desc: Your Deepwound's anti heal now lasts 60 seconds on assassination instead of 20.

Polished Armor.additional_info: The damage reduction of Polished Armor is increased by 0.05% per Ironsing investment, granting 8.75% damage reduction at requirements.
Polished Armor.desc: You receive 5% less damage when your Armor protects you from an attack and has over 90% durability. This 5% will scale up to 10% less damage at 100 MTL.

Polite Awakening.desc: Recover 15% of your max health after getting up from being downed. (Only Procs when below 20% HP)

Possession.additional_info: The chip damage buff only applies to Galebreathe Mantras.
Possession.desc: After an apparition hits an enemy, receive 7.5% posture damage on all Galebreathe attacks for 8 seconds. If the apparition hits while you have Phantom Step active, receive a 7.55% chip damage buff for 6 seconds.

Potion Quaffer.additional_info: Drink potions 30% faster. Increases the effectiveness of Health Regeneration potions by 15%, Sanity Restoration and Ether Regeneration potions by 30%, and removes the -25% effectiveness Instant Health potions have.
Potion Quaffer.desc: You're accustomed to drinking toxic fluids quickly. You'll get along famously with the other patrons at the tavern. Drinking potions slows less and grants superior regenerative effects to you.

Praise The Sun.desc: When standing in sunlight increase your natural health regen and reduce how long antiheal effects last on you.

Preceding Chill.additional_info: If the user has Crystallization, this Talent no longer freezes but instead causes crystals to explode.
Preceding Chill.desc: Enemies hit during the last moments of your ice beam are frozen.

Precise Swing.additional_info: Procs even if your critical is parried or blocked. The Precise Swing status effect will be lost should your next M1 land or get parried. This is additive with all other sources of Chip Damage.
Precise Swing.desc: After landing a critical your next basic attack will gain 25% chip past your opponent's block.

Precision Crusher.desc: Landing a charged shot will knock your opponent down instead of back.

Precision Hitter.desc: Your Basic Attack posture damage is increased by 15%.

Pressure Bleed.desc: Your vents turn pink, spraying explosive Black Blood puddles that ignite enemies.

Pressure Break.desc: Breaking an enemy's posture will cause them to take intense wind pressure, increasing the attack's damage by +25% and flinging the enemy backwards.

Pressure Detonation.additional_info: If the user has the Apparitions Talent, this can proc apparitions by inflicting suffocation.
Pressure Detonation.desc: Block breaking an opponent with a Shadow mantra generates a small vacuum that suffocates those hit and steals their Tempo.

Pressure Skewer.additional_info: Increases blood bar damage by 50% and grants +25% Chip damage while active. These bonuses apply to M1s and criticals with the M1 tag.
Pressure Skewer.desc: [Rapier] Flourishing an enemy causes your M1's to deal additional chip damage, blood loss and makes your hits deal 3 extra true damage until you take damage.

Pressure Strike.desc: [Staffs] Reduce Both Ends' staff strike base damage by 50%, but double its posture damage. Guardbreaking an opponent with a Both Ends staff strike adds an extra 20 damage to the attack.

Primal Rage.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used when you are under 50% health. While buffed, your hits will showcase the health percentage of your opponent. Additionally, gain a 25% damage buff for the duration of the effect. 3 minute cooldown.
Primal Rage.desc: If you are below 50%, unleash your rage and increase the amount of damage you deal for 25 seconds as well as being able to see enemy health when you hit them.

Prime Ether Bullets.additional_info: True Ether Bullets now procs in 2 hits instead of 3. Adds 1.2 Intelligence scaling to your Pistols.
Prime Ether Bullets.desc: Your bullets take one less hit to proc elemental effects and now have slight intelligence scaling. [Dual Gun]

Prince of the Wind.desc: You are the one who the wind bends around. Your galebreathe is enhanced.

Proficient Baiting.additional_info: Reduces the likelihood of fishing up trash items such as Seaweed or Leather Boots.
Proficient Baiting.desc: Casting your line excites ocean life, reducing the chances of fishing up trash.

Propagandist.desc: Your Sing will now stir your allies into a frenzy, causing them to become Overcharmed for 15s, applying Charmed to enemies they hit with Basic Attacks.

Protagonist Syndrome.additional_info: Increases your Dawnwalker Mantra damage by 30% after being hit by Shadowcast damage. This cannot be self procced by using Shade Devour.
Protagonist Syndrome.desc: The grasp of shadow is meaningless in the face of your blinding light. Your Dawnwalker mantras are empowered after getting hit by Shadowcast.

Pugnacious.additional_info: Gain various stacking buffs scaling on the amount of combat tags you have. Gain a further damage buff upon executing a player. On basic attack, gain +10% to the following stats: damage, posture damage, elemental damage resistance, physical damage resistance, chip damage, and speed boost per combat tag you have. The damage, posture damage, and chip damage effects ignore the modifier caps but cap at +30%. The resistance bonuses are multiplicative to other sources of their respective resistance types. The speed boost has no cap in effectiveness.
Pugnacious.desc: Become stronger the more you are combat tagged. Gain even more strength whenever you grip a player.

Punishing Blow.additional_info: If you M1 your opponent during their M1 animation, they will be dazed for 1 second. Also procs if you land a critical with the M1 tag during their M1 animation.
Punishing Blow.desc: [Heavy Weapons] Daze opponents for 1s and Stagger PvE enemies for 2s when you interrupt their Basic Attack / actions with your own.

Punishing Riposte.additional_info: After parrying a guard break, gain the Punishing Riposte status effect for 15 seconds, making your critical guaranteed guardbreak if it hits block.
Punishing Riposte.desc: When parrying a guardbreak, enhance your critical for the next 4 seconds. If you land your crit on your opponent's block while it is enhanced, immediately guardbreak your opponent.

Purge Shot.additional_info: Landing Arc Beam removes all stacks of anti-heal from your opponent, dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had.
Purge Shot.desc: Landing an arc beam while your opponent has anti heal stacks purges the stacks, with it dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had.

Pursuit.additional_info: Procs even if Revenge is blocked, parried, dodged, or vented. For every point in Agility below 90, Pursuit will gain +0.375 seconds to its cooldown, capping at 29.4 seconds with 65 Agility.
Pursuit.desc: If you land your Revenge, clear the cooldown immediately. (25s cooldown)

Pyreborne.additional_info: Increases the base damage of all Flamecharm Mantras by 30%.
Pyreborne.desc: Your Flamecharm mantras have all stats amplified.

Quick Swap.desc: Massively reduce your bullet swap cooldown. [Dual Gun]

Quickdraw.additional_info: Allows the user to instantly start attacking with their offhand gun after attacking with their main weapon.
Quickdraw.desc: Allows you to fire your offhand gun right after swinging. [Not necessary on dual guns]

Rage Amp.desc: At 2 or more combat tags, your critical now applies anti-heal while also increases the size and damage of your critical. This scales with the amount of combat tags you have.

Rage Bait.additional_info: On proc, steam will visually come out of your opponent's head, and a high-pitched angry growl sound effect will play. Goes on cooldown when the Mantra is blocked, not when the Talent initially procs. Also procs on allies. Rage Bait's duration is equal to: (Charisma + Willpower) × 0.12. At requirements, this has a 15.6s duration.
Rage Bait.desc: Proccing manipulator now enrages opponents, causing their mantras to deal 10% more damage. Anytime you block their enraged mantras however, laugh in their face causing extreme mental damage, dealing 1% of their max health. [5 sec CD]

Rain of Static.additional_info: When casting Lightning Impact, hover above the ground and fire multiple projectiles. Afterward, you strike down normally.
Rain of Static.desc: After successfully casting lightning impact, strike down countless thunder at those below. In return your Lightning Impact will require more time to cast.

Rapid Fire.additional_info: The Rapid Fire status effect entirely removes your Pistol critical cooldown for its duration, allowing you to spam it. Procs on dodge, block, and hit.
Rapid Fire.desc: [1H Guns] When you land a critical shot, gain Rapid Fire for 2s. 12s Cooldown.

Rapid Reload.additional_info: Reduces the total time taken to reload a pistol from empty by 0.1 seconds.
Rapid Reload.desc: [1H Guns] You have 20% faster reload when reloading an empty pistol

Rat's Spirit.additional_info: Being combat tagged by 2 or more players will cause your critical attack to deal an additional 10 true damage per hit. This scales on how many combat tags you have, gaining +10 damage per.
Rat's Spirit.desc: Each hit of your critical will deal an extra 10 true damage per combat tag whenever you are combat tagged by 2 or more people.

Ready or Not.desc: The first attack to hit you while out of combat has its damage cut in half.

Reality Shift.additional_info: Your last used Mantra or critical attack will be stored in your clones when you summon them. Using the Reality Shift Talent tool or hotkey will perform the stored action.
Reality Shift.desc: Command the closest conjured servant to attack their hallucinating target, either using a Critical Attack or a Mantra.

Rebuke in Stasis.additional_info: Your Punishment will apply bottom freeze to mobs if you land the counter hit.
Rebuke in Stasis.desc: Bottom freeze enemies nearby when countering with Punishment, freezes mobs affected when re-casted.

Reclaimed Glass.additional_info: The duration of this effect is refreshable by reproccing it.
Reclaimed Glass.desc: Your Crystal Shrapnel explosions now grant you and any allies caught in them 10% Elemental Resistance for 10 seconds.

Refine and Reuse.desc: Consuming rods with Scrapsinger reduces incoming PEN against you for 14 seconds. Each rod reduces PEN by 5% multiplicatively.

Reforged Alloy.desc: Anytime you consume iron rods using Metal Pull or any Rending Needle technique, reduce the cooldown of your next critical based on the amount of rods consumed.

Refreeze.desc: Landing any sort of ability that causes bottom freeze reduces the cooldown of your Orbital Ice by 20 seconds.

Reinforced Armor.additional_info: Loses 0.8% PEN resistance per point below 90 Fortitude, capping at 10% PEN resistance at 65 Fortitude.

Relentless Barrage.additional_info: Your Rapid Punches posture damage per hit scales on the amount of hits landed/blocked. At max Calamity Punch stacks, gain hyperarmor during Rapid Punches.
Relentless Barrage.desc: Every swing from Rapid Punches deals more posture than the last. At max punch stacks enables hyperarmor during the barrage.

Relentless Hunt.additional_info: 20s CD per weapon type, 6s CD if feinted. Movesets differ depending on weapon type. The Light Weapon variant hits twice if it is enhanced by Flow State.
Relentless Hunt.desc: M1 while doing an Aerial Attack to initiate a special gap closer attack.

Rending Impact.additional_info: Only procs on guardbreaks from weapon attacks. Applies knockdown for 1.2s.
Rending Impact.desc: [Greataxes] Block breaking an enemy applies knockdown.

Rending Needle: Conductor.additional_info: Upon applying 5 Metal Rods to a target, the Rods will converge into a Conductor Rod. Conductor Rods cannot be pulled. If an enemy affected by a Conductor Rod casts a Mantra, they will lose 5% of their maximum armor, and if that Mantra was a non-Ironsing/Bloodrend elemental Mantra, they will be afflicted with their Attunement's status effect, causing the Rod to fall off. Conductor Rods last 30 seconds or until a non-Ironsing/Bloodrend elemental Mantra is cast.
Rending Needle: Conductor.desc: 5 metal rods will combine into a conductor rod. If an enemy uses a non-Ironsing elemental mantra, they're dealt with their element back in return.

Rending Needle: Impaler.additional_info: Increases the Metal Rod cap from 5 to 10. You can no longer use Metal Pull unless the target has at least 5 rods. Your Metal Pull now deals damage, with the damage scaling based on the amount of Rods applied. Impaler Rods individually have a base damage of 4, with 5 Ironsing scaling, gaining 0.02 damage per Ironsing investment. This will deal 5.5 damage per rod at 75 Ironsing and 6 damage per rod at 100 Ironsing.
Rending Needle: Impaler.desc: If an enemy is affected by 5 or more metal rods, your Ironsing Pull instead pulls out all of the rods for massive damage.

Rending Needle: Jailer.additional_info: Increases the Metal Rod cap from 5 to 10, and you can no longer use Metal Pull unless the target has at least 5 rods. Metal Pull now stuns targets for 1.08s, and an additional 0.104s for every additional rod after the fifth (to a maximum of 1.6s). A stunned target has 30% damage reduction.
Rending Needle: Jailer.desc: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will restrain them instead of pulling them.

Repeated Blows.additional_info: This has no cooldown, theoretically allowing you to infinitely reset the cooldown of your Strength Mantras.
Repeated Blows.desc: Any strength mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it will reset its cooldown if you land a critical while a Wrath Gem is active.

Repeated Propulsion.desc: Reduce the cooldown of Dancing Steps and Graceful Steps to 1 second.

Replenishing Knockout.additional_info: Knocking enemies will replenish 1.5x more of your health and posture (50% -> 75%).
Replenishing Knockout.desc: You gain more health and posture from downing enemies.

Reshape and Remold.additional_info: Increases the armor drain effect of your rods by 25%, from 2% drain to 2.5%.
Reshape and Remold.desc: Successful procs of Scrapsinger will increase the amount of armor damage your opponent takes. After hitting 10 stacks, the opponent will take +5% damage until the stacks drop below 10.

Residual Fury.desc: [In Berserk State] Landing your critical grants +50% PEN on Basic Attacks for 8s.

Resolve Crusher.additional_info: Resolve Crusher's "Electrified" effect is only applied after the 5th stack (not the 4th stated by the Talent). Each stack lasts for 5 seconds. Electrified lasts for 5 seconds. Damage debuff only applies against weapon attacks.
Resolve Crusher.desc: Lightning moves now apply stacks of "Resolve Crusher". At 4 stacks, you apply "Electrified" to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you.

Retrograde.additional_info: Gain a Talent tool that records your location, health, Ether, and posture on use. Upon using the tool again or waiting 5 seconds, you will be transferred back to your original location, restoring you back to the state and location you were at when this tool was initially used.
Retrograde.desc: Your existence is... questionable. No one understands where you have come from. Your ability reflects this, activate to start your Retrograde timer. Activating the ability again will reverse your actions, with the cooldown scaling with the time.

Return to the Stone Ages.desc: Using the Table Flip mantra now turns the projectile into a larger boulder. Landing your Critical Attack enhances this further, giving you an even bigger and stronger boulder.

Reveal.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that activates True Strength on use. While active, you will passively accumulate Wither. Reveal will automatically end if your health goes below 10%.
Reveal.desc: Pour your heart out, and reveal your true strength.

Reverse Leech.additional_info: Behind You is procced by landing a basic attack behind your enemy after feinting a Mantra.
Reverse Leech.desc: Anytime you proc Behind You, steal ether from your opponent too.

Reverse Necrosis.desc: Landing any mantra will now heal you based on how slow your opponent is.

Righteous Crash.desc: Slamming down your opponent in the air with a flourish or your upgraded Vanguard Jus Karita critical deals extra true damage based on high up in the air they were.

Righteous Rage.additional_info: Temporary Health does not count for this effect.
Righteous Rage.desc: [In Berserk State] You deal increased damage the lower your health is.

Righteous Violence.desc: Landing a Critical Attack heals your marked ally. Landing a Jus Karita critical or Karita Swap heals your marked ally even more.

Riot Breaker.desc: You receive 15% less posture damage and deal 10% more posture damage when under attack by 3 or more enemies.

Riot Shield.additional_info: Grants 40% damage reduction to chip damage, does not reduce your opponent's chip % by 40.
Riot Shield.desc: While you are fighting two or more opponents and are using a shield, reduce the total amount of chip damage you take by 40%.

Rip and Tear.desc: Regain health upon defeating an enemy.

Rising Star.additional_info: 12s CD per weapon type, 4s CD if feinted. Procs all "on Uppercut" Talents. Movesets differ depending on weapon type.
Rising Star.desc: Press CTRL + M2 to activate a special uppercut attack.

Risky Defense.additional_info: Increases incoming posture damage from Mantras by 50%. Decreases incoming posture damage from weapon attacks by 25%.
Risky Defense.desc: Decrease how much posture damage you take from physical attacks by 25%, but take 50% more posture damage from mantras.

Risky Moves.additional_info: Attacking will cancel the effect early. 20 second cooldown.
Risky Moves.desc: When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack.

Robber Baron.additional_info: Lose 25% of your non-Soulbound/Enchanted items on death instead of 50%. You no longer lose Notes on death.
Robber Baron.desc: You hold onto more items when defeated.

Rock Blaster.desc: Doubles your ore yields when mining.

Rogue Assassin.desc: Your assassinations now deal an extra 50 true damage (200 in PvE).

Rosen's Technique.additional_info: Reduces the cooldown of Tactical Reload by 45 seconds; from 90 seconds to 45.
Rosen's Technique.desc: If you use Tactical Reload, Rosen's Peacemaker has 45 seconds less off its cooldown.

Rotten Regeneration.additional_info: Grants a 20% buff to all sources of offensive healing, such as Bloodless Gems, when targeting enemies who are afflicted with Anti-Heal.
Rotten Regeneration.desc: Heal 20% more off enemies who have anti-heal on them.

Royal Charge.additional_info: Running attacks with Club weapons grant Temporary Health. 20 second cooldown.
Royal Charge.desc: When landing a running attack while using a club to gain a bit of temp health.

Ruinous Recovery.desc: Enemies recover 15% less Posture when parrying. Guardbreaking an enemy by parrying them deals massive damage, and can be done against even the strongest of foes.

Rule Through Fear.desc: Executing an enemy applies Overcharm to nearby allies and yourself.

Rush Hour.additional_info: Use the Rush Hour tool to gain the Rush Hour status effect, granting a 30% speed boost, a 15% damage buff, and an increase to blood damage. This passively drains the user's health and blood while active. Recover 5% blood whenever you land an attack.
Rush Hour.desc: Stab yourself to become stronger, faster, and deal increased blood bar damage.

Rush of Ancients.additional_info: Extends your dash distance and makes you invisible for a very brief duration when you dash.
Rush of Ancients.desc: Dashing at maximum sprint momentum makes you one with the wind itself.

Sable Winds.additional_info: Inhale bonuses now apply to Shadowcast Mantras as well.
Sable Winds.desc: You can now Inhale Shadowcast mantras. Aftercut effects now drain a small amount of ether based on the damage they deal.

Sacred Aura.desc: Landing your Sacred Hammer critical attack applies an aura of protection around you, reducing the damage you take by a flat 2.5, multiplying based on how many combat tags you currently have on you.

Sacrificial Boon.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that consumes 10 Knowledge on use, not 5, to grant the user a random buff within a set pool. This has a 5 second cooldown, potentially allowing you to stack the buffs. Potential buffs are: 20% damage buff, hyperarmor for 10 seconds, instantly heal 50 health, stomach and thirst restoration, or a speed boost for 10 seconds. Executing a player with the Ritual Sacrifice awards 50 Knowledge.
Sacrificial Boon.desc: Sacrifice 5 knowledge to activate Blessing, giving you a random blessing from Navae.

Sadistic Split.desc: Guardbreaking your opponent now heals you. The amount of this heal is based on how much insanity your character currently has.

Safety Dance.desc: Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s.

Safety First.desc: At the start of fights, gain 25% damage resistance for 30 seconds.

Saint Jay.additional_info: You can only steal non-passive healing. On Crystal Path, applying a Crystal will proc Saint Jay for 2 seconds. You cannot steal healing that you apply.
Saint Jay.desc: When a Chilled enemy receives a heal, it's nullified and 60% of the healing is redirected to you. While this is active and they are on ice your rate of healing is increased, raise your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.

Saint's Negation.additional_info: Allows you to fully negate the damage of one attack that has a damage type that corresponds with your current Saint Stance. Can only proc once per full cycle, meaning you'll have to fully cycle through all of the Stances before you can proc it again.
Saint's Negation.desc: Once per stance cycle you can fully block an attack that matches your Saint Stance.

Saint's Overload.additional_info: Increases your Attunement investment scaling by 15% and the effects of your Mantra modifiers by 10% for a few seconds after performing a full rotation of Saint stances. You'll need to fully cycle through all of the Stances before you can proc this effect again.
Saint's Overload.desc: After a full rotation of stances your elemental scaling is increased by 15% and Mantra Modifiers increased by 10%.

Saint's Synergy.additional_info: 15% of the investment scaling from your highest Attuned stat is added to your other Attuned Mantras, granting them slight dual scaling.
Saint's Synergy.desc: 15% of your highest element scaling is applied to other elemental damage.

Sanguine Siphon.additional_info: Grants a 20% damage buff to the next Mantra cast.
Sanguine Siphon.desc: Landing a critical attack while in a blood pool will consume that pool and empower your next blood mantra.

Scales of the Edenkite.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that lasts 5 seconds with a 3 minute cooldown. The deaggro effect only works in PvE, and is extremely ineffective, as most enemies will immediately reaggro. The deaggro effect does not work against bosses or in Depths Trials.
Scales of the Edenkite.desc: In order to resolve conflict in Lumen, you need to be able to handle any situation thrown at you. Activate your Scales to reduce all damage taken by 80% and de-aggro enemies briefly.

Scammer.desc: If your opponent tries to parry the fake hit of your critical attack, your critical attack will inflict a stronger daze upon your opponent.

Scaredy Cat.desc: When enemies initiate a fight first, gain a speed boost.

Scholar's Intuition.desc: INT, WILL, and CHA Training Gear is 50% more effective.

Scholar's Mark.additional_info: You can now use Capra Marks to buff yourself.
Scholar's Mark.desc: You now are able to inflict yourself with a Mark. The duration of this scales with how many people you inflict with the effect as well.

Sclerosteosis.desc: Anytime you lose 10% of your health in one hit, reduce the next instance of damage you take by 99%. [5 sec CD]

Scorchblood.additional_info: Deals 16.5 damage in an AoE on proc.
Scorchblood.desc: Guardbreaking your opponent using a bloodrend mantra causes a blood explosion, setting your opponent on fire and poisoning their blood.

Scorched Peak.additional_info: Deals 10 Thundercall damage on hit. "On fire" refers to the Burn status effect. This can proc Grounding Bolt.
Scorched Peak.desc: Blockbreaking an enemy on fire or with a fire mantra causes them to be struck by lightning.

Scorching Decay.additional_info: Increases the Wither applied from Emperor Flame from 25 to 75.
Scorching Decay.desc: The wither dealt from your Emperor's Flame is massively increased.
Scorching Decay.reqs: 100r LHT OR 100r MED OR 100r HVY, 100s FLM

Scornful Scowl.desc: Your Glare stuns enemies for much longer.

Seaborne.additional_info: Ship purchase price is reduced by 20%, ships turn 20% faster, and have 10% more health. Repairing a ship with a Repair Hammer takes less time.
Seaborne.desc: You have a keen understanding of ships and their maintenance.

Seamaster's Guile.additional_info: Your boat will take 25% less damage if the person piloting it has this Talent.
Seamaster's Guile.desc: While you're at the helm of a ship, it takes 25% less damage

Second Interrogation.additional_info: Does not stack with Resolve Crusher's damage reduction, instead it replaces it with this, more potent, effect. Only applies against weapon attacks.
Second Interrogation.desc: Electrified attacks do 50% less damage and posture damage to you.

Serpent's Dance.additional_info: This critical deals 1x of your weapon's scaled damage. This critical can only be used on Cestus that do not have a unique critical.
Serpent's Dance.desc: Unleash the power of Fang and Coil to unlock a devastating Running Critical Attack, feint to cancel momentum.

Shadow Overflow.additional_info: Has a 4 second cooldown. Deals 5 Shadowcast damage on proc.
Shadow Overflow.desc: Extra ether stolen with mantras are exerted as dark energy, damaging and absorbing ether from those nearby.

Shadow Travel.additional_info: Deals 0.25 self damage per stud teleported. This can kill you if you don't have enough health to survive the teleport. If your teleport distance is less than 300 studs, you will not take self damage. Drains 100 Ether on use, with each stud travelled increasing this Ether cost by 0.2. The maximum distance you can travel is based on your Ether.
Shadow Travel.desc: Teleport to a location in exchange for Ether cost. Certain ranges will require a health sacrifice. Be careful as this technique can prove lethal to the user.

Shadowcast Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Shadowcast Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Shadowcast Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Shadowcast to its fullest.

Shadowcaster.desc: Grants you the ability to command shadows as a Shadowcaster.

Shaper Mimicry.additional_info: Your clones will also Vent when you Vent. This can trigger even if you do not have Tempo or if you press G while in an animation.
Shaper Mimicry.desc: The servants you have conjured will imitate your actions when you Swing/Block/Parry/Jump.

Shared Misery.additional_info: If you are actively losing sanity or have used Heretic's Sutra in the past 15 seconds, remove 3% of the target's maximum sanity, scaled down if you have less than 85 Willpower.
Shared Misery.desc: Using a Basic Attack/Critical Attack on an enemy while losing sanity causes them to lose sanity.

Sharing is Caring.desc: Your 'Charm' on opponents also slightly increases your blood drain against them.

Sharpened Dagger.additional_info: This applies to attacks used against your opponent's back, not assassinations.
Sharpened Dagger.desc: All backstabs deal 1 extra true damage (4 extra damage if done to PvE).

Shatter.additional_info: Landing a critical attack removes all speed debuffs your opponent has, dealing 5 Frostdraw damage per debuff.
Shatter.desc: Landing a critical shatters your opponent, ridding them of their speed debuffs for 5 frost damage per debuff.

Shattering Left.additional_info: Turns your Strong Left and Wind-Up enhanced attacks into guaranteed guardbreaks against blocking NPCs.
Shattering Left.desc: Your Strong Left and Wind-up punches will always guard break mobs.

Shield Breaker.desc: Blunt damage now fully ignores the posture bonus from shields.

Shock Trooper Specialist.additional_info: Upon meeting a damage threshold, create a Stormcall Strike. The Storm Strikes deal 40 Thundercall damage and can proc Grounding Bolt. Additionally, your Electro Carve, Grand Javelin, and Thunder Kick become green, and your Astral Wind, Champion's Whirlthrow, and Gale Lunge become yellow. All of the aforementioned Mantras have their base damage increased by 15%.
Shock Trooper Specialist.desc: Empower the mantras taught to you by your Legion Specialist Captain. You also now conjure a storm strike on your opponent by landing Gale and Thundercall mantras.

Shocking Finish.desc: Following a flourish up with a lightning beam causes it to be casted instantly.

Shocking Reverb.additional_info: You need to reach a threshold of 150 scaled damage with Thundercall Mantras without being hit to proc this Talent. The damage buildup to reach the threshold is unaffected by resistances and damage modifiers. Also negates damage from critical attacks and Silentheart abilities. 2 minute cooldown.
Shocking Reverb.desc: Landing enough lightning mantras without getting hit grants you a defensive lightning cloak for 15 seconds, letting you negate damage from light attacks and ironsing.

Showstopper.desc: When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing.

Sightless Still.desc: The more a person is affected by your Shadowcast the more you obscure their vision. Block breaking an opponent obscures their vision even more and applies Ether Sunder to PvE

Silencer's Blade.additional_info: Landing M1 attacks or criticals with the M1 tag on suffocated targets applies a new stack of suffocation that lasts 5 seconds. Grants a 22.5% speed boost for 3 seconds on proc.
Silencer's Blade.desc: Meleeing a 'Suffocated' opponent will extend the duration of the Suffocation and grant a speed boost.

Silencer's Song.additional_info: Landing any Mantra on a suffocated target creates a new stack of suffocation that lasts 5 seconds. Additionally, you gain a 22.5% speed boost for 3 seconds.
Silencer's Song.desc: Silencer's Blade now procs on your mantras.
Silencer's Song.reqs: 100r LHT OR 100r MED OR 100r HVY, 100s WND

Silent Cascade.additional_info: Landing 8 weapon attacks or Silentheart abilities grants the Silent Cascade status effect, allowing you to use the Silent Cascade attack. This effect lasts 30 seconds or until you use Silent Cascade. Deals 7.5 Oath damage per hit (6).
Silent Cascade.desc: Landing physical attacks on an opponent charges up your Silent Cascade, a devastating barrage that can be released with CTRL + M2.

Simmerbloom.additional_info: Basic attacks with Pleeksty's Inferno now apply burn with no cooldown.
Simmerbloom.desc: Basic Attacks on Pleeksty's Inferno are now granted flames.

Simple Buff.additional_info: Grants a 7.5% (15% in Vow of Iron) damage buff to M1s.
Simple Buff.desc: Your light attacks deal 7.5/15% more damage. Pretty simple.

Sin Stacker.additional_info: Each stack of All the Dead Gods anti-heal increases the duration of subsequent All the Dead Gods anti-heal stacks by 1 second. For example, your first hit will apply anti-heal for 8 seconds, and your next hit will apply 9 seconds of anti-heal, and so on. Each stack of anti-heal has an independent duration, decaying independently of each other.
Sin Stacker.desc: Your All The Dead Gods' duration is now based on how many stacks of antiheal you already have on your opponent, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.

Singularity.desc: Enemies will briefly hang in place when hit by a shadow move.

Skillful Recovery.desc: Recover more posture in all situations.

Sky Aid.desc: Take 80% less damage while in the air.

Sleight of Hands.desc: [1H Guns] When you flourish an opponent you instantly load a bullet.

Slick.desc: Coat of the infamous thief Emiya Konga. Improves the user's sliding abilities. This effect stacks with Konga's Clutch Ring.

Slider Style.desc: Raise the cap of how fast you are able to slide. Your Jus Karita fighting style gains a new sliding crit. Its power stems from how fast you are sliding when using the critical attack.

Sloped Plate.desc: Reduces the amount of damage you take when guardbroken by 10.

Smell of Blood.additional_info: Your opponent's blood (or blood hemorrhaging in PvE) percentage is shown as a red number, and their blood poison percentage is shown as a pink number.
Smell of Blood.desc: When people touch a blood pool, briefly see their blood (or blood hemorrhage amount for PvE) and blood poison. This effect also occurs whenever you blockbreak your opponent.

Smoldering Touch.desc: Guardbreaking your opponent sets them on fire.

Snake Oil.additional_info: Increases the sell price of items by 40%.
Snake Oil.desc: Okay, the amount you're charging people for your items is getting downright criminal. But I'm just a Talent description, I can't stop you.

Soar.additional_info: This allows you to retain your full momentum during your weapon critical. This Talent will be disabled if you equip a Motif onto the Withered Gale Pale.
Soar.desc: Retain full walkspeed while using your crit.

Soaring Storm.additional_info: Proc condition is removed and damage is increased if in True Strength. Applies to all forms of uppercuts, including Mantras and certain weapon criticals. Deals 24 Oath + Slash damage (6 hits that deal 4 damage each), this is increased to 39 damage (6 hits that deal 6.5 damage each) if you are in True Strength.
Soaring Storm.desc: Empower your uppercuts with the way of the blade, after Lithe Stepping, flourishing, or landing an Oath ability.

Soaring Swiftkick.desc: Flying Swiftkick no longer consumes your speed boost and instead gives you more speed.

Solborn.additional_info: Spawns a small orange, stationary, Phoenix near you. The size of the Phoenix will increase based on the user's level. This Phoenix can be used like a campfire to rest and heal yourself.
Solborn.desc: Harness your Heartfire to command the Phoenix bound to your soul.

Songs Unforged.desc: Your weapon criticals will now activate scrapsinger.

Sorcerer's Skill.additional_info: This restores 5 Tempo after using your Vent instead of decreasing the Vent cost.
Sorcerer's Skill.desc: Decrease the amount of tempo it takes to vent by 5.

Sorcerer's Supply.additional_info: Increases your Tempo by 10 in Pathfinder or 30 in Vow of Iron.
Sorcerer's Supply.desc: Increase the amount of Tempo you have by 10/30.

Sorcerer's Surge.desc: Your vent's cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds.

Soul Infusion.additional_info: Increases your execution speed by 40%, down to 1.8 seconds from 3 seconds. Upon successfully performing an execution, use Ardour Scream for free. Your Ardour Scream range is buffed, sfx is changed, and minimum Ether cost required to cast Ardour Scream is reduced from 100% Ether to 40%.
Soul Infusion.desc: Infuse Ardour into your executions. If your execute is interrupted, the opponent remains down for a longer amount of time. Your Ardour Screams are projected further.

Soul Rip.additional_info: Grants a 50% weapon damage buff, ?% defense, infinite Ether, and a speed boost for the buff duration. Once the buff wears off, one of your legs will break, removing your ability to sprint for 30 seconds.
Soul Rip.desc: Kill a player to gain 2 runes. Activate a rune when using this talent, and gain immense physical power, defense, and infinite ether for 25 seconds. Beware its strenuous downside.

Soul Veil.additional_info: Each successful attack with the Soulthorn builds up stacks of Soul Veil, increasing your weapon damage by 7.5%. This caps at a 30% damage buff. If you take damage while Soul Veil is active, the opponent who hit you will steal your Soul Veil stacks until you hit them back. This can prove fatal.
Soul Veil.desc: Soulthorn now directly siphons the song of your enemies. Accumulating stacks and increasing your power. Perfect plays are encouraged.

Sovereign State.additional_info: Landing Galebreathe Mantras, Thundercall Mantras, weapon attacks, and Blightsurger Mantras gives Blight Meter. Press [X] while having at least 30% Blight Meter to enter the Sovereign State. Your weapon is replaced with Sovereign Bangle and the Wither applied on Blightsurger Mantras is increased while in Sovereign State.
Sovereign State.desc: Landing physical hits builds your Blight Meter. At full gauge, enter a Blight State that changes your critical and empowers Blightsurge abilities.

Sovereign's Counter.additional_info: Punishment has its reflected damage output increased by 12.5% additively, meaning at level 5 you can reflect 112.5% of someone's damage on top of the base damage. If the Authority Commander Outfit is equipped, the longevity of the attack window on your Punishment is increased by 3x; from 20 seconds to a full minute. Prediction's active frames are increased slightly. Curse of the Unbidden has its posture restoration increased by 10%, restoring 40% of your posture. Payback has its active counter frames increased by 0.7 seconds.
Sovereign's Counter.desc: Improve the efficiency of every counter you use. This effect becomes stronger for Punishment if you have the Riot Breaker talent.

Sow and Mend.additional_info: Gives 25 flat Temporary Health on use. 30 second cooldown.
Sow and Mend.desc: Sacrifice 35% of your blood for temporary health.

Spare Nails.desc: Prevents you from dropping any wood on death.

Spark of Theros.additional_info: Turns your Thundercall white and changes your Shock to Blightshock, applying Wither to affected targets.
Spark of Theros.desc: Your Thundercall is imbued with the spark of Theros, altering its appearance and properties.

Speed Demon.additional_info: Speed Demon's bleed deals 2.5% of your weapon's scaled damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to 7.5% of your weapon's scaled over a 0.9 second period. Bleed deals typeless damage.
Speed Demon.desc: Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown.

Speed Emission.additional_info: Grants a 30% speed boost and applies a 15% slow. 5 second cooldown.
Speed Emission.desc: Gain a 5s speed boost and apply a 3s slow to your opponent.

Spell Shout.additional_info: The player will say the name of the Mantra they cast in a chat bubble. e.g. casting Fire Blade will make the player say "Fire Blade!" Renaming a Mantra will Spell Shout the new Mantra name.
Spell Shout.desc: You will now shout your mantra name upon cast

Spike Traps.additional_info: Spikes activate upon being stepped on.
Spike Traps.desc: Press F during the wind up of your Ice Spikes to create traps around you instead of spawning a spike in the normal spot.

Spinal Shatter.desc: Landing the Crescent Cleaver critical attack causes your opponent to be unable to sprint for 8 seconds. [10 second CD]

Spinal Splinter.additional_info: If your critical attack hits your opponent's back, it will gain an secondary damage instance that deals 25 true damage.
Spinal Splinter.desc: Landing a backstab with your critical deals 15 extra true damage.

Spine Cutter.additional_info: The second slash has no PEN. Procs on certain physical Mantras and criticals with the M1 tag. Has a 5 second cooldown.
Spine Cutter.desc: Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will initiate a second slash that deals your weapon's raw damage.

Spinning Swordsman.desc: Running attacks do +15% extra damage when you have a speed boost.

Spotter.additional_info: Using Callout while in Rhythm will showcase the health value of the target to your allies.
Spotter.desc: Marking enemies while in Rhythm will now indicate their health status to your allies.

Stack the Deck.desc: Charmed enemies will grant you even more damage multipliers on your Taunt counter.

Star Duster.desc: You take 30% less damage from airborne enemies.

Stasis Strike.additional_info: Stasis Strike increases the damage of your crystal explosions by 1.67x when your opponent is bottom frozen.
Stasis Strike.desc: Your crystal explosions deal more damage whenever your opponent is also bottom frozen.
Stasis Strike.reqs: 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY, 90s ICE

Static Ace.additional_info: Heavily reduces the windup of Lightning Stream.
Static Ace.desc: Using Lightning Stream with an active tether link targets your closest active link.

Static Allure.additional_info: Instantly procs when you create a new Static Link. The extra Link duration only applies to the Static Link that procced the magnetization effect.
Static Allure.desc: Having two active tethers will cause the previous tethered enemy to get magnetized to your newest tethered enemy, also increases the duration of tethers by 15 seconds.

Static Beatdown.additional_info: Shaky block duration scales on your Thundercall investment, increasing by +0.004s for every point in Thundercall.
Static Beatdown.desc: The metal the cestus is made from allows electricity to be conducted easily through it, allowing you to further extend how long your opponents are stuck in shaky block based on your total Thundercall investment.

Static Blade.additional_info: Grants stacks when you '''get parried''', not when you parry attacks. Also grants stacks when you hit blocks or block attacks. Each stack lasts for 15 seconds and refresh upon gaining another, including when you're at max stacks. Each stack grants an ~2.35% speed boost, totaling to ~11.75% speed at max stacks.
Static Blade.desc: Hitting blocks, blocking or parrying hits will now generate an electric charge in your blade, granting a small speed buff. Charges can stack up to 5 times.

Static Fakeout.desc: Roll cancelling immediately after a parry will cause you to teleport behind your opponent.

Static Flash Clone.desc: When using lightning clones you instead disappear leaving behind a static clone for a short duration.

Static Link.additional_info: Lasts 15 seconds. The links are non-refreshable, meaning you will need to wait until after the duration ends to reapply them.
Static Link.desc: Flourishing or uppercutting an enemy creates a static link between you and your enemy.

Stature Break.additional_info: While their posture is paused, your opponent cannot restore posture by parrying, spitting, passive posture restoration, or through Steady Nerves. All other forms of posture restoration ignore this effect entirely.
Stature Break.desc: Landing a backstab of any kind disables posture for 4 seconds. [8 second CD]

Stay of Execution.desc: Increases the time taken to execute you by 20%. Saving others from being executed grants you both 10 TempHP (20s CD)

Steady Footing.additional_info: Knockback is reduced by 20%. Ice's slide distance effect is removed.
Steady Footing.desc: You're much more resistant to being pushed around.

Steady Mind.additional_info: You can spend more time in the Depths before gaining Afflictions.
Steady Mind.desc: Despite the finality of your mind and body succumbing to the effects of the depths, you manage to ward it off for a little longer.

Steady Nerves.additional_info: Restore 2 flat posture on a successful dodge.
Steady Nerves.desc: You dance from toe to toe - successful dodges restore posture.

Steampunk Soldier.desc: Increase the size of your steam which you activate Flashboil. Flashboil's cooldown is also reduced.

Steel Grip.desc: When you are blockbroken, negate it and set your posture to 80%.

Steel Scales.additional_info: The 3% Slash Armor is multiplicative with other sources of Slash resistance.
Steel Scales.desc: You take an additional 5% less damage when your armor is broken.

Steel Tread.desc: Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.

Steelvessel.additional_info: Take posture damage instead of health damage. Upon being guardbroken, take a large amount of damage to your healthbar. Your healing and posture restoration from parrying attacks is reduced.
Steelvessel.desc: Landed attacks deal posture damage but when guard broken take massive damage. Posture gain on parry is reduced.

Sticky Flames.desc: [Greatcannon] Your base greatcannon critical attack's cannon ball leave 3 seconds of sticky flames on successful hits.

Stifled Jump.additional_info: The daze effect lasts for 1 second.
Stifled Jump.desc: Suffocating now applies Dazed if enemies jump. Suffocated PvE enemies now also get Sluggish when they are suffocated.

Stock Bash.desc: [Rifles] Your running attacks now apply a brief amount of daze and Stagger PvE enemies.

Storm Link.additional_info: Adds a secondary instance of damage to your Galebreathe Mantras if they hit a Static Linked target. This deals 10% of your attack's scaled damage as Thundercall damage.
Storm Link.desc: While you have a Static Link on someone, your Wind mantras that hit them are imbued with flashes of Lightning.

Storm Return.additional_info: Being under the effects of Amped or Lightning Cloak will proc this effect.
Storm Return.desc: Being under lightning/wind status effect causes your Basic Attacks and Criticals to do 10% more damage. (Amplified with Lightning Cloak)

Stormcall.additional_info: Your Stormcall Shocks from other Specialist Equipment Talents apply the Stormcall Shock status effect. If your opponent attempts to cast a Mantra while affected, they will take 15 Galebreathe/Thundercall damage and they will gain the Shock and Winded status effect.
Stormcall.desc: Anytime you land a storm strike apply stormcall shock on your opponent, damaging them if they try to use a mantra while its active.

Stratos Step.additional_info: Stratos Steps will only proc twice before going on a cooldown. Said cooldown applies to individual steps. Additionally, Stratos Step consumes Ether per step.
Stratos Step.desc: Holding space while climbing will now let your perform Stratos Steps to get even higher.

Stratoshock.additional_info: All sources of Thundercall damage innately gains a 5% damage buff if it is raining. This Talent adds an additional 5%.
Stratoshock.desc: Your lightning deals an additional +5% damage when in the rain.

Strength Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Strength Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Strength on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Strength Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Strength to its fullest.

String Trick.additional_info: Does not proc on non-humanoids. Deals a small amount of damage on proc.
String Trick.desc: Pulls together any two opponents you've attached Hidden Tendril to.

Strong Hold.desc: [Medium Weapons] When above half health and two-handing, posture damage taken is reduced by 5%.

Strong Stern.desc: The duration you are dazed from wall bangs is cut in half. Slightly reduce your guardbreak stun time from PvE enemies as well.

Stronger Under Pressure.additional_info: This applies a 5% slow per combat tag you have, lasting 1 second.
Stronger Under Pressure.desc: Your mantras with might gem now slow down your opponents, scaling with how many combat tags you currently have.

Subzero.desc: Landing a running attack inflicts your opponent with a deep freeze. Additional light hits after the opponent thaws out will briefly slow them as well.

Successive Prediction.additional_info: Allows you to reflect the entirety of multi-hit moves.
Successive Prediction.desc: Predicting an attack will briefly allow you to predict another.

Successive Throw.additional_info: There is a 1.5 second delay after your flourish before the dagger is thrown. This deals 5 Slash damage.
