Successive Throw.desc: [Dagger] When you successfully flourish an enemy, you throw out a dagger afterwards

Suffocating Impact.desc: When flourishing enemies into walls they are suffocated and winded for a short duration.

Sulphur Surprise.additional_info: Reduces the bomb throw cooldown from 5 seconds to 4 seconds. This only applies to the bomb thrown directly after this Talent procs, not on the bomb that procced this Talent. 20 second cooldown.
Sulphur Surprise.desc: Your cooldown for throwing bombs will be shortened after your first bomb damages an enemy.

Sunken Predator.desc: Enemies you hit in the water or the depths have their speed buffs nullified and are slowed.

Sunset Ricochet.desc: Makes your bullets ricochet to a nearby enemy when hitting an opponent.

Supernatural Sense.desc: After dealing with literal ghosts, you feel emboldened.

Surestep.additional_info: Makes you immune to the ragdoll and movement speed debuff of the Wind from the Second Layer and Moon's Eyrie.
Surestep.desc: Your boots secure your footing in all forms of terrain by digging into the ground with metal spikes.

Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor.additional_info: Turns your Thundercall abilities blurple. Shock is replaced with Surge Rods, a stacking status effect that Overloads upon applying five Rods and then landing an attack that would apply a sixth, consuming all of the Rods. Each Rod has an individual 30 second duration. Surge Overloads deal 2.5 Thundercall damage per Rod with 5 Thundercall scaling to Overloaded target, gaining 0.0125 damage per Thundercall investment, and 2 Thundercall damage per Rod in an AoE that does not hit the Overloaded target.
Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor.desc: Your lightning no longer applies Shock, instead apply Surge. At maximum stacks of Surge, your opponents will Overload, sending arcs of lightning in every direction.

Survival Kit.desc: You keep a well-stocked set of tools on your person at all times. Your flint never runs out of uses.

Survivalist.additional_info: Take less damage from Acid Rain.
Survivalist.desc: Resist the effects of Weather Effects.

Sweeping Edge.desc: Your Master's Flourish is larger and can now proc flourish talents.

Sweeten the Deal.desc: Madness can now be applied to enemies at 80% health or lower.

Swift Blade.desc: Proccing Wind Gem now gives you 10% more light attack posture during its duration. Extend the duration of Wind Gems by 2 seconds.

Swift Rebound.desc: Move faster after successfully dodging an attack.

Swift Strike.additional_info: On proc, you gain the Swift Strike status effect indefinitely. This effect will be consumed when you use your critical. The teleport has a range limit. 20 second cooldown.
Swift Strike.desc: Land a light attack behind your opponent to enhance your next critical, allowing you to teleport behind your opponent and strike them. This enhanced critical also procs assassination talents.

Swiftfoot.desc: Reduce all slows you receive by 10%.

Swiftkick Master.desc: Proccing Swiftkick Prodigy now extends its duration to 15 seconds.

Swiftkick Prodigy.additional_info: Your third M1 will grant a speed boost for a short duration.
Swiftkick Prodigy.desc: Hitting successive Basic Attacks with Jus Karita will give a temporary speed buff.

Switchblade.additional_info: This also allows other light weapons to use Dagger Talents.
Switchblade.desc: You can now utilize Dagger Talents when not wielding a dagger.

Symbiotic Link.additional_info: Blue Cords (Allies) gain a speed boost, 20% damage resistance, and a 5% damage increase. Red Cords (Enemies) gain a minor speed debuff. Allows you to passively see the health bars of your allies.
Symbiotic Link.desc: Activate by pressing X while hovering over an ally or enemy. The Links are destroyed when you receive damage from a non-ally, you stray too far or you activate it again. Only one cord of each type may exist at once, links give a 3 second warning in break range, in the warning phase, they can't be broken.

Tacet Minimization.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that massively reduces the size of your Tacet bubble on use.
Tacet Minimization.desc: Focus your Tacet even further, allowing the radius at which you get spotted to become smaller temporarily.

Tactical Reload.additional_info: Upon activating the Talent tool, your rifle will gain the ability to fire Bullets for 15 seconds. 90 second cooldown. Does not work on Rifle Spear.
Tactical Reload.desc: [Rifles] Activate to make your rifle shoot bullets for 15 seconds.

Tailor Made.desc: These were specifically made for your kind. Etris Flasks now heal you 45% more than usual.

Tainted Ground.desc: Enemies who stand in blood pools will not decay blood poison and gain 15% more blood poisoning.

Tap Dancer.additional_info: Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel.
Tap Dancer.desc: Dodging immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your Dodge on a longer cooldown.

Target Focus.desc: Enemies you charm take more damage from your squadmates in your party.

Target Switch.additional_info: This effect is signalled by a yellow halo. Has a 4 second activation window with a 10 second duration.
Target Switch.desc: Parrying an opponent then hitting someone else makes your next mantra free.

Taste The Rainbow.desc: Every time you shoot, switch your ammo type. [Dual Guns]

Teachings of the Edenkite.additional_info: Allows you to meditate, emitting a white aura and causing two white orbs to circle your head. Very heavily reduces your hunger and thirst consumption while you passively gain EXP and Attribute EXP and regenerate health at a mediocre rate, which is slightly reduced when in combat.

Temperature Shock.desc: Your fire mantras now detonate any stacked crystals.

Tempest Evolution.additional_info: Increases the slide jump variant of Wind Blade's damage by 20%. Additionally grants a 20% damage buff while you are airborne after landing the slide jump Wind Blade.
Tempest Evolution.desc: Your slide-jumped Wind Blades are naturally stronger and if landed grant +20% damage in the air for a few seconds.

Temple Guard.additional_info: You will only gain the damage reduction if your critical attack gets interrupted.
Temple Guard.desc: For the first 0.3s of your Critical Attack's windup, you take 90% less damage from any attacks that cancel your windup.

Tempo Sap.desc: Activate to make your dagger's light attacks steal tempo per hit for 20 seconds. [Dagger]

Tenacity.desc: Greatly shorten the amount of time you are guardbroken for.

Termite.additional_info: Allows user to eat Sticks, Bamboo, Beeswax, Coral, Spider Eggs, Pristine Lotus, and every Ore.
Termite.desc: You can eat things most would consider inedible.

Terrapod Tracer.additional_info: This only works while your opponent has Anti-Heal.
Terrapod Tracer.desc: Deal 0.5% of your opponent's health to opponents who heal off you.

Terrifying Paralysis.desc: Your Hidden Blade disables opponents' ability to roll for 3 seconds.

The Big One.desc: Your critical attack's projectile size and explosion size is doubled.

The Eleventh Hour.additional_info: Lasts 30 seconds with a 90 second cooldown.
The Eleventh Hour.desc: When below 15% health your mantras require no ether to cast for 11 seconds.

The Final Act.desc: Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode.

The Floor is Lava.additional_info: The duration and damage of the lava pools scale on your Flamecharm investment.
The Floor is Lava.desc: Your Eruptions leave lethal pools of lava beneath them. Don't fall in.

The Path, Unveiled.additional_info: Increases Jus Karita damage by 10%, despite what the Talent description states.
The Path, Unveiled.desc: Your Jus Karita attacks deal 15% more damage.

The Rich Get Richer.desc: Gain 15% more notes whenever you sell something.

Thornmail.desc: Getting flourished applies a metal rod on your attacker.

Threadripper.additional_info: Critical autogrips knocked opponents when used by a contractor
Threadripper.desc: When used by a Contractor, your Critical is empowered to eviscerate opponents.

Threefold Impact.additional_info: Grants buffs to your Strong Left based on how many Calamity Punch stacks you have. At one stack, your Strong Left cooldown will be reduced. At two stacks, your Strong Left will additionally deal typeless damage. At three stacks, your Strong Left will also guard break and deal more damage.
Threefold Impact.desc: Every stack built with Strong Left provides a buff. 1st successful attack will reduces cooldown, 2nd ignores armor, and 3rd increases damage & guardbreaks.

Thresher Thrasher.desc: Adapt to the ways of the thresher, increasing how long you are able to stay underground with Beast Burrow by 30%, and reducing its cooldown by 25%.

Thundercall Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Thundercall Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.
Thundercall Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Thundercall to its fullest.

Thundercaller.desc: Grants you the ability to command Lightning as a Thundercaller.

Tidal Shock.additional_info: Your Critical attacks will apply Daze on hit. For the next 4 seconds after landing your Critical attack, if you were to be hit by any Mantra, you'll automatically dodge the Mantra instead, voiding its damage. This can be used to void self damaging Mantras. 13 second cooldown.
Tidal Shock.desc: Landing a successful Critical Attack will temporarily put you in a state where you dodge all mantras, as well as dazing your opponent.

Tidekeeper.desc: Losing 25% of your health within the span of 3 seconds grants a 15% damage buff, 20% defense buff, and prevents from being knocked for 10 seconds.

Time To Go.desc: Taking a life grants a speed boost for 10 seconds. Taking a player's life doubles the speed boost and the duration.

To the Finish.additional_info: For every point of Fortitude below 50, To the Finish loses 0.166% damage reduction, having a minimum value of 5.833% damage reduction at 25 Fortitude.
To the Finish.desc: You take 10% less damage when below 30% health.

Torture Mastery.additional_info: On proc, all chip damage you deal will be converted into healing. The conversion rate is 1:1.
Torture Mastery.desc: Landing a critical on opponents applies 15 seconds of Torture Mastery. Heal any chip damage off players who have Torture Mastery on them. This duration is doubled if you have Rush Hour on.
Torture Mastery.reqs: 100s BLD, 100r LHT OR 100r MED OR 100r HVY

Total Silence.desc: Massively reduce the sound of your footsteps and rolls.

Tough Love.additional_info: Charms for 2 seconds with a 1 second cooldown. Tough Love's damage buff affects all sources of Charm, not just Tough Love's. Tough Love's damage buff is affected by the damage modifier cap.
Tough Love.desc: Deal 10% more damage to enemies Charmed by you. Mantras deal +5% instead. Being hit by someone the same Aspect or Oath as you applies Charmed briefly.

Traditional Execution.desc: Flourishing an opponent turns your next critical attack into the Katana critical attack. Also extends Dancing Steps Of War's effects by 0.5 seconds.

Training Wheels.desc: Increase the amount of parry frames you have by 20%.

Treefelling Blow.additional_info: Allows you to gain Wood when you destroy trees with Strong Left.
Treefelling Blow.desc: You can collect lumber from the trees you fell with your fists. It's only natural.

True Drifter.additional_info: Anytime you would have gained 1 Cutting Pace stack, gain 2 instead. You can now consume Cutting Pace stacks to use Blinkstep without being at 90% or more Ether.
True Drifter.desc: You are a true drifter. Gain double the 'Cutting Pace' stacks and consume stacks to Blinkstep below 90% ether.

True Ether Bullets.additional_info: Landing 2 shots will make the 3rd shot deal elemental damage and apply the status effect correlating to your highest attunement. This Talent will not do anything if you do not have an attunement.
True Ether Bullets.desc: Using Ether Bullets applies elemental damage of your highest investment.
True Ether Bullets.reqs: 20r LHT OR 20r MED OR 20r HVY, 30s INT

True Mirage Clone.desc: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.

True Seraph Slash.additional_info: This deals 0.5x of your weapons scaled damage as typeless damage. Hits four times.
True Seraph Slash.desc: Landing the first hit of your critical attack enhances your next critical, giving you access to the Angels' spear smite ability.

True Shatter.additional_info: Deals 5 true damage per slow debuff.
True Shatter.desc: Landing a critical shatters your opponent, ridding them of their speed debuffs and dealing true damage scaling off how slow they were.

True Skulk.desc: Massively reduce the sounds of your mantra casts.

True Vantage.additional_info: Changes your Vent color to match the color of your Silentheart Tattoos.
True Vantage.desc: Venting makes you invisible briefly, as well as boosting your speed.

Turning of the Wheel.additional_info: Using an M1 after dodging a weapon attack will cause you to step back and then advance with faster swing speed.
Turning of the Wheel.desc: After perfect dodging a swing or critical attack, step backwards and ramp up your swingspeed.

Turtle Shell.additional_info: If you have a shield equipped and your main weapon two-handed, your shield will be put on your back. This grants 12.5% damage reduction against attacks that hit your back and prevents your opponent from proccing Spine Cutter.
Turtle Shell.desc: If your shield is on your back, take reduced backstab damage and negate Spine Cutter.

Twelve Steps Ahead.additional_info: This effect requires your opponent to be within 90 studs of you. For every point of Intelligence below 80, Prediction's maximum cooldown will be increased by 0.125 seconds, capping at 33.13 seconds with 55 Intelligence.
Twelve Steps Ahead.desc: Landing Prediction will halve the cooldown to a minimum of 2s. Whiffing will double the cooldown to a maximum of 30s. This effect stacks for up to 30 seconds.

Twin Drift.additional_info: Performing a basic attack after a roll cancel will perform a second slash, then two light purple clones of yourself will attack the target.
Twin Drift.desc: Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will bring upon twins who will follow up your assault.

Two Left Feet.desc: Posture breaking an opponent grants you +50% PEN for 3 seconds.

Ultrakill.desc: [1H Guns] When under the effects of Rapid Fire you reload 2X as fast.

Umami.additional_info: Has a 35% chance to proc with a 3 cooldown per proc attempt, going on cooldown even if it fails to proc. The hunger and thirst steal are NOT affected by damage modifiers or resistances, rather exclusively being based on scaled damage dealt. Procs on: The Long Tong of The Law, The Flippers of Fate, The Pastry Paster, and Fondant Splitter.
Umami.desc: Feast on foes with mighty cutlery. Chef Weapons now steal opponents hunger.

Unbreakable.additional_info: Reduces the stun duration from being guardbroken from 1.05s to 0.7s.
Unbreakable.desc: You have reduced stun duration when block broken.

Under The Radar.desc: The negative reputation threshold for a faction to put out posters of you is now higher.

Underdog.additional_info: Underdog grants a 2.5% damage buff at 20 Willpower, this is increased by 0.0375% damage per Willpower above 20, capping at 4% with 60 Willpower. Grants a 2.875% damage buff at requirements. "Higher HP" refers to current HP.
Underdog.desc: You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes.

Undying Flame.additional_info: Graceful Flame can be casted in the First Layer. It cannot be used in the Diluvian Mechanism or Depths Trials, however. Graceful Flame passively restores sanity and health to those around it.
Undying Flame.desc: Your Graceful Flame burns brightly even underwater. Those that gather around it are soothed and regain sanity.

Unfazed.additional_info: You now shiver at tier 2 Insanity instead of Tier 1. You now scratch yourself at tier 3 Insanity instead of tier 2. You can no longer Panic.
Unfazed.desc: You are more resilient to the side effects of going insane. You no longer Shiver and you Panic with less severity.

Union Card.additional_info: Gain increased EXP gain from Jobs and Dungeons, but reduced EXP gain from any other content.
Union Card.desc: A card representing your membership in the Ignition Union. Entitles you to speedier experience gain from Dungeons and Jobs, though the fees will slightly reduce your experience gain outside of these.

Union Hook.desc: You can now make use of the Ignition Union hooks to ascend or descend.

Union Pager.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that acts as a remote-access Job Board, allowing you to pick up jobs from any location.
Union Pager.desc: Check up on job listings remotely.

Unmatched Dexterity.additional_info: You can now swap weapons and equipment while in combat. Pressing [X] will swap your current weapon with a random weapon in your hotbar.
Unmatched Dexterity.desc: Press [X] to Quick Swap between weapons within your toolbar.

Unmended Eye.desc: All mantras you land now apply anti heal.

Unnecessary Theatrics.additional_info: The charm proc has no cooldown, but the one-liners do. Instantly reapplies Charm after Manipulator removes it, on the same hit.
Unnecessary Theatrics.desc: Deliver a one-liner on uppercuts, flourishes and critical attacks that charms your opponents briefly.

Unseen Threat.desc: You can assassinate those with weapons out provided you're not in combat yourself. Those you assassinate are slowed and unable to jump for 3s.

Unstoppable Force.desc: [Greathammer] You take 15% less posture damage when parried.

Unswayed.additional_info: The Taunt Mantra and Cornered Fool no longer work on you. Sing will still Charm you.
Unswayed.desc: The effects of Taunt and Encore no longer work on you.

Until It Is Done.additional_info: Your Berserk has an indefinite duration, ending only when you use the tool again.
Until It Is Done.desc: Your Berserk State lasts until you willingly end it.

Untouchable.additional_info: Grants True Strength for 15 seconds on proc. Untouchable requires 10 'Untouchable Stacks'. Being hit by any non-self damage source will reset all Untouchable Stacks. Weapon attacks give 2 stacks each, and non-weapon attacks give 1 stack each.
Untouchable.desc: By landing consecutive hits on your opponent without taking any damage, reveal your True Strength for a short duration.

Unwavering Focus.additional_info: Grants 0.3% posture resistance per point in Intelligence, capping at +21% at 70 Intelligence.
Unwavering Focus.desc: When your mantras are parried, receive less posture (scales with intelligence).

Unwavering Resolve.additional_info: The posture reduction effect is reduced by 0.433% for every point in Strength below 40, having a minimum value of 22% posture reduction from being parried at 15 Strength.
Unwavering Resolve.desc: Getting parried punishes your posture 33% less.

Unyielding Frost.additional_info: If you have less than 100 Frostdraw, your Chill duration (when applied through block) will be reduced down to 25% of its original duration instead.
Unyielding Frost.desc: Your Chill can proc through block, with blocked Chilling procs lasting 80% of the duration.

Unyielding Inferno.additional_info: Negates the innate 10% damage debuff Flamecharm Mantras, First Light's critical, and Twisted Puppets' Puppets receive during the rain. Prevents your burn from being extinguished by the rain.
Unyielding Inferno.desc: Your flames burn just as strong even in the fiercest of storms.

Vacuum Punch.additional_info: Gale Punch Mantra will now pull players towards the user during the windup of the Mantra. Increases Gale Punch's windup by 0.1s.
Vacuum Punch.desc: Your Gale Punch pulls enemies in before you hit them.

Vanguard Style.additional_info: This new critical attack has 20 base damage, and adopts your current weapon's scaling stat.
Vanguard Style.desc: When using the Jus Karita critical attack, turn it into a kick that brings your enemies up in the air. Landing the critical attack while your opponent is in the air brings them up and slightly stun them while upgrading your next critical.

Vanguard's Onslaught.desc: Landing a Vanguard Style Jus Karita critical attack makes you deal 20% more damage in the air for the next 5 seconds.

Vanishing Wraith.desc: Your 'Aerial Attacks' while in Phantom Step will now teleport you behind your target.

Vasculitis.additional_info: On proc, your opponent will be unable to use their Deep Gems for 8 seconds. Gem Enhancement increases the effectiveness of your Deep Gems in PvE.
Vasculitis.desc: Hitting your opponent while they have over 20% blood poisoning disables their deep gems for a brief duration while giving you Gem Enhancement against PvE temporarily.

Vengeful Pursuit.additional_info: Base damage and scaling differ depending on weapon type. 8 second cooldown.
Vengeful Pursuit.desc: Your running attacks that don't hit send out a special mid-range crescent projectile that slows on hit. Tracks onto those with their backs turned to you.

Versatile.additional_info: Reduces the attribute requirements of all equipment and weapon items by 3. This is applied to each requirement individually, meaning you can save upwards of 12 points.
Versatile.desc: You learn how to use new pieces of equipment quicker than others. You can equip things at 3 points lower than the requirement.

Verses of Harmony.additional_info:
Gain access to the following Talents while in the respective Saint Stance. Upon swapping out of the Saint Stance, all granted Talents will be lost. Some of these Talents have an additional level requirement.
Flamecharm: Dancing Steps, Immolation, Agitating Spark
Frostdraw: Condensation Drip, Saint Jay, Frozen Legs, Fragile Freeze, Chilling Flourish
Galebreathe: Pressure Break, Wind Step, Air Pressure, Cyclone Blade, Inhale, A World Without Song
Shadowcast: Dark Rift, Lasting Sorrow, Dark God, Dark Hours, Shadow Overflow, Singularity
Thundercall: Static Fakeout, Stratoshock, Resolve Crusher, Static Blade, Gathering Electricity
Verses of Harmony.desc: Each elemental stance grants access to select talents from the corresponding attunement.

Vessel's Gamble.additional_info: Though this Talent is actively detrimental to the user, the Corrupted Vessel's Boots +20 Posture offsets the downside.
Vessel's Gamble.desc: When you get guardbroken you take 3 times the damage of the attack.

Vigil's Grace.additional_info: Stacks additively with Action Surge. Both this and Action Surge are applied before Lightning Cloak's swing speed multiplier.
Vigil's Grace.desc: Whenever you gain a speed boost, increase your swingspeed by 0.02.

Vital Wound.additional_info: Uppercutting your opponent applies the Vital Wound status effect for 20 seconds, which only affects their passive posture recovery. The reduction starts at 100% and scales down as the remaining duration runs out. This has no cooldown, but it cannot be refreshed or reapplied while it's active.
Vital Wound.desc: Uppercutting your opponent punctures their lungs, slowing their rate of posture recovery for 20 seconds. This starts at 100% with it scaling down based on the duration of the effect left.

Voice of the Mad God.desc: Any time you apply charm it now applies "Madness" to enemies directly.

Void Glutton.additional_info: Gives 2 maximum health when you kill a player. You will also be slowed, with the slow being based on how much maximum health you've siphoned.
Void Glutton.desc: Siphon some of your enemies ether when you kill them. This gets added onto your health permanently, however you are now slowed at all times. This slow increases the more health you have siphoned.

Voideye.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that teleports you back to the Voidheart on use. 1 minute cooldown.
Voideye.desc: Voidmother's blessing, the method to travel back to the Voidheart.

Voidwalker Contract.additional_info: Gain increased EXP from bounties of all kinds, but gain reduced EXP from all other sources.
Voidwalker Contract.desc: You progress much faster from completing bounties, and less from events. Gain access to the Voidheart, and factions have a negative outlook on you.

Volcanic Glass.desc: Detonating crystals causes an eruption soon after.

Volt Draft.additional_info: This has a proc window of 5 seconds after using Inhale. Storm Strikes from this Talent deal 0.125 * (Thundercall + Galebreathe investment) Thundercall damage, capping at 25 damage with 100 points invested in both Attunements. Can proc Grounding Bolt.
Volt Draft.desc: Using Inhale will now also make your Basic Attacks apply a storm strike. [20 second CD]

Volt Reflex.additional_info: Increases the dodge window based on your Thundercall investment. Increases your dodge cooldown (for both dodge types) to 2.4 seconds.
Volt Reflex.desc: Your dodge window is increased with the power of lightning, but also increase the cooldown of your dodges.

Voltaic Conductor.desc: Your Thundercall Mantras deal 30% chip damage against enemies with conductor rods.

Vow of Mastery.additional_info: Players who take the vow are considered allies with their master and others who take the vow. Commands Given: "Sleep", "Drop", "Run", "Eat", "Say (Text)", "Use", "Locate", and "Leech" at base. "Fight" and "Sacrifice" at 50 Charisma, "Return" at 60 Charisma, and "Explode" at 75 Charisma.
Vow of Mastery.desc: The Vow of Mastery grants the Master the power to command their Subject. To initiate a vow you must ask the other player if they'd like to make the vow. e.g. "wanna make a vow of mastery?"

Warding Radiance.additional_info: Allows you to proc Hell's Partisan on Flamecharm Mantras that aren't Fire Forge while you have the halo active. Lasts 60 seconds, but cannot be refreshed.
Warding Radiance.desc: Every fire mantra builds up one halo stack. At 3 stacks a halo appears that allows you to slide further. Hell's Partisan is also triggered passively while this is active.

Warrior's Swing.desc: [Heavy Weapons] Reduces incoming damage by 5% if hit during Heavy swing hyperarmor.

Water off a Duck's Back.additional_info: Transfers Suffocation, Winded, Chill, Shock, Burn, and potion effects from yourself to your enemy on vent.
Water off a Duck's Back.desc: Venting will shift any elemental status effects affecting you onto those hit by your vent.

Way of Navae.additional_info: Allows you to use the Way of Navae fist style.
Way of Navae.desc: Gain the ability to use fist combat against weapons. Including the ability to block weapons with your hands using Ether.

Way of the Wind.additional_info: On proc, a wind of gale will erupt from your legs, signifying that the effect is active.
Way of the Wind.desc: Being in the air briefly increases the speed of your mantra casts. This effect only lasts while you're in the air.

Weakening Venom.desc: Assassinating an opponent decreases the damage they deal by 25% for the next 30 seconds.

Weapon's Training.desc: Training with different weapons taught you how to wield all of them more proficiently. Gain slightly extra weapon scaling on all weapons you use.

Weather Resistant.desc: Take 30% less damage when under less than ideal weather conditions.

Whistleguard.additional_info: The wind shield grants one (1) autoparry frame and has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The shield will be dispelled early if you get hit (proccing the shield), cast a Mantra, feint an attack, or use a critical attack.
Whistleguard.desc: The favor of the winds is yours: landing three hits (five for light weapons) without taking damage against your opponent envelops you in a shield of wind.

Wild Alchemy.desc: You have a chance to brew 2 potions instead of 1.

Will o' Wisp.additional_info: Allows the player to have multiple Wisp Mantras active at once.
Will o' Wisp.desc: Your mastery over the Wisps of the Song enables you to mediate the innate conflicts between your wisps, allowing any number of Wisps to be active at a time.
Will o' Wisp.reqs: 25r ICE OR 25r FLM OR 25r WND OR 25r SDW OR 25r LTN OR 25r MTL OR 25r BLD

Willpower Unbounded.additional_info: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Willpower Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Willpower on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.
Willpower Unbounded.desc: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your willpower to its fullest.

Wind Dancer.additional_info: Grants a 10% speed boost for 8 seconds. 10 second cooldown.
Wind Dancer.desc: Roll cancelling twice in quick succession will grant you a speed boost. One of your rolls must dodge a hit.

Wind Step.additional_info: Jump while airborne to double jump, leaving behind a wind pad that other players can also use. Alternatively, jumping while sliding down a slope will perform a Gale Leap that propels you forwards. While in combat, this ability cost Ether to use.
Wind Step.desc: Create a step of wind below you when jumping in the air. Jumping while sliding down a slope or off a cliff launches you forwards.

Windup Battery.additional_info: Applies this bonus to non-Thundercall Mantras.
Windup Battery.desc: Landing 3 Thundercall Mantras without whiffing reduces the windup of your next Mantra by 10%.

Windwaker.additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used while on a boat and out of combat. On use, the boat will gain a very large amount of additional speed for a short duration.
Windwaker.desc: Call upon a gust of wind to propel your boat even faster. (Around 5x faster than normal.)

Winter's Protection.additional_info: Increases the time it takes for the Second Layer's parasites to kill you. Negates weather-reliant damage buffs such as Frostdraw's increased damage when its snowing or Thundercall's increased damage when it's raining.
Winter's Protection.desc: Your tightly-bound winter gear negates elemental damage buffs from weather on damage against you. Also seems to provide some resistance to the Gale.

Wisp Convergence.additional_info: While Chorus of Souls is active, your weapon attacks will apply Burn, Chill, Shock, Winded, Shadow, Metal Rods, and Blood Poison. This Talent will not activate unless you have every Attunement's Wisp Mantra equipped and active. If one of your Wisps runs out, this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp. This Talent will not work if you no longer have the Oathless Oath.
Wisp Convergence.desc: When empowered by the Chorus, your Wisps now grant their elements to your strikes.

Withering Soul.additional_info: The Wither applied is based off your weapon's scaled damage.
Withering Soul.desc: Your Basic Attacks proc 12.5% of their damage as Wither. Wielding the Deepspindle or Umbrite Witherblade will double the amount to 25%.

Woodland Terrain.desc: You move slightly faster on grass.

Wormwarder.additional_info: Makes you entirely immune to the Second Layer's Parasites, but at a cost of granting you a mobility debuff.
Wormwarder.desc: Your lantern generates a shroud of static electricity around you that the flesh-burrowing parasites of the Eternal Gale detest. It's not exactly the lightest thing to lug around, though.

Worshipper's Tolerance.desc: Reduce the burn damage you take by 15%. While on fire, parrying an opponent's attack now sets them on fire [45 second CD].

Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets.additional_info: Your Flamecharm abilities and status effects are now black. Your regular burn is now much weaker, dealing 87.5% less damage, but it now spawns Puppets on a 4 second cooldown. Your Shadowcast abilities can now apply burn that deals 75% less damage than default burn. Both of these burn types drain 6.25 Ether from affected targets per tick. Puppets deal 20 Typeless damage and 10 posture damage. Increases the uptime of your Flame of Denial by 25%.
Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets.desc: Your Flamecharm mantras summon puppets of shadow and flame. Your flames are now black.

Wyvern's Claw.additional_info: Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds.
Wyvern's Claw.desc: You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead.
Wyvern's Claw.reqs: 25r LHT OR 25r MED OR 25r HVY, 15s STR

You'll Need To Get Past Me.additional_info: Spawns in an allied NPC to attack whoever hits you. This Talent can only proc if you are not in combat. The cooldown of this Talent scales on your Charisma investment, having a base cooldown of 69.286 seconds with each investment point into Charisma decreasing this by 0.143 seconds. At requirements, this Talent will have a 59 second cooldown, has a maximum cooldown of 62 seconds at 50 Charisma, and a minimum cooldown of 55 seconds at 100 Charisma.
You'll Need To Get Past Me.desc: When you're attacked, one of your many allies will leap into action to protect their boss.
